List of magic items in Act Two
List of magic items in Act Three

entries.name: Amulet of the Absolute
entries.description: These grisly trinkets started popping up with the rise of the Cult of the Absolute. While the skull and triangle are made from cheap pewter, rumours suggest the red handprint is made exclusively with blood from ritual sacrifice.

entries.name: Barnabus' Collar
entries.description: Necklace the Gnoll Master gave Barnabus when she first met him.

entries.name: Bronze Necklace
entries.description: Though shining brightly, this necklace smells distinctively of rust.

entries.name: Bronze Pendant
entries.description: The interlocked bronze links of this necklace tinkle softly every time you move.

entries.name: Burnished Necklace
entries.description: Bright and polished, this necklace was clearly cherished by its previous owner.

entries.name: Destroyed Kill Collar
entries.description: Smells a bit rusty, but looks stylish nonetheless.

entries.name: Dog Collar
entries.description: An old, leather collar for a large dog. The name 'Myrna' is engraved on the tag, surrounded by a plethora of indecipherable runes.

entries.name: Gold Necklace
entries.description: Tiny, ageless flower petals fill the amber stones of this necklace.

entries.name: Gold Pendant
entries.description: Though this necklace looks simple in design, the tiny filigreed triangles holding the gemstone in place demonstrate the jeweller's skill.

entries.name: Pearl Necklace
entries.description: Tiny rainbows reflect in the pearls' iridescent shine.

entries.name: Polished Necklace
entries.description: It is said that wearing a ruby near the heart will increase a lover's courage.

entries.name: Sahuagin Singing Bundle
entries.description: The deep emerald stones on this chain sparkle like Eldath's eyes.

entries.name: Selûnite Amulet
entries.description: A small, silvered necklace, worn by Selûne worshippers. It is adorned with seven pieces of iolite, a blue gemstone used for navigation at sea.

entries.name: Silver Amulet
entries.description: Chunky and a little dated, but made entirely of hammered silver.

entries.name: Silver Locket
entries.description: A finely crafted silver locket, engraved with the words 'For Papa.'

entries.name: Silver Necklace
entries.description: Sapphire necklaces are popular among Baldur's Gate's patriars as mourning garb - the heavy teardrop-shaped stones represent the weight of their loss.

entries.name: Tarnished Locket
entries.description: This locket opens to reveal an intricate illustration of a stone tower. The words 'Elturel: Strength in Unity' are inscribed across the top.

entries.name: Brass Locket (Common)
entries.description: Slightly tarnished, and opened with a mere flick of the thumb.

entries.name: Tarnished Pendant
entries.description: Spots of crumbling green patina are slowly eating away at this once-bronze pendant.

entries.name: Aberration Hunters' Amulet
entries.description: Many a githyanki hunter has worn this amulet before you. The strange stones set in swirling silver reverberate with echoes of their magic.

entries.name: Absolute Confidence Amulet
entries.description: The interlocked bronze links of this necklace tinkle softly every time you move.

entries.name: Absolute's Talisman
entries.description: Stained by blood, and gifted to only the most faithful of True Souls to help preserve their lives.

entries.name: Amulet of Elemental Torment
entries.description: Each jewel gleams with the energy of the natural elements.

entries.name: Amulet of Misty Step
entries.description:
This necklace allows the wearer to cast Misty Step.

Made of blue gems unique to a privately-owned mine in Menzoberranzan, this necklace was likely a token of esteem - or perhaps a desperate attempt to win its recipient's mercy.

entries.name: Amulet of Selûne's Chosen
entries.description: The gems and pearls of this necklace have a brilliant shine to them, as if reflecting unseen moonlight.

entries.name: Amulet of Silvanus
entries.description: This amulet, engraved with a small waterfall, imparts a feeling of calm serenity when worn.

entries.name: Amulet of the Unworthy
entries.description: Once part of the Girdle of Blades, this buckle was torn off and fashioned into an amulet that can be worn by creatures of all sizes.

entries.name: Beastmaster's Chain
entries.description: The green jewel set into this necklace's pendant is carved to resemble a cat's slivered pupil.

entries.name: Broodmother's Revenge
entries.description: Each of this amulet's jewels shines like a viper's eyes.

entries.name: Fireheart
entries.description: The ruby's red reflections look like eerie flames dancing across your skin.

entries.name: Frost Prince
entries.description: Each sapphire feels like a tiny shard of sharpened ice.

entries.name: Hammergrim Mist Amulet
entries.description: One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. Drugging the Keykeeper of Duerra's vaults, the children crept in under cover of night and plundered their mother's treasure - searching desperately for anything that would aid in their flight.

entries.name: Kill Collar
entries.description: Smells a bit rusty, but looks stylish nonetheless.

entries.name: Komira's Locket
entries.description: Worked carefully into the locket's metal back are the words, 'Never dark again.'

entries.name: Moondrop Pendant
entries.description: The back bears an inscription under a delicate crescent moon. 'You're a novice no more, Robin. Only right you should carry a little of our Lady's light with you.'

entries.name: Necklace of Elemental Augmentation
entries.description: The tourmaline in this necklace is almost uncomfortably hot, warmed by a heat all its own.

entries.name: Pearl of Power Amulet
entries.description: There are no molluscs of power, alas.

entries.name: Psychic Spark
entries.description: Every gem hanging from this necklace is warm to the touch, as if waiting to ignite.

entries.name: Shar's Temptation
entries.description: The inlaid jewels are so rich in colour, so deep in hue, you could lose yourself in them.

entries.name: Silver Pendant
entries.description: Grime covers this necklace, but you can vaguely discern delicate engravings of a moon and harp.

entries.name: Spineshudder Amulet
entries.description: Quivers creep up your enemy's back - the slow, long-fingered hand of your magic.

entries.name: Tarnished Charm
entries.description: A menacing cackle emanates from this twisted charm. It whispers to bite, to maim, to kill...

entries.name: The Blast Pendant
entries.description: Though they only worked together for a short time, it is hard to overstate the influence Lenore the cleric of Mystra had on Yrre the Sparkstruck, who often likened harnessing lightning to manipulating the Weave.

entries.name: The Ever-Seeing Eye
entries.description: A pale green eye, pierced by the twisting branches of a dead tree - the result of a foolhardy woman begging Auntie for a favour.

entries.name: Amulet of Branding
entries.description: Though thin and delicate-looking, the amulet's pendant sits heavy against your chest.

entries.name: Amulet of Restoration
entries.description: The gemstone centrepiece of the amulet was long ago mottled and dyed by the tears of a martyr.

entries.name: Amulet of the Drunkard
entries.description: Donning this necklace causes the room to sway and tip - or maybe it was already swaying? Whatever, time for another pint.

entries.name: Amulet of the Harpers
entries.description: Nobility can be found in suffering the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune. So can dying. Best to be on guard.

entries.name: Champion's Chain
entries.description: A plump mass torn from Sovereign Glut's own flesh. A marker of the colony's esteem - or perhaps its property.

entries.name: Chancer's Carcanet
entries.description: Imbued with a little luck after the item was pressed to the pursed lips of a saint of the goddess Tymora. Inscribed roughly and inexpertly on the underside: 'Lady Luck, don't you piss in my porridge oats!'

entries.name: Envoy's Amulet
entries.description: A fleshy amulet shaped by Sovereign Spaw's own hand. Wherever the bearer goes, so does the myconid circle.

entries.name: Periapt of Wound Closure
entries.description: Sometimes the best thing you can do for your friends is to stop bleeding and give them a chance to sort everything out.

entries.name: Sentient Amulet (Rare)
entries.description: Sun-graced warmth radiates from both the pendant and its chain. Somehow, even a brief glance of it brings a smile to your face.

entries.name: Spell Savant Amulet
entries.description: When on the wrong side of a few sherries, the powerful wizards Bigby and Tenser would sometimes see how many spells they could fit into amulets like this one before they burst.

entries.name: Strange Tendril Amulet
entries.description: Eldritch sigils seem to coarse through the metalwork on this amulet.

entries.name: Surgeon's Subjugation Amulet
entries.description: A surgeon is only as reliable as her tools. And, indeed, as depraved.

entries.name: The Amulet of Lost Voices
entries.description: The dead hold no secrets from Jergal's Scriveners of Doom.

entries.name: Uncovered Mysteries
entries.description: Beneath the layers of dust covering this necklace, its inlaid gems still give off a blue sparkle - the colour of Mystra's clergy.

entries.name: Amulet of Greater Health
entries.description: Worn by Lumi, a cleric beholden to twilight, who sheltered her fellow adventurers as a bantam shelters her chicks.

entries.name: Amulet of the Devout
entries.description: Otto, a member of the powerful arcane organisation the Circle of Eight, had a penchant for amulets. So much so that they announced his arrival before he ever needed to.

entries.name: Amulet of Windrider
entries.description: Heavily embossed with filigree, this necklace reflects light in all directions.

entries.name: Corvid Token
entries.description: 'Let your lips turn black as night/On this eve of frightful wights/Let your throat be filled with screams/Nearby looms the Raven Queen!' - A song of dark festivity

entries.name: Fey Semblance Amulet
entries.description: Originally the kidney stone of an archfey, this object has been, ahem, passed down through the centuries.

entries.name: Khalid's Gift
entries.description: A gift from Khalid for Jaheira.

entries.name: Sentient Amulet (Very Rare)
entries.description: Sun-graced warmth radiates from both the pendant and its chain. Somehow, even a brief glance of it brings a smile to your face.

entries.name: Spellcrux Amulet
entries.description: Some scholars have speculated that spells have a mind of their own, suggesting that the spells get bored between being cast and restored.

entries.name: The Spectator Eyes
entries.description: Spectators are hideous aberrations that float above the ground, fiercely staring around and shooting beams at anything they don't appreciate.

entries.name: Tressym Collar
entries.description: The gem in this collar's centre is placed as a common courtesy: it allows the tressym's summoner to be identified and complained to in the case of bereaved pet owners or pigeon-masters. This one glows with a Waterdhavian name: Gale Dekarios.

entries.name: Unflinching Protector Amulet
entries.description: Touching this amulet's centrepiece, you are imbued with a vision of woven strands, and the strands coming apart and holding true and firm over your friends, like shields banded in a haze of golden light.

entries.name: Amulet of Bhaal
entries.description: A silver amulet depicting the symbol of Bhaal.

entries.name: Bloody Amulet
entries.description: Tiny specks of blood cover this amulet. They have pooled into the engravings on the back, spelling out the name 'Wulbren' in a grisly brown hue.

entries.name: Brass Locket
entries.description: Instead of a picture, a folded piece of paper is trapped inside. It reads, 'To Barth, You can do more than you realise. Love always, Mum'.

entries.name: Mayrina's Locket
entries.description: An aged, blue-stained scrap of paper within this locket reads: 'To Mayrina - Will you go to the summer fair with me? From Connor. PS. These bluebells are from Ma Grundy's patch, please don't tell!'

entries.name: Dauntless Amulet
entries.description: Flowing through your chest, threads of whiskey-like warmth - they spread and spread, and who could lay you low, you champion in hopeful hours?

entries.name: Ilmater's Aid
entries.description: Named after the god of martyrs, this amulet seems to shine in the presence of the wearer's blood.

entries.name: Kruznabir's Asylum Amulet
entries.description: The bauble is emblazoned with fiendish words that, when translated, mean, 'May your throat be educated in new screams.'

entries.name: Scarab of Protection
entries.description: This beetle-shaped medallion thrums with a power redolent of older civilisations in Toril - how old is this relic, all grouted with dust as it is?

entries.name: Synaptic Needle Amulet
entries.description: Fingering this amulet sends a spike of pleasure sliding through the brain - pleasure that could be turned to pain in an enemy's addled mind.

entries.name: Treacleflow Amulet
entries.description: The air surrounding this lavishly decorated amulet is thick - like pushing your fingers through sap or syrup.

entries.name: Wakeful Amulet
entries.description: While this doesn't prevent wilful rest, it does protect you from being put to sleep from such sources as hypnotism, copious alcohol usage, or, indeed, magic.

entries.name: Bandit's Armour
entries.description: This lightweight armour appears to have been quickly produced, skipped stitches and fraying edges betraying the inattention of its maker.

entries.name: Broken Padded Armour
entries.description: A standard gambeson of quilted cloth. Good for catching blows, but almost unbearably sweaty.

entries.name: Druid Leather Armour
entries.description: Dark, messy stains line the armholes of the well-used leather breastplate.

entries.name: Faded Drow Leather Armour
entries.description: The sun's harsh light has dulled this armour's dark lustre.

entries.name: Leather Armour
entries.description: Dark, messy stains line the armholes of the well-used leather breastplate.

entries.name: Padded Armour
entries.description: A standard gambeson of quilted cloth. Good for catching blows, but almost unbearably sweaty.

entries.name: Selûnite Robe
entries.description: Crafted with care, this robe will protect you from the elements. It won't do much against a sword's thrust, though.

entries.name: Simple Jerkin
entries.description: Dark, messy stains line the armholes of the well-used leather breastplate.

entries.name: Studded Leather Armour
entries.description: Shaped, hardened, and reinforced with metal studs, leather is the armour of choice for those who value agility as much as protection.

entries.name: Blazer of Benevolence
entries.description: Even though the embroidered velvet won't help against a sharp blade, wearing it fills you with self-assuredness.

entries.name: Leather Armour +1
entries.description: This well-tailored leather tunic is reinforced by geometric quilting.

entries.name: Padded Armour +1
entries.description: The quilting threads running through this padded vest seem to gleam in the rising sun.

entries.name: Scarlet Leather Armour
entries.description: This well-tailored leather tunic is reinforced by geometric quilting.

entries.name: Studded Leather Armour +1
entries.description: This armour is strong enough to stop a dagger and light enough to escape whatever weapon follows it.

entries.name: Drow Studded Leather Armour
entries.description: Tracings of glossy black spider-web mark this drow-made armour. It is supple, but strong - and made to blend in with the dark caves and crevices of the Underdark.

entries.name: Leather Armour +2
entries.description: This armour is stitched together with thick, metal-lined cord, reinforcing it at the seams.

entries.name: Padded Armour +2
entries.description: A standard gambeson of quilted cloth. Good for catching blows, but almost unbearably sweaty.

entries.name: Penumbral Armour
entries.description:
One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children.

Kitted out though they were for escape, the older siblings had a horrible time encouraging their younger brothers and sisters, who at the crux were frightened of what their mother would do to them should they be caught.

entries.name: Shadeclinger Armour
entries.description: Glutted with lone wolves and well-meaning scallywags, the Harpers are not averse to shadows - quite the contrary. For many such individuals, being swallowed in the dark throat of the night is the only method they know, or care to know.

entries.name: Spidersilk Armour
entries.description: Tracings of glossy black spider-web mark this drow-made armour. It is supple, but strong - and made to blend in with the dark caves and crevices of the Underdark.

entries.name: Studded Leather Armour +2
entries.description: Superbly shaped, elegantly designed, and tough as ring mail with none of the weight.

entries.name: Armour of Landfall
entries.description: Smelling of long-abandoned gardens grown wild with thorny roses, moss and hibiscus, this armour was worn by a powerful druid who spent so long from people that she forgot to miss them.

entries.name: Armour of Moonbasking
entries.description: This armour was designed by lunar-obsessed Cuthbertina, a gnomish arcane smith who now lives peacefully on a mountain plateau with her magical forge.

entries.name: Armour of the Sporekeeper
entries.description: According to one story, this armour was enriched by the cascading spores of a myconid sovereign, its great fungal head shimmering and twinkling as it shook upon the material.

entries.name: Bhaalist Armour
entries.description:
Bhaal, Lord of Murder, was forced to walk the world as a mortal man during a period of history called the Time of Troubles. He was more vulnerable than he had ever been.

But Bhaal was cunning. He had contingencies in case he died.

entries.name: Elegant Studded Leather
entries.description: After she returned from her confinement at the hands of the demon prince Graz'zt, the Goddess of prosperity, Waukeen, appointed a champion, who donned this studded leather and took up arms against those who had schismed and corrupted her church in the interim.

entries.name: +1 Breastplate
entries.description: Wearing this "plus one" garment allows you to bring one additional person to a wedding or any other similar occasion.

entries.name: Breastplate
entries.description: This standard-sized breastplate is lined with thick padding meant to cushion the wearer and deflect blows from assailants. The uniform squares of the padding suggest a mathematically-minded crafter.

entries.name: Damaged Dark Justiciar Armour
entries.description: Though time has tarnished this armour's metal and cracked its leather, the black sheen of Shar's symbol shines eternal from its chestpiece.

entries.name: Dreamwalker Plate
entries.description: A battle-burnished armour tempered with otherworldly steel.

entries.name: Githyanki Half Plate
entries.description: This armour was forged to Vlaakith's standards under the exacting eye of a githyanki smith.

entries.name: Half Plate Armour
entries.description: This heavy, resilient breastplate is reinforced by a padded gambeson to protect soldiers from hip to neck.

entries.name: Hide Armour
entries.description: Constructed from carefully-chosen animal hides tanned, hardened and varnished to a gleaming finish.

entries.name: Scale Mail
entries.description: A hefty shirt of scale, offering some protection against the slings and arrows of the world.

entries.name: Scale Mail of Devotion
entries.description: Embroidered on the tabard are the tenets of devotion: Honesty, Courage, Compassion, Honour, and Duty.

entries.name: Scale Mail of the Ancients
entries.description: Four embroidered sentences decorate the tabard - the tenets of the ancients: 'Kindle the Light. Shelter the Light. Preserve your own Light. Be the Light.'

entries.name: Scale Mail of the Crown
entries.description: Embroidered on the tabard are the tenets of devotion: Honesty, Courage, Compassion, Honour, and Duty.

entries.name: Scale Mail of Vengeance
entries.description: Gold embroidery covers the inside of the tabard, right over the heart: 'By any means necessary, I will fight the Greater Evil, showing no mercy for the wicked.'

entries.name: Breastplate +1
entries.description: This breastplate is crafted in the specialty style of a mysterious armourer in Amn known only as 'The Tailor.'

entries.name: Chain Shirt +1
entries.description: The intricate embroidery on the linen panel of this armour indicates the nobility of its previous owner.

entries.name: Dark Justiciar Mail
entries.description: Though well-preserved, the armour's gleam is somewhat muted - as if half-shadowed, even in brightest day.

entries.name: Half Plate Armour +1
entries.description: Heraldic runes are sewn into the padding of this armour, offering a gift of protection to whoever dons it.

entries.name: Hedge Wanderer Armour
entries.description: This simple cured goat hide was enchanted by a travelling druid. A goatherd once helped her negotiate a strange maze of hedges, so she blessed all his goats in thanks.

entries.name: Hide Armour +1
entries.description: Tight stitches bind panels of hard leather into a formfitting carapace that moves like a second skin.

entries.name: Luminous Armour
entries.description: Many an adventurer has found themselves swallowed up by the dark throat of some nameless dungeon, aching for a glimpse of light.

entries.name: Scale Mail +1
entries.description: The work of a skilled craftsman, this scale shirt offers better protection than most.

entries.name: Slippery Chain Shirt
entries.description: Scored with slime and blood, it seems this chain mail shirt couldn't save its previous owner. Although it may help the next.

entries.name: The Oak Father's Embrace
entries.description: Embroidered with a simple maxim - 'Nature is the True State of the World' - these hides radiate a faint divine power.

entries.name: Barkskin Armour
entries.description: The bark motifs in this armour are like the boles of oak trees in a wood where the acorns slept long, and grew proud.

entries.name: Breastplate +2
entries.description: This garment's previous owner left a few minor personal effects in its inner breast pocket: a scrap of sassafrass, a short bit of thread, and half a peppermint.

entries.name: Chain Shirt +2
entries.description: This mail's impossibly fine, close joining indicates the work of gnomish fingers.

entries.name: Elven Chain
entries.description: The weight of the interwoven steel rings is offset by clever elven craftsmanship - rustling against your undershirt, the mail feels like you're wearing a cloud.

entries.name: Half Plate Armour +2
entries.description: This breastplate is far tougher than it appears, taking blows from common weapons without suffering so much as a scratch.

entries.name: Hide Armour +2
entries.description: This hide armour, soft to the touch but hard as a zaratan's hide, is stitched together of narrow panels allowing for the wearer's ease of movement and comfort.

entries.name: Scale Mail +2
entries.description: Crafted by an artist's hands, this exquisite scale shirt feels like it could turn aside any blade.

entries.name: The Jolty Vest
entries.description: Yrre the Sparkstruck got their nickname for both their obsession with lightning and the inventions they created, which had the habit of electrocuting both Yrre and any poor observers that got too close.

entries.name: Unwanted Masterwork Scalemail
entries.description: Nothing stings the master blacksmith more than a cancelled commission - not even molten iron. This mail is engraved with the mark of a devillish forgemaster, as well as several curses stamped out in Infernal, and hums with diabolic magic.

entries.name: Yuan-Ti Scale Mail
entries.description: The snakefolk of Chult are not known for waste, so often forge lightweight and robust armour like this from their own shed skin.

entries.name: Adamantine Scale Mail
entries.description: The adamantine scales hug your body like a second skin - a heavy, near-impregnable skin.

entries.name: Armour of Agility
entries.description: Layered sheets of smelted, shaped, and smithed steel have been etched with a sweetly luminous gold. Its outward appearance is heavy. And yet it's so light when you lift it, like lifting a bag of shrunken dead leaves.

entries.name: Flame Enamelled Armour
entries.description: The air around this armour shimmers, oven-hot. From the seams of the armour you can hear a red-tinted rumble, like coals digesting in a furnace.

entries.name: Sharpened Snare Cuirass
entries.description: This magnificent hide was harvested from a rare mythological creature of the Feywild, a cross between a unicorn and a stoat.

entries.name: Chain Mail
entries.description: The tight weave of chains in this armour chimes like wind through leaves.

entries.name: Splint Armour
entries.description: Combining sturdy metal plates with flexible cloth, this armour promises protection and mobility.

entries.name: Chain Mail +1
entries.description: Fine fabric obscures the bulk of this chain mail, allowing its wearer to mix in polite society while protecting them from unexpected assailants.

entries.name: Splint Armour +1
entries.description: Skilled hands crafted this armour, reinforcing the metal plates while sacrificing none of the flexibility.

entries.name: Armour of Devotion
entries.description: The soft hum of a fervent prayer reverberates throughout the armoured plates.

entries.name: Cerebral Citadel Armour
entries.description: The little tentacle engravings are a nice touch.

entries.name: Chain Mail +2
entries.description: Made from thick, strong chains loosely-fitted, this armour hangs more heavily than some but protects its wearer with an impenetrable weave of metal.

entries.name: Dwarven Splintmail
entries.description: Skilled hands crafted this armour, reinforcing the metal plates while sacrificing none of the flexibility.

entries.name: Flawed Helldusk Armour
entries.description: 'I learned so much from Carixim. All sorts of forgecraft that... S-sorry. Just when I think of him, and the whimpers those people inside him made... I don't know. Anyway, it was worth it. Worth it to be the best.' - Overheard from the smith Dammon

entries.name: Rippling Force Mail
entries.description: Dents, notches, and nicks add character to each ring of this mail - yet each blemish also speaks to those who tasted magical vengeance on the armour's behalf.

entries.name: Splint Armour +2
entries.description: Wrought of an artisan's skill and passion, this armour will turn aside all but the fiercest of blades.

entries.name: Adamantine Splint Armour
entries.description: The adamantine plates lock and slide together perfectly - offering protection against even the deadliest of blades.

entries.name: Armour of Persistence
entries.description: Great sheets of steel were hammered and bashed into something like a carapace, thick and dense - you can almost feel the hammer blows, flooded with rich magic.

entries.name: Blackguard's Plate
entries.description: To break one's oath is a dangerous game - it marks you as a faithless cur, an exile without a cause. This armour is tempered by an age of rocks, blades, and persecution turned against it - and is buffed by the immutable, unbindable will of its wearer.

entries.name: Reaper's Embrace
entries.description: Heavy steel bones and teeth enclose the armour's chest and neck like a grotesque exoskeleton that both swallows and protects the wearer.

entries.name: Helldusk Armour
entries.description: Carixim, soul-stuffed forgemaster of hellish Avernus, hammers away ceaselessly at new creations. Questions of morality and destiny do not concern him. Conscience is for his betters. He works with cheer, his swollen skin moaning soothingly.

entries.name: Absolute Outfit
entries.description: Adorned with the tripartite symbol of the Absolute, this ensemble of black and green presents the wearer as either a mocker or a devotee of the cult. Or someone who likes the cut and colour. Or someone who is cold.

entries.name: Anarchic Blue Outfit
entries.description: There is something of the blue-blooded rebel in this outfit, of the bandit princess or prince stealing plunder and hearts.

entries.name: Anarchic Green Outfit
entries.description: There is something of the green-grinning rebel in this outfit, of the bandit princess or prince stealing plunder and hearts.

entries.name: Anarchic Purple Outfit
entries.description: There is something of the purple-peacock rebel in this outfit, of the bandit princess or prince stealing plunder and hearts.

entries.name: Anarchic White Outfit
entries.description: There is something of the pale-white-toothed rebel in this outfit, of the bandit princess or prince stealing plunder and hearts.

entries.name: Angelic Scion Outfit
entries.description: Golden vambraces and arm rings surmount this divine set.

entries.name: Astarion's Eccentric Clothes
entries.description: A once-fine shirt that's seen years of cuts, tears, and careful repairs. Clearly someone cares about looking good.

entries.name: Backless Extravaganza
entries.description: Backless so that people can pat you on the back and proclaim, 'I say, lovely outfit.'

entries.name: Black Flare Leather Outfit
entries.description: A minimalist leather binding get-up that clings to the skin and creaks just the slightest bit when you move.

entries.name: Blue Flare Leather Outfit
entries.description: A minimalist leather binding get-up that clings to the skin and creaks just the slightest bit when you move.

entries.name: Bright Flare Leather Outfit
entries.description: A minimalist leather binding get-up that clings to the skin and creaks just the slightest bit when you move.

entries.name: Brocade Ensemble
entries.description: The rich detail on this ornate garb suggest the work of the finest craftspeople Waterdeep's fashion district have to offer.

entries.name: Chandelier-Style Embroidered Ensemble
entries.description: Modelled on the chandeliers in the Waterdhavian Sea Ward - aesthetically pleasing and most grand.

entries.name: Channeler's Trunks
entries.description: Underwear of this type was commonly worn by mages powerful enough to broadcast their likeness across the many planes of existence.

entries.name: Chatterbox's Tabard
entries.description: Indigo cloth manipulated into elaborate patterns mark this outfit's wearer as a gregarious observer, listener, and conversationalist.

entries.name: Chocolatier Style Doublet
entries.description: This lovely ensemble is evocative of the apron of a master chocolatier - and just as scrumptious.

entries.name: Circus Ensemble
entries.description: Designed for fun rather than function.

entries.name: City of Brass Outfit
entries.description: Though the name is an exaggeration (the fabled city's heat would burn the fabric black stitch by stitch), the sheer magnificence of this ensemble's appeal is not.

entries.name: Comfortable Ashmeadow Outfit
entries.description: Stylish without being altogether noteworthy, though the embroidery is actually very fine in certain lights.

entries.name: Comfortable Autumnal Outfit
entries.description: Stylish without being altogether noteworthy, though the embroidery is actually very fine in certain lights.

entries.name: Comfortable Blue-Red Outfit
entries.description: Stylish without being altogether noteworthy, though the embroidery is actually very fine in certain lights.

entries.name: Comfortable Red Shirt
entries.description: As red as campfire flame.

entries.name: Cosy Blue Shirt
entries.description: At camp, under the deep blue sky fading to indigo at the horizon, this shirt fits right in.

entries.name: Cut-Throat Leather Ensemble
entries.description: With sharpened edges, this ensemble is not to be worn by the fainthearted... or by those who bleed easily.

entries.name: Dandy's Dream Ensemble
entries.description: While the leather is cheap and the silver is simply paint, this outfit is clearly loved and well looked after.

entries.name: Debtor's Attire
entries.description: This attire disguises you as a poor soul indebted to Raphael - other debtors in his thrall will not be hostile to you.

entries.name: Decadent Ensemble
entries.description: Spun from gold and inlaid with real rubies, this outfit costs more than the contents of most patriars Counting House vaults.

entries.name: Delicately Constructed Outfit
entries.description: Capably crafted, giving the impression of affirming wealth,

entries.name: Diamond Blue Doublet
entries.description: Robust, sleek, and flattering, this ensemble presents a very fetching figure for the wearer.

entries.name: Diamond Pattern Garb
entries.description: Diamonds are like the colour black - they simply go with everything.

entries.name: Drow Outfit
entries.description: With its harsh, almost arachnid cut and shape, this outfit evokes the spiderlike denizens of the Underdark.

entries.name: Duke's Magnificent Raiments
entries.description: Envisioned and created by a tailor of considerable talents. To wear it is to make one the envy of both friend and enemy.

entries.name: Dusky Ensemble
entries.description: Humble materials crafted with a light touch. This outfit is strong enough to withstand the elements but delicate as a sliver of moon.

entries.name: Elegant Robe
entries.description: A draped robe made with lightweight fabric. Made for seduction rather than battle.

entries.name: Embroidered Ensemble
entries.description: A delicately-embroidered outfit inspired by the decorative spine of Sharro's 'A Sommelier's Guide to the Forgotten Realms.'

entries.name: Eminent Emerald Outfit
entries.description: Each stitch not embellished with filigree and gold weave is gorgeous as the polished scales of a green dragon fully grown.

entries.name: Eminent Obsidian Outfit
entries.description: Black as volcanic glass and just as valuable, this ensemble would turn the eye of an entire court.

entries.name: Fastidiously Perfect Outfit
entries.description: Nimble fingers designed and created this outfit.

entries.name: Finely Crafted Ensemble
entries.description: Whoever crafted this outfit designed it to be both practical and stylish - an excellent combination.

entries.name: Frilly Outfit
entries.description: For the wearer who likes every ruffle and pleat just so.

entries.name: Glittering Garb
entries.description: Gold, gold, gold, from sternum to thigh - that's how you make an entrance.

entries.name: Green Flare Leather Outfit
entries.description: A minimalist leather binding get-up that clings to the skin and creaks just the slightest bit when you move.

entries.name: Grubby Ochre Clothes
entries.description: Perhaps once pretty, now musty and worn.

entries.name: Grubby Ochre Clothes (Dark Urge)
entries.description: Perhaps once pretty, now musty and worn.

entries.name: Halsin's Grove Garments
entries.description: Feeling the fabric, the strangest feeling occurs: your thumbs brush sun-dappled leaves, skim the water of a creek, tangle in the fur of some panting animal, heat and breath.

entries.name: Harper Finery
entries.description: Scrubbed to an inch of its life, the barely visible bloodstains on this Harper garb suggest it has seen more than a few 'parties'.

entries.name: Homely Clothes
entries.description: Perfect for ambling around a campsite, enjoying the starlight and good conversation.

entries.name: Hot Pants
entries.description: Hewn with rough style, these trousers are fire-resistant, blood-proof, and tough to pull off unless you're a big barbarian lady.

entries.name: Jaheira's Respectable Clothes
entries.description: Though humble in appearance, these clothes bear little hints at Jaheira's fashionability. Minimalism offset by the subtle hues shining brighter at night and softening in sunbeams.

entries.name: Karlach's Infernal Trousers
entries.description: Torn and hell-scented, these trousers have seen a good deal of action - though not perhaps the sort Karlach might prefer.

entries.name: Klagga's Pants
entries.description: These pants, cinched at the waist, are stained with splotches of brown and crimson.

entries.name: Lacey Garb
entries.description: Do not be fooled by this ensemble. While delicately made, it will not impede you in a fight - should the need arise.

entries.name: Lae'zel's Clothes
entries.description: As exciting as a trade deposition and as functional as a brick.

entries.name: Leathery Garb
entries.description: So tight...

entries.name: Lionheart Green-Pink Outfit
entries.description: Robust, sleek, and flattering, this ensemble presents a very fetching figure for the wearer.

entries.name: Lionheart Outfit
entries.description: Presumably named for a courageous person. Regardless, a marvellously decadent outfit.

entries.name: Lionheart Teal Outfit
entries.description: Robust, sleek, and flattering, this ensemble presents a very fetching figure for the wearer.

entries.name: Magnificently Realised Ensemble
entries.description: Some craftsperson of the highest calibre envisioned and created this, and anyone who wears it shall be the envy of not only their friends, but their enemies too.

entries.name: Mellow Black Shirt
entries.description: Dark and inexpensive, yet with a very charming cosiness once worn.

entries.name: Mesmerising Circus Outfit
entries.description: A burst of fun and colour, this outfit completely avoids the general sensation of damp misery inherent to the standard circus clown.

entries.name: Minsc's Fantastical Relaxation Garb
entries.description: To the metaphorical eye, an absolute fantasia of an outfit, declaiming Minsc as a style icon without equal. To the literal eye, this is a belt-buckle shirt/pants combo.

entries.name: Minsc's Underwear
entries.description: Tight, aerodynamic, and built for maximum breathability. Humidity is no friend to hamsters.

entries.name: Minthara's At-Ease Clothes
entries.description: While there is little of the spidery Goddess Lolth's influence in this outfit, there is something of spiney inflexible culture of the drow in it.

entries.name: Moonlit Ensemble
entries.description: Embroidered with pure silver, this garment fits the body like a glove, while allowing complete ease of movement.

entries.name: Nomad's Garb
entries.description: Form-fitting and highly functional, warming the wearer in chilled deepwinter air, but cooling at summertide's zenith.

entries.name: Opalescent Outfit
entries.description: When held out in the sun, the sleeves almost glitter, so richly woven is the fabric of this outfit.

entries.name: Prison Tatters
entries.description: Infested with vermin and stiff with dirt, this garb - if you can call it such - reeks to high heaven.

entries.name: Raffish Bronze-Red Outfit
entries.description: Raffish (meaning sly and disreputable in an alluring way) comes from Raffish Buck Daederum, whose fashion this ensemble mimicks closely.

entries.name: Raffish Chestnut Outfit
entries.description: Raffish (meaning sly and disreputable in an alluring way) comes from Raffish Buck Daederum, whose fashion this ensemble mimicks closely.

entries.name: Raffish Garb
entries.description: Something slightly perilous and fun imbues this design of garments.

entries.name: Raffish Metallic-Shaded Outfit
entries.description: Raffish (meaning sly and disreputable in an alluring way) comes from Raffish Buck Daederum, whose fashion this ensemble mimicks closely.

entries.name: Raffish Midnight Outfit
entries.description: Raffish (meaning sly and disreputable in an alluring way) comes from Raffish Buck Daederum, whose fashion this ensemble mimicks closely.

entries.name: Road-Dust Grey Clothes
entries.description: Grey with accumulated road dust, these clothes are nothing special.

entries.name: Robes of the New Moon
entries.description: These Sharran robes emphasise authority and austerity over comfort - a negative, like the black hole of the new moon.

entries.name: Scruffy Vagabond Clothes
entries.description: Patchwork and threadbare, these clothes practically dangle off their wearer.

entries.name: Senja'si Finery
entries.description: Formal garments typically worn by githyanki seers, repurposed as ceremonial attire.

entries.name: Shadowheart's Clothes
entries.description: A little bar of standard-issue cloister soap is tucked into this outfit. It smells like lime and religious fervour.

entries.name: Snug Purple Shirt
entries.description: Purple as tasty plums shared by a camp tent.

entries.name: Snugglesome Green Shirt
entries.description: Soft and green and ideal for a good sleep under the stars.

entries.name: Solemnity Outfit
entries.description: Austere and no-nonsense, this outfit betokens largesse and poise.

entries.name: Solemnity Outfit in Blue
entries.description: One of master Figaro's collection pieces, this outfit maintains the poise and grace of the wearer. Honestly, it elevates it considerably. Bad poise becomes competent poise. Competent becomes strong. Strong becomes spiffing.

entries.name: Solemnity Outfit in Gold Medallions
entries.description: One of master Figaro's collection pieces, this outfit maintains the poise and grace of the wearer. Honestly, it elevates it considerably. Bad poise becomes competent poise. Competent becomes strong. Strong becomes spiffing.

entries.name: Solemnity Outfit in Green
entries.description: One of master Figaro's collection pieces, this outfit maintains the poise and grace of the wearer. Honestly, it elevates it considerably. Bad poise becomes competent poise. Competent becomes strong. Strong becomes spiffing.

entries.name: Solemnity Outfit in Purple
entries.description: One of master Figaro's collection pieces, this outfit maintains the poise and grace of the wearer. Honestly, it elevates it considerably. Bad poise becomes competent poise. Competent becomes strong. Strong becomes spiffing.

entries.name: Splendid Beige Outfit
entries.description: Tailored with immaculate skill, this outfit makes you feel like someone who has elevated beige. Beige is an atrocious colour, yet here it is, very impressive and pleasing on the eye.

entries.name: Splendid Blue Outfit
entries.description: This outfit makes you feel like a piece of the summer sky transmuted into silk.

entries.name: Splendid Gold Outfit
entries.description: This outfit makes the wearer feel like a ray of sunlight swanning around camp.

entries.name: Splendid Green Outfit
entries.description: This outfit makes the wearer feel like a brilliant green turaco bird.

entries.name: Splendid Outfit
entries.description: Keenly administered to by the sort of fingers that were born stitching, crocheting, and generally making nice clothes.

entries.name: Splendid Purple Outfit
entries.description: Tailored with immaculate skill, this outfit makes you feel like a Luskan noble walking their manor instead of a wilderland camp.

entries.name: Splendid Red Outfit
entries.description: This outfit makes you feel like a red dragon's fiery breath, only the deadliness lies in sheer aesthetic beauty.

entries.name: Splendid Teal Outfit
entries.description: This outfit makes the wearer feel like a bouquet of puya flowers, except with legs, and great style.

entries.name: Spring Slimfit Outfit
entries.description: Accentuating all features, turning stockiness into slenderness, turning a beer-belly into... well, an ale gut, but even so! A win overall!

entries.name: Strapped Choker Leather Ensemble
entries.description: So tight...

entries.name: Swarthy Wayfarer in Blue
entries.description: A most adventuresome and spring-heeled variety of ensemble, perfect for journey-makers and risk-takers.

entries.name: Swarthy Wayfarer in Cream
entries.description: A most adventuresome and spring-heeled variety of ensemble, perfect for journey-makers and risk-takers.

entries.name: Swarthy Wayfarer in Green
entries.description: A most adventuresome and spring-heeled variety of ensemble, perfect for journey-makers and risk-takers.

entries.name: Swarthy Wayfarer in Red
entries.description: A most adventuresome and spring-heeled variety of ensemble, perfect for journey-makers and risk-takers.

entries.name: Sweetly Tailored Outfit
entries.description: Fashioned at the hands of someone deeply skilled... or, at the very least, someone who was having a good day at the loom and tailor shop.

entries.name: Tasteful Suit
entries.description: Restrained but finely-made, this simply elegant suit appeals to a variety of tastes.

entries.name: Teal Slimfit Outfit
entries.description: Accentuating all features, turning stockiness into slenderness, turning a beer-belly into... well, an ale gut, but even so! A win overall!

entries.name: The Blade's Padded Armour
entries.description: A standard gambeson of quilted cloth. Good for catching blows, though unbearably warm against the skin.

entries.name: Very Handsome Shirt
entries.description: Whichever rodent chose this outfit must have thought its wearer looked very handsome in it.

entries.name: Weave-Touched Robe
entries.description: A beautiful robe crafted with the Weave itself. It thrums with power.

entries.name: Winter Gala Doublet
entries.description: Crisply white with snatches of blue, this garment would not be out of place at a winter festival gala celebrating the wearer's sense of style.

entries.name: Cape of the Red Prince
entries.description: A noble warrior's cloak, woven in the heart of an ancient empire.

entries.name: Cloak
entries.description: Woven of heavy wool, this cloak is solid of make if somewhat stiff to wear.

entries.name: Cindermoth Cloak
entries.description: With every rustle of this cloak, small moths like windblown embers appear around you - they flutter for a moment, then fade into inconsequence.

entries.name: Cloak of Cunning Brume
entries.description:
One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. The children found nothing of use in the vault and were discouraged.

But in the morning the Vault Keykeeper's son, who admired the children, sought them out - and in his arms he brought a wealth of things, forged in shadow.

entries.name: Cloak of Elemental Absorption
entries.description: A favourite among fleet-footed gish, this cloak allows the wearer to wield a foe's elemental mastery against them.

entries.name: Fleshmelter Cloak
entries.description: Droplets of foul acid drip from the tails of this cloak, as if from the stinger of a demonic scorpion.

entries.name: Reverse Rain Cloak
entries.description: The wearer is perpetually just a little bit damp.

entries.name: Thunderskin Cloak
entries.description: Through a gap in the long snarls of thread, you are sure you can glimpse a great black thunderhead swollen with purple lightning and spears of rain.

entries.name: Vivacious Cloak
entries.description: The sheer mortal terror of the low-vitality spellcaster (who can be blown over by a wafted spoon) can be partially offset by cloaks like this one.

entries.name: Cloak of Displacement
entries.description: The fur is so blue as to be almost black. When mantled across your shoulders, the patterns on the cloak seem to shift and ripple.

entries.name: Derivation Cloak
entries.description: Based on a mad alchemist's experiments to derive youth from his victims by poisoning them, this cloak relies on a much more reliable arcane formula.

entries.name: The Deathstalker Mantle
entries.description:
Let hill and hollow be a door
To screams that last forevermore.

entries.name: Wavemother's Cloak
entries.description: Little jellyfish-shaped pockets line the inside of this cloak.

entries.name: Mantle of the Holy Warrior
entries.description: This garment accidentally fell into the communal steambaths during the All Saints Morning Retreat And Candlelit Guided Meditation.

entries.name: Nymph Cloak
entries.description: The charmers, seducers, philanderers, flirts, gallants, beguilers, ravishers, rogues, tempters, and tantalisers of the Feywild all share one common trait: they make you feel as if you are the only diamond among the drift.

entries.name: Shade-Slayer Cloak
entries.description: Rough and coarse, the cloak's materials soften to silk when immersed in shadow.

entries.name: Cloak of Avarice
entries.description: For one to wear this heavy cloak woven of errant, unused gold, one's pockets must hang even heavier still.

entries.name: Minsc Cloak
entries.description: Woven of heavy wool, this cloak is solid of make if somewhat stiff to wear.

entries.name: Phasmid Cloak
entries.description: Zhentarim spies have been known to take on the aspect of the phasmid - an insect sometimes called the devil's darning needle - to blend into their surroundings.

entries.name: Barbarian Clothes
entries.description: A rough combination of furs, leathers, and supple fabrics, made for a life outside civilisation.

entries.name: Monastic Robes
entries.description: This garment's pristine condition despite years of martial training speaks to a supremely disciplined owner.

entries.name: Robe
entries.description: Crafted with care, this robe will protect you from the elements. It won't do much against a sword's thrust, though.

entries.name: Simple Robe
entries.description: Crafted with care, this robe will protect you from the elements. It won't do much against a sword's thrust, though.

entries.name: Sorcerer Robe
entries.description: Neat leather bands keep the trailing cloth secure. Singed sleeves are a liability for any spellcaster.

entries.name: Armour of Uninhibited Kushigo
entries.description:
Long ago, Kushigo was a warrior. Bedecked in an enormous set of plate steel, its shoulder pauldrons fashioned like great antlered stags, his arrival on a battlefield spelled doom for the enemy.

Yet this armour - so light and fine - speaks nothing to that legacy.

entries.name: Bided Time
entries.description: Revenge is best served. Hot or cold makes no difference.

entries.name: Bloodguzzler Garb
entries.description: No sooner does blood speck the armour than it's absorbed, as if sustaining something within.

entries.name: Cloth Armour
entries.description: No sooner does blood speck the armour than it's absorbed, as if sustaining something within.

entries.name: Poisoner's Robe
entries.description: Found in the Spider Queen's stomach, this robe emanates a sour smell and stings to the touch.

entries.name: Robe of Summer
entries.description: This robe's thin fabric is pleasantly warm to the touch.

entries.name: Cloth of Authority
entries.description: One can hardly be called a lord if they aren't dressed as such. A cursory glance at Gortash's finery would reveal intricate garb - a closer look would reveal a maddening attention to even the most minute details of the filigree.

entries.name: Drunken Cloth
entries.description: Long ago, Kushigo was a warrior. Bedecked in enormous, stag-antlered plate, his arrival spelled doom for the enemy. This flimsy cloth speaks nothing to that legacy.

entries.name: Enraging Heart Garb
entries.description: Created by a designer and an enchanter who were going through a messy divorce at the time. As such the armour is filled with passive-aggressive rage.

entries.name: Garb of the Land and Sky
entries.description:
Long ago, Kushigo was a warrior. Bedecked in an enormous set of plate steel, its shoulder pauldrons fashioned like great antlered stags, his arrival on a battlefield spelled doom for the enemy.

Yet this armour - so light and fine - speaks nothing to that legacy.
entries.wikiTitle: Garb of the Land and Sky

entries.name: Icebite Robe
entries.description: Delicate ferns of frost glitter in the lining of this robe.

entries.name: Mutilated Carapace
entries.description: Hard, fleshy leather has been derived from a countless slew of victims to form this armour for Bhaal's fetid chosen.

entries.name: Obsidian Laced Robe
entries.description: The inside of this robe is dark and faceted like volcanic glass, yet the material is light and soft. Against the skin, it also produces a heat like a toasty fire on a day of snow.

entries.name: Robe of Exquisite Focus
entries.description: This robe once belonged to one of the great wizard Tenser's lecturers. While in university, Tenser used to practise spells on this robe, sometimes resulting in wonderful arcane discovery.

entries.name: Shelter of Athkatla
entries.description: Mantled in the sublime majesty of this cloak, you magically sense Lorroakan's complex feelings for his homeland. Merriment and comfort go hand in hand with a jilted sentiment around his lovers and his family. And the old friends he thought of, but would never see again.

entries.name: The Graceful Cloth
entries.description: A garment worn by one of three monks who fought together against Headless Serpent, Secret Venom, a gang in the port city of Nyanzaru. This was worn by Roahton Mobar, whose stances were broad and strong.

entries.name: The Mighty Cloth
entries.description: A garment worn by one of three monks who fought together against Headless Serpent, Secret Venom, a gang in the port city of Nyanzaru. This was worn by Kimigha Poji, whose stances were narrow and swift.

entries.name: The Protecty Sparkswall
entries.description: Yrre the Sparkstruck was raised in the Underdark, so they weren't surprised that power begets envy, and envy begets violence. They were prepared.

entries.name: Viconia's Priestess Robe
entries.description: Listening to the magical hum this robe emits dulls your senses, thoughts, feelings - everything. Listen too long, and you can almost hear the screaming chitters of a thousand spiders devoured by encroaching, hungry darkness. Almost.

entries.name: Bonespike Garb
entries.description: Sharp juts and knobbly nodules of bone stud this armour, as if something ancient sank its teeth deep into the leather and they got stuck there.

entries.name: Infernal Robe
entries.description: Presumably Mizora was not always a sensuous and manipulative benefactor of troubled souls like Wyll. Negotiating the hierarchies of hell result in changes of form - but was she ever less beautiful, less erudite, less willful?

entries.name: Moon Devotion Robe
entries.description: A memory from her childhood: a warm bed. Through the cracked window, she could see the moonlight cupping the plums in the tree as if in silver hands. The name of the goddess Selûne came to her, and never left.

entries.name: Potent Robe
entries.description: This robe is a difficult look to pull off unless one is blessed with an otherworldly charisma.

entries.name: Robe of Supreme Defences
entries.description: Long ago, the young wizard Bigby noticed his friend Tenser spending a lot of time with his robe. One of nature's pranksters, Bigby sent his dog, Bigboy, to savage the garment. The ensuing struggle between canine and nude wizard was brutal, and eventually led to Tenser designing more durable robes like this one.

entries.name: Robe of the Weave
entries.description: Earnest little Edith Cluckle was a small girl when she asked to be the great wizard Otiluke's apprentice. He scoffed at her, but was quickly abashed when Mystra herself endowed Edith with this very cloak.

entries.name: Veil of the Morning
entries.description: Crafted from celestial feathers, bottled sunlight, and ink from the pages of sacred scripture, it's a wonder the maker didn't hang cloves of garlic from this robe, so anathema is it to the undead.

entries.name: Vest of Soul Rejuvenation
entries.description: A garment worn by one of three monks who fought together against Headless Serpent, Secret Venom, a gang in the port city of Nyanzaru. This was worn by Strigga Morkoscavich, whose stances moved fluidly, flawlessly, and who defanged the Serpent one blustery night.

entries.name: Wavemother's Robe
entries.description: Tales tell of a most wondrous fish, scales resplendent, an intricate jewel that shone beneath the sea. When it died, the Wavemother gifted its hide as a robe to her most devoted follower - and demanded she drown the sailors that killed her gem-bright fish.

entries.name: Robe +1
entries.description: Artfully crafted, this robe is comfortable and elegant.

entries.name: Robe of Spell Resistance
entries.description: Handed out to all students during orientation at the arcane universities of the world. However, a bit of enchanted cloth is a meagre defence against one's classmates.

entries.name: Appreciably-Cared-For Boots
entries.description: These boots are well-maintained and clean, though their soles are thin from wear.

entries.name: Cleverly Cobbled Boots
entries.description: Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.

entries.name: Curled-Toe Boots
entries.description: Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.

entries.name: Drow Leather Boots
entries.description: Shallow, web-like lines have been tooled into these boiled leather boots.

entries.name: Jaheira's Boots
entries.description: As well travelled as any set of boots on Toril.

entries.name: Karlach's Boots
entries.description: Warmed by occasionally wiggling infernal toes.

entries.description: These boots are well-maintained and clean, though their soles are thin from wear.

entries.name: Lonely Left Boot of Elvenkind
entries.description: This is the left boot of the famous magical footwear. Unfortunately, useless without its pair.

entries.name: Tough Shoes
entries.description: Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.

entries.name: Tough-Soled Shoes
entries.description: Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.

entries.name: Boots of Aid and Comfort
entries.description: Sturdy and well-worn, these boots make a snug fit on any wearer.

entries.name: Boots of Stormy Clamour
entries.description: Peals of thunder rumble at the back of your skull with every step taken in these boots.

entries.name: Boots of Very Fast Blinking
entries.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_MistyStep">Misty Step</LSTag>, with the caveat that you will teleport leaving your clothes behind.

entries.name: Cinder Shoes
entries.description: Despite the many scorch marks, these leather boots are somehow still supple and intact.

entries.name: Hoarfrost Boots
entries.description: A smattering of tiny ice crystals have formed cleats on the soles of these hardy boots.

entries.name: Mystra's Grace
entries.description: Wearing these boots is like walking on cotton clouds.

entries.name: Tyrannical Jackboots
entries.description: Each step taken in Gortash's shoes is a reflection of the man himself: quick, sharp, and terrible.

entries.name: Varsh Ko'kuu's Boots
entries.description: Though the leather is slick with acid, the corrosive liquid doesn't seem to damage the boots - nor does it penetrate.

entries.name: Acrobat Shoes
entries.description: These flexible shoes were once owned by Audreyne Willoughs, who, in a somewhat ironic twist of fate, ran away from the circus to join her parents back home.

entries.name: Boots of Apparent Death
entries.description: Practical jokes with these boots often involve all your stuff being stolen by opportunistic cousins.

entries.name: Boots of Arcane Bolstering
entries.description: Fizzling barbs of enchantment magic crackle from the laces of these boots.

entries.name: Boots of Brilliance
entries.description: Tiny bells are sewn into the boots' cuffs. They jingle subtly with every step.

entries.name: Boots of Genial Striding
entries.description: The soles of these boots warp and shift like warm clay manipulated by an unseen sculptor's hands.

entries.name: Boots of Speed
entries.description: Featherlaced and flexible of sole, these boots have been used to round up - and outrun - many a foe.

entries.name: Boots of Uninhibited Kushigo
entries.description:
During a hilltop battle that soaked the slopes in gore, Kushigo's best friend Irishi was scalped before he could help her.

The enemy held up the bloody wig, and Kushigo fell upon one, and then another, until he had killed so many that they hung from his antlered shoulders like skewered effigies.

entries.name: Evasive Shoes
entries.description: Rogues in Waterdeep prefer these spring-loaded boots that make evading the city watch a breeze.

entries.name: Linebreaker Boots
entries.description: Lightweight fur and leather, designed to speed the wearer's charge into battle.

entries.name: Slinging Shoes
entries.description: These shoes were formerly enchanted to return to their owner's feet. This caused a great deal of trouble for owners, who, while wearing a slipper or a nice heeled number, kept being kicked in the ankles by jealous footwear.

entries.name: Spaceshunt Boots
entries.description: These boots are well-maintained and clean, though their soles are thin from wear.

entries.name: Springstep Boots
entries.description: Supple leather rebounds with every step, as if urging the wearer on.

entries.name: Swiresy Shoes
entries.description: Likely fashioned in tribute to the extremely small, high-vaulting rascal who pillaged many a hen house - Lupperdiddle Swires.

entries.name: The Watersparkers
entries.description: An enormous storm was raging the first time Yrre the Sparkstruck left the Underdark. The deep gnome's interest in lightning became at once an all-consuming obsession, and they would spend the rest of their years striving to recreate that storm's power themselves.

entries.name: Bonespike Boots
entries.description: Armour designed for the aerodynamic leaping and striking and general screaming of your standard barbarian.

entries.name: Helldusk Boots
entries.description: No ore takes better to being forged than the infernal iron of Avernus, where the archdevil Zariel presides.

entries.name: Disintegrating Night Walkers
entries.description:
Darker than a starless night, Night Walkers are made for secrecy in the honour of Shar.
This particular pair was found deep in the ruins of an Underdark fortress. Though the leather is old and the magic is fading, the boots were recently cleaned and oiled with care.

entries.name: Dreamsome Boots
entries.description: Scratched in places, scorched in others, and worn thin at the heel, these boots bear the indelible marks of experience.

entries.name: Githyanki Boots
entries.description: Lavishly decorated boots, crafted on far-away planes from stolen metals and poached rubies.

entries.name: Metallic Boots
entries.description: Scratched in places, scorched in others, and worn thin at the heel, these boots bear the indelible marks of experience.

entries.name: Boots of Elemental Momentum
entries.description: Toughened metal boots, highly insulated with heavy leather and padding for use in any and all elements.

entries.name: Boots of Striding
entries.description: The metal of these greaves is comfortably warm against your shins, as though heated by your mere presence.

entries.name: Blackguard's Greaves
entries.description: Clad on the desiccated feet of a death knight, these boots have walked a long and terrible path. They strode through the tattered remains of their owner's oath. With every heavy footstep, they have sounded pure fear into the hearts of men.

entries.name: Dark Justiciar Boots
entries.description: Scratched in places, scorched in others, and worn thin at the heel, these boots bear the indelible marks of experience.

entries.name: The Speedy Lightfeet
entries.description: It is said the Speedy Lightfeet were the first of many lightning inventions made by Yrre the Sparkstruck. The boots' old, frayed edges zap and crackle with even the slightest movement.

entries.name: Unwanted Masterwork Greaves
entries.description: These boots are stamped with the marks of a cancelled commission. Despite their discarded fate, they still hum with complex infernal arcana.

entries.name: Vital Conduit Boots
entries.description: Tenser's notes on arcane displacement were not only read by wizards - other avid readers included enterprising smiths eager to break into the magic items market.

entries.name: Boots of Psionic Movement
entries.description: When not atop their dragons, gith are not particularly air-worthy. This is probably for the best. The imposition of downward gravity tends to put most people in a mood.

entries.name: Bicorne of the Sea Beast
entries.description: A battered two-point hat that's seen the wear and tear of rebellion.

entries.name: Brimmed Hat
entries.description: This wizardly hat has a little embroidered rabbit inside its lining - the rabbit is called Snowball, and once he was lost, never to be found.

entries.name: Bycocket
entries.description: This wizardly hat has a little embroidered rabbit inside its lining - the rabbit is called Snowball, and once he was lost, never to be found.

entries.name: Cap and Bells
entries.description: Tinkling, ringing, jangling, and about as festive as a terminal diagnosis.

entries.name: Circlet
entries.description: Provides its wearer a touch of elegance but no additional protection.

entries.name: Devilfoil Mask
entries.description: Beneath a layer of dust, the mask still gleams. An innocent smile and wide, searching eyes - seeking its own kind.

entries.name: Embroidered Bycocket
entries.description: Tapered to a precise point, such as the wizardly mind when focusing on a nice big dinner, instead of all these complicated spells.

entries.name: Embroidered Hat
entries.description: Silvery wings spread over the stiff unyielding leather.

entries.name: Frumpy Hat
entries.description: There is something of the frumpy explorer who keeps lots of cats in the aesthetic of this hat.

entries.name: Hat of Eminent Giggles
entries.description: 'What do you get when you cross a fiend with a rogue? A thiefling.' - nameless comedian moments before his (perhaps timely) murder.

entries.name: Ignoble Hat
entries.description: Foppish and fluffy and built for just the right sort of dome accustomed to having it set upon the head by other people.

entries.name: Old Floppy Hat
entries.description: Whacked around more often than a clown in a tragedy.

entries.name: Rufflesome Blaggart Hat
entries.description: For the discerning raconteur, spinner of stories, and peacockish personality.

entries.name: Snakeskin Hat
entries.description: As classic a design as one can hope for. It even has the frumpy wrinkles.

entries.name: Whispering Mask
entries.description: Soft, unintelligible whispers seep from the dark wood, ringing in your ears and resounding in your skull.

entries.name: Wide-Brimmed Hat
entries.description: Very wide brimmed, really. Almost a kind of grinning sombrero.

entries.name: Wizard Hat
entries.description: This wizardly hat has a little embroidered rabbit inside its lining - the rabbit is called Snowball, and once he was lost, never to be found.

entries.name: Browbeaten Circlet
entries.description: A cornered animal will, on occasion, feel a rush of exhilarating energy, and an urge to fight. The same is true of many arcane practitioners, who do not take kindly to being menaced.

entries.name: Cap of Curing
entries.description: Putting on this hat is somehow enough to lift your spirits.

entries.name: Coldbrim Hat
entries.description: Upturning the hat and gazing into it, you get this slightly vertiginous feeling, as if you were looking into a cold, abandoned well with no discernible end.

entries.name: Dark Justiciar Mask
entries.description: Worn by Shar's most loyal zealots, the mere sight of it strikes fear in the heart of even the bravest of souls.

entries.name: Hat of Fire Acuity
entries.description: It is said some wizard hats grant the power to keep your head cool - both literally and figuratively.

entries.name: Hat of Storm Scion's Power
entries.description: Two sigils glow white where the hat brushes your temples - something is being tapped into; something distant and fearsome.

entries.name: Infernal Mask
entries.description: Power radiates from this like heat from the sun.

entries.name: Key of the Ancients
entries.description: The branches of this circlet are half-fossilised, passed down through generations of druids. Fabricated during the founding of the grove, the wreath is forever linked to its lands, the tiny rubies connected to its stones and structures, bidding them to do their bidding.

entries.name: Marksmanship Hat
entries.description: Silvery wings spread over the stiff unyielding leather.

entries.name: The Lifebringer
entries.description: 'Lightning is like magic,' Yrre the Sparkstruck once said. 'And what is magic but life itself?'

entries.name: The Shadespell Circlet
entries.description: One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. Flanked by her court, Duerra shook her head at her children. Had they really believed they could leave her?

entries.name: Wapira's Crown
entries.description: Legends say a giant elk and a druid once formed a powerful friendship. When the elk laid down his life for the druid, she crafted this helmet in honour of her beloved friend, so his beauty and compassion would live on forever.

entries.name: Warped Headband of Intellect
entries.description: This particular circlet is covered in yellow slime and has pieces of half-digested mutton stuck behind the gems.

entries.name: Cap of Wrath
entries.description: With every blow the skullcap seems to compress, narrowing the vision of the wearer.

entries.name: Circle of Bones
entries.description: A coldness clings to this macabre circlet, like the chill of a grave.

entries.name: Circlet of Mental Anguish
entries.description: Fell magic has seeped into this circlet, rejoicing at the slightest touch of despair.

entries.name: Circlet of Psionic Revenge
entries.description: You get the eerie feeling that the jewelsmith used more than alien metals to forge this circlet - something like ancient magic, or shards of a soul.

entries.name: Diadem of Arcane Synergy
entries.description: This circlet shimmers with a hundred otherworldly metals.

entries.name: Fistbreaker Helm
entries.description: 'If your foe rains down blows upon your head, turn not the other cheek, but let your pricking helm bleed the bastards dry.'

entries.name: Gibus of the Worshipful Servant
entries.description: Corroded by Sceleritas' insouciant perversion, this little gibus hat was worn by the Butler before he sank throat-deep into Bhaal's clutches. Once, it was beyond besmirchment. Once, it was lovely.

entries.name: Haste Helm
entries.description: The helm throbs when violence is near, filling the wearer with a compulsion to act.

entries.name: Hat of the Sharp Caster
entries.description: All you need now is a holster for your wand, tobacco to chew, and some sort of pack animal to ride, and you'll look like a complete and utter bingus.

entries.name: Hat of Uninhibited Kushigo
entries.description:
Coming upon a wise woman, Kushigo got drunk and grew maudlin, and told her about Irishi's scalping. She gave him some clothes - light and fine - and encouraged him to take his time to grieve. He did.

And, when he was ready, he fought again, uninhibited by steel or fellowship - for they only weighed him down.

entries.name: Scabby Pugilist Circlet
entries.description: Every adventuring party has at least one 'chaotic element'. In the case of one such party, this was the infamous Scabby, a barbarous goblin who was trained by monks.

entries.name: The Pointy Hat
entries.description: Sages over the course of ages have dealt very constructive and useful advice - however, none so sagacious as that of the wizard Otiluke, who once advised one of his students thusly: 'Never cast Speak with Dead on a loved one if there's unresolved tension there. It's never worth it. Trust me.'

entries.name: Assassin of Bhaal Cowl
entries.description: When he was killed, Bhaal's blight upon the world was not destroyed. For the many people upon whom he had sired his spawn slithered out of tainted wombs, and with their arrival Bhaal's malcontent returned with force.

entries.name: Birthright
entries.description: 'The thing that you poor sods simply cannot grasp is how effortless all this magical hootie-wootie castie-spellsie business is for me!' - A very stupid sorcerer at a wizard academy ball.

entries.name: Bonespike Helmet
entries.description: The tibia of a storm giant was ground and chiselled and reworked till it became this helm. The wearer can actually smell summer tempest clouds like maroon-dark dread while wearing the helm.

entries.name: Circlet of Hunting
entries.description: Huntresses prowling in the least hospitable woods of Toril hold one rule as cardinal: kill quickly. This is not about suffering. It's about sound, and its necessary absence.

entries.name: Helldusk Helmet
entries.description: It is said that Carixim, the fiendish titan whose flesh squirms with twenty-thousand trapped souls, forged the pieces of this armour set.

entries.name: Horns of the Berserker
entries.description: This was created by a designer and an enchanter who were going through a messy divorce at the time. As such, the armour is filled with active-aggressive rage. It also makes you feel like you've wasted the last ten years picking up after a complete tit.

entries.name: Jannath's Hat
entries.description: The corner of modern fashion that this hat currently occupies might well be called Optimistic.

entries.name: Mask of Soul Perception
entries.description: Formerly worn by Autumnal Baskin, a professional meditator turned bare-knuckle champion, who gained enlightenment via two methods. The first was giving up her addictive reliance on secluded caves and lonely mountaintops, and getting a bit more sociable. This involved many new skirts. Most of them lavender.

entries.name: Pyroquickness Hat
entries.description: Merely holding the circlet makes your skin flush, filling you with determination and righteous fury.

entries.name: Shapeshifter Hat
entries.description: 'Trust is the most fundamental part of wild-shaping. Not trusting others, but trusting yourself. Because the assumption of an animalistic form comes part and parcel with risk - that you'll like being a beast. Like it too much. You've got to trust yourself to the extent that you're comfortable courting that danger. Trust yourself the way you trust a marital partner with your heart.' - Mac Tíre, Moon Druid

entries.name: Mask of the Shapeshifter
entries.description: The magic of this mask comes from its gory provenance, and makes it perfect for the discerning actor, sleuth, or person with a mirror and time to kill.

entries.name: Angelic Plume Helmet
entries.description: Fanned out in two angelic-broad wings.

entries.name: Frayed Drow Hood
entries.description: A supple leather cowl. Its spider web embroidery is stained, and pieces of leather and thread are slowly disintegrating.

entries.name: Leather Helmet
entries.description: Layers of leather were boiled and moulded to create this rugged cap. It still smells a bit of tannins.

entries.name: Leatherstring Helmet
entries.description: The red dye infusing this helmet comes from Crimson Lake beetles, often found in the deserts of Anauroch.

entries.name: Red Carmine Mask
entries.description: Dyed as red as gladiatorial blood.

entries.name: Rich Arcanist Helmet
entries.description: Years of sweat and use have slowly darkened the leather of this cap.

entries.name: Covert Cowl
entries.description:
One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. Keeping themselves and one another safe from the nasty surprises of their home, the siblings made good progress.

At the final hurdle, they were confronted by none other than Duerra herself, and her rage was great, and they felt the candles of hope in their hearts snuff out.

entries.name: Helmet of Arcane Acuity
entries.description: Subtle magics are woven into the helmet's leather panes - for a powerful offence is sometimes still the best defence.

entries.name: Helmet of Autonomy
entries.description: The metal bolted to the helmet's forehead is engraved with a faded script. Though the words have become unintelligible, their magic remains.

entries.name: Shadow of Menzoberranzan
entries.description: You sense the shadows that envelop this drowcraft cowl, eagerly waiting to envelop you and shield you from view.

entries.name: Helmet of Grit
entries.description: At the barest touch, you feel a surge of exuberance and stamina - like you could take on anyone and anything.

entries.name: Adjustable Steel Helm
entries.description: Grated and fixable, so the wearer might gulp cool air during a fight.

entries.name: Blackplume Helm
entries.description: Flowing like a horsetail, black as night.

entries.name: Blaze Portyr's Ceremonial Flaming Fist Helm
entries.description: The brutish thuggery of the Enforcer's position is summarised in this helmet's design.
entries.wikiTitle: Blaze Portyr's Ceremonial Flaming Fist Helm

entries.name: Cracked Helm of Shar
entries.description: Battered by age and use, this once-fine helmet feels like a ghost of a bygone time.

entries.name: Fierce Golden Helm
entries.description: Aureate twists in the metal give a sheen like polluted sunlight.

entries.name: Flaming Fist Helmet
entries.description: Unadorned yet intimidating for that factor, this helm speaks to the quiet nobility and equally quiet dread the Fist inspire.

entries.name: Formidable Helmet
entries.description: Hammered from an alloy of strong mountain metals.

entries.name: Goldgloss Heraldic Helm
entries.description: Hard as golden dragonscales.

entries.name: Helmet
entries.description: Any padding that once lined this helmet has long since worn away.

entries.name: Justiciar Helmet
entries.description: Round-topped and fashioned to protect from errant arrows.

entries.name: Opulent Helmet
entries.description: Donned by the aristocracy during festivals involving a militaristic component.

entries.name: Regal Helm
entries.description: As royal as taxation.

entries.name: Reinforced Helmet
entries.description: Forged from an unfamiliar alloy. Uncommonly rugged.

entries.name: Scalpspike Helm
entries.description: Equipped with a tall spike jutting up toward the sky.

entries.name: Shar Headwear
entries.description: Shar's endless fervour seems to seep blackly from the pieces of this helm.

entries.name: Triumphal Helm
entries.description: Worn ceremonially by commanders and general at the head of parades.

entries.name: Watch's Helmet
entries.description: Any padding that once lined this helmet has long since worn away.

entries.name: Well Crated Helm
entries.description: Hammered into a fine shape by competent smiths.

entries.name: Dark Justiciar Helm
entries.description: Stamped with Shar's own sigil, this helm was worn by the Nightsinger's own crusaders. The darkness within seems deeper than night, somehow.

entries.name: Holy Lance Helm
entries.description: Brief halos of divine light wrap your head when you don and doff this helmet.

entries.name: Flawed Helldusk Helmet
entries.description: 'When I found Carixim, he turned to me, all those poor people's souls crammed into him like too many bees in a rotten hive, and he... He grinned at me. And he said: I been expecting you, boy.' - Overheard from the smith Dammon

entries.name: Steelwatcher Helmet
entries.description: 'When I found Carixim, he turned to me, with all those poor people's souls crammed into him, and he... he grinned at me. He said, "I been expecting you, boy."' - Overheard from the smith Dammon

entries.name: Dark Justiciar Helmet
