entries.description: Adorned in a fanned coronet of speartip points, its mask fixed with stiff-lipped intent, this helmet evokes a frightful, almost alien aspect that gestures to Shar. For she is strange and terrible indeed.

entries.name: Sarevok's Horned Helmet
entries.description: The last sight Sarevok witnessed as a mortal was his sibling's knife. This duel, the first between Bhaalspawn, is worshipped still by the cult of Bhaal, who now believe that no act is more sacred than fratricide between spawn before the altar of their Dread Lord.

entries.name: Helm of Balduran
entries.description: This helm, worn atop the pate of Balduran the Brave, still gleams as if with the untarnished splendour of his legacy. Baldur's Gate itself bears his name, and tales of his exploits have turned the heads and hearts of many.

entries.name: Grymskull Helm
entries.description: Once home to an inscrutable machine intelligence, Grym's skull now serves as a simple helm.

entries.name: Drow Leather Gloves
entries.description: Fabricated from lizard hides in the depths of the Underdark, these gloves were never meant to see the light of day.

entries.name: Druidic Bracers
entries.description: These supple gloves provide both flexibility and protection.

entries.name: Gloves (Equipment)
entries.description: These padded vambraces balance light protection with a dextrous expression impossible in heftier gauntlets.

entries.name: Leather Bracers
entries.description: Large, uneven stitches connect supple leather and coarse fur. Despite their lack of artistry, the bracers are soft and warm.

entries.name: Leather Gloves
entries.description: These supple gloves provide both flexibility and protection.

entries.name: Nettie's Gloves
entries.description: A small pair of supple gloves, stamped with an alternating pattern of leaves and acorns. Though well-worn and stained with earth, they are in excellent condition.

entries.name: Braindrain Gloves
entries.description: Somewhere deep in the spongy grey matter and little jiggly bits that comprise the brain, the memory of the slimy tadpole slithering over your eyeball lingers...

entries.name: Dark Justiciar Gauntlets (Uncommon)
entries.description: The grip of darkness is a fear felt by many. The grip of a Dark Justiciar's gauntlets is a sacred fear reserved for an unfortunate few.

entries.name: Fleetfingers
entries.description: Plain leather with a faint but unmistakable buzz - as if eager to put idle hands to work.

entries.name: Gloves of Archery
entries.description: Banded in dark iron, these gloves are embossed with the brass likeness of an elf against a trio of arrows in flight.

entries.name: Gloves of Baneful Striking
entries.description: The slightest movement of leather makes a dark energy seep out of the gloves.

entries.name: Gloves of Belligerent Skies
entries.description: Balling your fingers into fists while wearing these gloves causes a sonorous chime, like the fusion of a tempest and a church bell, to resound inside your skull.

entries.name: Gloves of Hail of Thorns
entries.description:
Grants wearer ability to cast Hail of Thorns.

Whoever previously owned these gloves marked each with a series of thirty superficial scrapes, six per finger. What they indicate is unclear.

entries.name: Gloves of Heroism
entries.description: Suede covers the palms of these gloves - ensuring a soft, comforting touch for anyone in need of help.

entries.name: Gloves of Power
entries.description: Blessed by Priestess Gut, these gauntlets provide additional aid to any who bear the Absolute's mark upon their flesh.

entries.name: Gloves of the Growling Underdog
entries.description: Crowded taprooms. Packed feast halls. Bustling market bazaars. Chances to be social? Sure. Chances to be violent? Absolutely.

entries.name: Gloves of Thievery
entries.description: Useful for bank vaults, locked chests, and bolted barns.

entries.name: Hellrider's Pride
entries.description: A waft of sulphur emanates from these proudly-kept gauntlets.

entries.name: Herbalist's Gloves
entries.description: The leather smells faintly of herbs, as if washed in a herbal bath.

entries.name: Ichorous Gloves
entries.description: These gloves smell like beef mince left to rot in a privy pail.

entries.name: Knock Knuckle Gloves
entries.description: In the palm of the left glove is a glossy scarlet solution that coats Thieves' Tools, making them more reliable. In the right, arcane symbols wax and wane.

entries.name: Luminous Gloves
entries.description: The pads of each fingertip shine from the fabric with a garish glow.

entries.name: Reason's Grasp
entries.description: The snug fit of these gloves resist a balled fist - as if favouring the open hand of peace.

entries.name: Thermoarcanic Gloves
entries.description: Ash dusts the gloves' fingers, darkening their seams.

entries.name: Unlucky Thief's Gloves
entries.description: Whenever the wearer steals anything, a piece of coal appears in their pocket, like a tiny, dusty condemnation.

entries.name: Winter's Clutches
entries.description: Likely these originated in Icewind Dale, where tempers run as hot as hearths, and frozen rivers trace the arm of the dale in a network of blue-white tributaries.

entries.name: Bracers of Defence
entries.description: Delicate twists of magical iron - painstakingly gilded - have been fashioned into these fortifying vambraces.

entries.name: Cerebral Citadel Gloves
entries.description: The taut violet leather is drier than snakeskin, and puckered at each knuckle with shallow mouth-shaped pits.

entries.name: Cindersnap Gloves
entries.description: 'What moves faster, a loosed crossbow bolt or a windblown cinder? Let's find out.' - Overheard during a Flaming Fist raid in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Craterflesh Gloves
entries.description: Indents on the fingertips of these gloves are ringed with tiny meteorites, lined in a shimmering purple light rather than the rich red of astral flame.

entries.name: Daredevil Gloves
entries.description: The sting of fear at the encroachment of some hulking brute is lessened by these gloves. In fact, in such moments, they send rivulets of courage coursing through you.

entries.name: Dark Displacement Gloves
entries.description: Rudimentary teleportation sigils mark the palms of these gloves, like coiled snakes in a bath of pitch.

entries.name: Dark Justiciar Gauntlets (Rare)
entries.description: The grip of darkness is a fear felt by many. The grip of a Dark Justiciar's gauntlets is a sacred fear reserved for an unfortunate few.

entries.name: Flawed Helldusk Gloves
entries.description: 'Beneath those horrible sounds of... well, let's call it what it was: torment, Beneath the tormented screams I heard this moaning sound like many people in pain, and I heard the ringing of a great hammer. Carixim's forge was close.' - Overheard from the smith Dammon

entries.name: Gloves of Battlemage's Power
entries.description: Bands of blue light snap and contract when the gloved fingertips are pressed together - evidence of the arcane polarity linking them.

entries.name: Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle
entries.description: It was through scrying and observing blazing elementals that the monks of Plumgully Temple mastered the art of fighting fire with fists, and vice versa.

entries.name: Gloves of Crushing
entries.description: Stitched into the fabric of these gloves are the words: Largest and Largesse, For The Discerning Murderer.

entries.name: Gloves of Missile Snaring
entries.description: These gloves seem to meld to your skin - supple, snug and dextrous as one could hope for.

entries.name: Gloves of the Automaton
entries.description: Llena the Many-Times-Married would use these gloves to blend in with the statues in her courtyard. This would allow her to avoid her plethora of husbands. Anything for a moment's peace.

entries.name: Gloves of the Balanced Hands
entries.description: Formerly worn by Doubleway Douglas Fairbanks, who was so ambidextrous his tears ran down the back of his neck.

entries.name: Gloves of The Duellist
entries.description: Ways of beginning a duel have varied over the years. Perhaps the most famous is the Bildumbacher Method, in which the instigator drips paint thinner onto the opponent's socks.

entries.name: Gloves of Uninhibited Kushigo
entries.description: Forsaking his infamous armour, Kushigo left Irishi's body and wandered naked, without thought or care, into the barren countryside. The land was flat and desolate under the red-gold sun, but compared to his lonely heart, it seemed alive with joy.

entries.name: Jhannyl's Gloves
entries.description: Divine runes accentuate the finger pads. While not a religious sect, the Harpers do not demand the occlusion of religion in their members.

entries.name: Martial Exertion Gloves
entries.description: 'You drop and give me thirty you sumbitch; you think a bugbear's gonna roll over and let you rub his tummy? One two three four - keep going maggot! Stronger, better, tougher!' - Any Sword Coast Drill Sergeant, Invariably

entries.name: Nimblefinger Gloves
entries.description: For the right wearer, these supple doeskin gloves offer both comfort and protection - alongside a perfectly attuned sense of where one's fingers are, and what pocket they're picking.

entries.name: Poisoner's Gloves
entries.description: While the leather is clean and well-maintained, a cold, acrid smell permeates these gloves.

entries.name: Raven Gloves
entries.description: Dark and suitably moody, these gloves are perfect for wearing while thinking about poetry.

entries.name: Seraphic Pugilist Gloves
entries.description: Apparently this is what happens to your handwear when you clock an angel in the chops.

entries.name: Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves
entries.description: Covetous of Mystra's command of the Weave, Bane the Black Hand extends his grasp, each finger comprised of ten thousand fanatics, adjuncts of his evil will.
entries.wikiTitle: Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves

entries.name: Snow-Dusted Monastery Gloves
entries.description: Cracking your knuckles in these gloves dislodges puffy drifts of snow from your fingers.

entries.name: Spellseeking Gloves
entries.description: Sorcerers operate on a first-come, first-blasted basis.

entries.name: Stalker Gloves
entries.description: It's a difficult life being a modern rogue - everyone expects the surprise attack. These gloves assist in making sure that the surprisee doesn't live long enough to decide whether they were surprised.

entries.name: Swordmaster Gloves
entries.description: The famous drow with his heart of gold, Drizzt Do'Urden, is not the pioneer of the 'twin sword style' of fighting, though he was among the best practitioners.

entries.name: The Sparkle Hands
entries.description: 'Sometimes I just want to feel that spark,' Yrre the Sparkstruck said. 'Feel the lightning course through me.'

entries.name: Thunderpalm Strikers
entries.description: Each blow landed while wearing these gloves produces the rumbling boom of a thousand demons' ravenous stomachs.

entries.name: Winkling Gloves
entries.description: Good for a winkle in cases of mechanisms, locks, or some bugger who needs killing.

entries.name: Wondrous Gloves
entries.description: A series of motivational quotes have been enthusiastically removed from the embroidery of these gloves, as if in protest.

entries.name: Abyss Beckoners
entries.description: Demons will bite their masters, slaves, comrades, and, on occasion, themselves. They bite on principle, and are functionally piranha with extra steps.

entries.name: Bhaalist Gloves
entries.description:
When the Lord of Murder, Bhaal, was rendered mortal, he knew his days were numbered. His vile machinations had gained him many enemies.

Those days ran out and Bhaal was indeed killed, not by a god, but by a man with hawkish features named Cyric.

entries.name: Bonespike Gloves
entries.description: These gloves were soaked in the marrow of a Dragon Turtle, its bones broken and their fluid drained in sloppy chunks into vats.

entries.name: Gauntlet of the Tyrant
entries.description: A tyrant's grip must be one of cool, unforgiving, and intricately realised steel. It cannot budge, cannot falter, no matter the pressure, and its fingertips must deeply pierce those who would struggle against it.

entries.name: Gauntlets of Hill Giant Strength
entries.description: Your basic hill giant is just a landslide with a digestive system.

entries.name: Gemini Gloves
entries.description: Designed by an arcane smith with half-vision. He made these gloves to make sure his spells hit their target.

entries.name: Gloves of Dexterity
entries.description: The point at which the gloves meet the wrist is form-fitting and very snug; almost a hint at the supple quickness and skill these gloves permit the wearer.

entries.name: Helldusk Gloves
entries.description: What precisely confers eternal punishment, reward, absolution? Perhaps it's not just belief in a god. Perhaps the deciding factor is whether the gods believe in you.

entries.name: Hr'a'cknir Bracers
entries.description: The planar silver cladding of these forearm bracers allows the wielder to channel the latent astral energies floating in the Weave.

entries.name: Quickspell Gloves
entries.description: These gloves were worn by the wizard Bucknard, who always maintained that speed was most important in spellcasting. This, because even if you royally bugger up the spell, you've got enough time to leg it away afterward.

entries.name: Spellmight Gloves
entries.description: Designed for the jobbing spellcaster, these gloves are well-insulated to prevent digit immolation for the somatically inept.

entries.name: Gloves of Soul Catching
entries.description: Formerly worn by Autumnal Baskin, a professional meditator turned bare-knuckle champion, who gained enlightenment via two methods. The second was getting a lot of fighting acumen. Advanced cosmic harmony is a nose. Sometimes you've got to break it a few times to get the best of things.

entries.name: Metallic Gloves
entries.description: Made from steel hammered thin, these gauntlets are a fine investment for any warrior.

entries.name: Metallic Gloves (Dream Guardian)
entries.description: Made from steel hammered thin, these gauntlets are a fine investment for any warrior.

entries.name: Blackguard's Gauntlets
entries.description: For some paladins, the iron-clad grip that an oath holds can be too much to bear. When these champions fail and falter, their hands that would guide turn cold, hard, and piercing.

entries.name: Gauntlets of Surging Accuracy
entries.description: Made from steel hammered thin, these gauntlets are a fine investment for any warrior.

entries.name: Gauntlets of the Warmaster
entries.description: Clothing doesn't tend to have much personality. That comes down to how it's worn. Yet these gloves exude a confidence, an intangible aura of expertise.

entries.name: Legacy of the Masters
entries.description: Formerly the property of the royalty of Threskel, these gauntlets impart some of the prince of Threskel's legendary skill with weapons.

entries.name: The Reviving Hands
entries.description: Stitched into the lining is the phrase: 'Yes all right, all right, stop moaning and get up.'

entries.name: Alfira's Lute
entries.description: Though the wood is old and worn, a loving hand has polished this lute to a shine. Its frets are slick with blood.

entries.name: Battered Lute
entries.description: A lute with the initials AC meticulously carved into the body.

entries.name: Dostrealt's Piccolo
entries.description: This petite flute, engraved with drow sigils, is said to have belonged to Captain Dostrealt of the spelljammer flitter 'Erevan's Clutch'.

entries.name: Falataeric Cli Lyre
entries.description: This exquisite instrument is said to come from the shop of the legendary Moonshaean bard Falataer. Fewer than twenty of his handcrafted lyres still survive.

entries.name: Flute
entries.description: It is said Diores the Charming once lured a nest of harpies to their deaths, using only a flute.

entries.name: Glimmergad's Selgaunt Fiddle
entries.description: The notorious gnomish bard Fiddlesticks Glimmergad was said to play violin tunes so sad they made bank guards weep - while his accomplices robbed the bank's vaults.

entries.name: Hand Drum
entries.description: The skin and wood of this drum has been replaced countless times. Is it even the same instrument?

entries.name: Kiam Goda's Kilat Drum
entries.description: A Lulutiun hand drum covered in sealskin, like those played at koatulit peace festivals. Kiam Goda was famous for his finger-thumb taradiddles.

entries.name: Lihala's Lute
entries.description: This lute's wooden body is worn dull from time and use, but its strings and frets are still in excellent condition.

entries.name: Lute
entries.description: Many a bard's first instrument, the lute is heard in taverns all across Faerûn.

entries.name: Lute of the Merryweather Bard
entries.description: An old lute that hums with the voices of numerous sprites and spirits.

entries.name: Spider's Lyre
entries.description: The strings of this lyre are as sharp as an assassin's blade. Pluck with care, or you may lose a fingertip.

entries.name: Stolyarof's Table Lute
entries.description: This heavy, deep-voiced instrument is of the type called a 'table lute' due to its weight. Famously, the late Ahndri Stolyarof refused to let anyone else play it.

entries.name: Violin
entries.description: A violin of cedar and burled walnut. The pegs are a little scuffed, the strings thin and worn, but the song from this instrument would still ring clear and true.

entries.name: 'Magic' Ring
entries.description: The runes encircling this ring appear to have been scratched into the metal with a rock.

entries.name: Amethyst Ring
entries.description: The silver band's cool undertones highlight this ring's vivid purple gemstone.

entries.name: Bloody Signet Ring
entries.description: The garnet embedded in this tarnished ring has been lovingly polished - the band worn thin from use.

entries.name: Bronze Ring
entries.description: A purple gemstone set in bronze, this ring has been crafted by a steady and practised hand.

entries.name: Carnelian Ring
entries.description: Considered a token of good fortune, this ring's stones are perfectly smooth.

entries.name: Copper Band
entries.description: This chunky copper ring is embedded with dark green stones.

entries.name: Copper Ring
entries.description: Inlaid with semi precious stones, this ring looks expensive - at first glance.

entries.name: Dark Ring
entries.description: With a sharpened gemstone at its centre, this ring is capable of cutting the very flesh it decorates.

entries.name: Dowry Ring
entries.description: A simple gold ring with a simple inscription: 'From Miri and Benryn'.

entries.name: Emerald Ring
entries.description: Imported in bulk from Calimshan, the gemstone set in this ring is roughly finished and marred with visible flaws.

entries.name: Gold Band
entries.description: A weighted gold ring embellished with emeralds of varying sizes. Simple, but elegant.

entries.name: Gold Ring
entries.description: A date was once engraved on the inside of this ring, but most of it has long since been worn away by time.

entries.name: Onyx Ring
entries.description: This silver band is inlaid with onyx and tempered to a sharpened point. Beautiful, but dangerous.

entries.name: Peridot Ring
entries.description: Considered sacred by some gnomes and halflings, the gem set in this ring sparkles brilliantly.

entries.name: Polished Ring
entries.description: Each purple gemstone set in this thin silver band has been polished until it gleams.

entries.name: Ring of Being Really Invisible
entries.description: This ring is missing its gem - or perhaps it's just very invisible.

entries.name: Ring of Infinite Wishes
entries.description: The exterior of this ring is roughly carved with nonsensical runes.

entries.name: Ring of Murderous Opportunity
entries.description: Formless, unsettling dread fills any normal folk that don this ring - the transpositional magic thrumming within wishes to be used by only one specific scion of murder.

entries.name: Ring of Resistance to Ants
entries.description: A glob of tree sap studded with dead ants occupies the space where this ring's stone once sat.

entries.name: Ring of the Lekinesus
entries.description: A small pebble swings from a length of fishing line tied to this copper ring.

entries.name: Ruby Ring
entries.description: The setting around the ruby is chipped and scratched, as if somebody had tried to lever the gem free.

entries.name: Silver Band
entries.description: Calishite emeralds are embedded in this heavy silver ring.

entries.name: Tarnished Ring
entries.description: A cheap ring marred by rust and a thin patina of neglect.

entries.name: Tarnished Wedding Ring
entries.description: An old wedding ring. The inside is engraved with this small devotion: Forever yours, Teffeco

entries.name: Tourmaline Ring
entries.description: A slim-fitting silver band, decorated with a mint green gemstone.

entries.name: Verdelite Ring
entries.description: Encased in delicately twisted gold, this seafoam green stone is of the tourmaline variety.

entries.name: Bracing Band
entries.description: A common ring, simple and unadorned. Though there is a certain heft to it...

entries.name: Callous Glow Ring
entries.description: A grudging gleam emits from this ring - more an indictment of light than an endorsement.

entries.name: Caustic Band
entries.description: Adjusting this unassuming ring on your finger, you hear a faint sizzle, as of pressure being released.

entries.name: Coruscation Ring
entries.description: Provocative light blooms from the engraved contours of this ring.

entries.name: Crusher's Ring
entries.description: Though caked with mud and grime, the ring smells faintly of lavender. Remarkable, considering where it's been.

entries.name: Djinni Ring
entries.description: The ring from the djinni who worked in the circus. Its magic certainly explains how the djinni was able to cheat at the wheel.

entries.name: Explorer's Ring
entries.description: A radiant and remarkably preserved ring, forged from arandur metal.

entries.name: Family Ring
entries.description: The ring's simplicity is a deceit. Its gold core is woven with iron-hard feathers from the wings of great black corvid birds, envoys of the Raven Queen.

entries.name: Firzu's Ring of Trading
entries.description: Belonged to a trader Firzu. Increases Deception <LSTag Tooltip="SkillChecks">Checks</LSTag> by 1.

entries.name: Guild Ring
entries.description: Calishite emeralds are embedded in this heavy silver ring.

entries.name: Mage's Friend
entries.description: Though carefully stowed away in a bedside chest, this ring is covered in dust and cobwebs.

entries.name: Poisoner's Ring
entries.description: Strange, green fumes seep from the ring's emerald.

entries.name: Ring of Absolute Force
entries.description: Darkness seems to blossom from this ring, heightened by the menacing glare of the Absolute's symbol, though for the Branded this symbol holds the promise of power.

entries.name: Ring of Colour Spray
entries.description: When the light hits it just so, the centre jewel shimmers with every colour of the rainbow.

entries.name: Ring of Elemental Infusion
entries.description: The mysterious gem set in this ring seems to change hues whenever you aren't looking.

entries.name: Ring of Flinging
entries.description: Organisations like the Harpers do not relegate their activities to head-to-head combat - many a moonlit chase with an evildoer has been resolved with a loose roof tile and a decent throwing arm.

entries.name: Ring of Geniality
entries.description: Glibness is not only in the tongue, but in the body. Gesture is powerful. Think of how many words of comfort can be stored and saved, when a hug will do just as sweetly.

entries.name: Ring of Jumping
entries.description: The ring is scuffed and twisted out of shape, as if worn by big stony fingers. The owner of those fingers has carved 'Karthol' into the warped metal in a fit of affection or possessiveness.

entries.name: Ring of Mental Inhibition
entries.description: The patterns in the ring's swirling metal make your head spin whenever you look at them for too long.

entries.name: Ring of Salving
entries.description: A hymn to Eilistraee is inscribed along the inside of this ring, which is surprisingly heavy when worn.

entries.name: Ring of Self Immolation
entries.description: Every one of the three gems in this ring is searing hot - enough to burn yourself with the slightest brush of your fingers.

entries.name: Ring of Shadows
entries.description: For some, darkness is wielded like a black opal stud embedded in a signet ring - fashioned to a sharp and unforgiving point.

entries.name: Ring of Spiteful Thunder
entries.description: When you slip this ring on your hand and flex your fingers, a boom of discontented thunder grumbles in the air around you.

entries.name: Seemingly Gleaming Ring
entries.description: The garnet at the centrepiece of this ring is like an unblinking, malevolent eye.

entries.name: Shadow Blade Ring
entries.description: One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. Long ago in a foreboding realm called Hammergrim, Deep Duerra, daughter of the dour god Laduguer, sired a great many heirs to her twisted corundum throne.

entries.name: Shadow-Cloaked Ring
entries.description: Even in the brightest light, this ring never gleams, as if perpetually wrapped in shadow, hungry for the dark.

entries.name: Shapeshifter's Boon Ring
entries.description: 'I'm a talented shapeshifter, too. I can shapeshift a thin body into a fat body. All I need is a steady supply of mince pies and mulled wine.' - Overheard in a tavern in Daggerford

entries.name: Smuggler's Ring
entries.description: A subtle accessory prized by purveyors of the covert arts.

entries.name: Snowburst Ring
entries.description: A series of names have been scratched out, one after the other, on the inside of the ring. The last word, untouched, is not a name. It simply reads: Mine.

entries.name: Spurred Band
entries.description: Tiny barbs prick the wearer when they're injured, as if urging flight from danger.

entries.name: Strange Conduit Ring
entries.description: In his speculative writing on arcane displacement, the wizard Tenser notes the possibility for keenly focused minds to maintain spells, and even unlock hidden potential while doing so.

entries.name: Sunwalker's Gift
entries.description: The ring's arcane jewel parts all but the darkest of shadows.

entries.name: The Sparkswall
entries.description: When the inventor Yrre met the cleric Lenore, sparks flew. Apart, they were in a rut, but together, they inspired each other to push the boundaries of innovation and invention. This ring is just one of their many scientific triumphs.

entries.name: The Whispering Promise
entries.description: A soft, soothing voice floats from this ring, reciting a prayer over and over.

entries.name: After Death Do Us Part
entries.description: Love is the last cruel leaf to fall in an autumn wide with sorrow.

entries.name: Band of the Mystic Scoundrel
entries.description: What better way to disguise one's transgressions than a quickly positioned phantasm after the deed is done?

entries.name: Fetish of Callarduran Smoothhands
entries.description: The smooth, six-pointed star on this ring is beset with small Underdark gemstones, as befits a talisman of the god of mining and patron of deep gnomes.

entries.name: Keepsake Ring
entries.description: Created by a conglomerate of druids one moonlit night when all the stirring violins of insect, elms, and whispering winds consorted, and when wild beasts in need of taming prowled unseen.

entries.name: Ring of Arcane Synergy
entries.description: The sharp silver corners of this ring almost cut into the stone set in its centre - a gem of which you've never seen the like before.

entries.name: Ring of Blink
entries.description: Fashioned by the wizard Bigby in honour of his faithful hound Bigboy, who could use teleportation to fetch, snare errant cats, and generally harass postmen.

entries.name: Ring of Exalted Marrow
entries.description: Gazing through this ring, you find that there is no other side, only a small sucking blackness that defies explanation.

entries.name: Ring of Free Action
entries.description: The heart of the gem seems to flow like liquid - yet it contains neither quicksilver nor mercury.

entries.name: Ring of Mind-Shielding
entries.description: This ring is forged from a smooth, alien metal, capped with eyes of emerald that watch the world unblinking.

entries.name: Ring of Poison Resistance
entries.description: The ring's emerald glows a deep, deadly green.

entries.name: Ring of Protection
entries.description: Elegant motifs of warding - shields, targes, bucklers, and buffers - are faintly impressed into the metal round of the ring.

entries.name: Ring of Truthfulness
entries.description: 'Fib now, and forever hold your teeth.' - Folk saying

entries.name: Ring of Twilight
entries.description: Dark smoke swirls in the ring's onyx, protecting something within.

entries.name: Risky Ring
entries.description: Life is just a series of risks taken while blindfolded.

entries.name: Shifting Corpus Ring
entries.description: A shiny, deceptively simple band, designed to look like those worn by battlefield scouts and city pickpockets alike.

entries.name: Till Death Do Us Part
entries.description: Love is the sweetest bird that might migrate to the charming country of your heart.

entries.name: True Love's Caress
entries.description: The most pragmatic and courageous lover ever known was, of course, Sorcha MacTire, for whom the popular hairstyle is named, and for whom many an extremely soppy poem has been written (most of them comparing her to geography).

entries.name: True Love's Embrace
entries.description: The scholar of love, Joel Firris Baldidims, writes that the next time he reads about a woman compared to a flower (or any feature of geography for that matter) he's going to start knocking on poets' doors with a sledgehammer.

entries.name: Burnished Ring
entries.description: A paralysing eyestalk harvested from a beholder was boiled in a broth, and poured down the throat of a dwarven ringsmith. Not one fortnight thence, he crafted this ring.

entries.name: Crypt Lord Ring
entries.description: Slipping one's finger through this ring fills the senses with the waft of tombs, the urine-yellow smell of old bandages, images of dead spiders curled into husks, and the sensation of hot, slobbering breath at the nape of one's neck.

entries.name: Killer's Sweetheart
entries.description: Though the ring is highly polished, darkened slivers of blood still cling to small scrapes and corners.

entries.name: Orphic Ring
entries.description: When light catches this ring at the right angle, it pulses with a dizzying, intoxicating glow befitting the jewellery of the Prince of the Comet.

entries.name: Ring of Evasion
entries.description: Decorated with a hummingbird wrought of jade and sapphire, this ring evokes the sheer wonderful quickness of that animal.

entries.name: Ring of Feywild Sparks
entries.description: This otherwise unassuming ring ties a spellcaster indelibly to the sporadic arcana of the Faerie realm.

entries.name: Ring of Regeneration
entries.description: This ring is, in effect, a tiny field medic that won't charge you 70 gold pieces for a fifteen-minute consultation.

entries.name: Guiding Light
entries.description: Used by the previous owner to access both the Underdark's darkest corners and her own basement, this ring seems to reflect light where there should be none.

entries.name: Szarr Family Ring
entries.description: This ring carries the symbol of the Szarr family and has an inscription in some crusty old language.

entries.name: A Sparking Promise
entries.description: A year into their union, Lenore, cleric of Mystra, gifted the gnome inventor Yrre an invention of her own devising - a ring that held a spell of sparks. Eventually, the touch of Lenore's hand faded to a glinting memory, but the ring's tingling grip remained resolute.

entries.name: Absolute's Smite
entries.description: This ring coaxes anyone branded by the Absolute. Their fingers veritably itch to slip it on.

entries.name: Hag's Ring
entries.description: Grimy, discoloured, and revoltingly ugly. Auntie Ethel must have made it herself. Surprisingly, you feel no disgust. Instead it fills you with a longing, as if it's calling out for its like.

entries.name: Ring of Beguiling
entries.description: Whispers in the Deep Speech of the Underdark insinuate themselves into the mind of whoever so much as brushes against the burnished metal of this ring.

entries.name: Ring of Crabsight
entries.description: Mud cakes the tiny letters of an inscription - 'A Cursed Sight Doth Dwell Beneath'.

entries.name: Ring of Fire
entries.description: A burning heat radiates from this ring, warming the wearer from head to toe.

entries.name: Ring of Restorative Gravity
entries.description: A hymn to Eilistraee is inscribed along the inside of this ring, which is surprisingly heavy when worn.

entries.name: Sandthief's Ring
entries.description: Multiple amethysts fresh off the boat from Chult line this ring's band.

entries.name: Broken Shield
entries.description: This old splintered shield is no stronger than a child's toy.

entries.name: Fossilised Shell
entries.description: Sticky, rope-like seaweed is wrapped around this oversized shell, allowing it to be fashioned as a shield.

entries.name: Iron-Banded Shield
entries.description: This thick oak shield is reinforced with a frame of rough-hammered iron.

entries.name: Metal Shield
entries.description: Though the metal is only of moderate quality, a proud, flaming fist decorates the front of this shield.

entries.name: Organic Shield
entries.description: These three small stumps make for a peculiar but effective shield.

entries.name: Rusty Studded Shield
entries.description: Good for defending from stray flatulence, but that's about it.

entries.name: Scrapwood Shield
entries.description: A hand-like symbol is artlessly painted on the front of this wood shield.

entries.name: Shield (item)
entries.description: Pristine and unmarred, this shield still smells faintly of varnish.

entries.name: Spiked Shield
entries.description: Thick spikes jut from this repurposed wooden tabletop.

entries.name: Studded Shield
entries.description: The side of this shield has a slightly lighter colour - as if part of it was cut away and replaced.

entries.name: Training Shield
entries.description: A light, wooden shield, full of dents and cuts.

entries.name: Wooden Shield
entries.description: Despite the chips and dents, you can still make out the faded painting of a flower on the face of this shield.

entries.name: Absolute's Warboard
entries.description: Blood is smeared across the shield's face, exalting wielders who bear the Absolute's mark.

entries.name: Gloomstrand Shield
entries.description: Supposedly fashioned around a lock of hair stolen from the head of the Prince of Gloomwrought, shields of this ilk gladly welcome the dark.

entries.name: Glowing Shield
entries.description: Soft, loving whispers emanate from this shield. Though barely audible and spoken in some long-forgotten language, they make you feel safe.

entries.name: Ironvine Shield
entries.description: Each whorl and groove and worm-curled twist of this shield evokes a tangle of bog-stuck trees in rain-swollen vines.

entries.name: Safeguard Shield
entries.description: Magic got caught in this heirloom by being exposed to too many wizard family dinners.

entries.name: The Real Sparky Sparkswall
entries.description: 'Is there anything as beautiful as lightning striking all around you?' Yrre the Sparkstruck said, letting lightning strike all around them.

entries.name: Watcher's Shield
entries.description: To hold this shield is to be vigilant in duty, wary of danger, and mindful in crisis.

entries.name: Wood Woad Shield
entries.description: 'And with her arm the dryad linked a man who had once been her lover, and once of flesh and bone. Now his flesh was bark, and his bone heartwood. In his eyes a feverish love still blazed like a thousand fireflies in a spring meadow.'

entries.name: Absolute's Protector
entries.description: The Absolute's power radiates from this shield, invisible waves of energy beckoning to the Branded.

entries.name: Adamantine Shield
entries.description: The dull shine of the adamantine promises this shield could take a thousand beatings - and still look as good as new.

entries.name: Iron-Banded Shield +1
entries.description: This thick oak shield is reinforced with a frame of rough-hammered iron.

entries.name: Justiciar's Greatshield
entries.description: It's never the shield that kills you - but hearing your frantic steel thudding uselessly against this reinforced oak in the darkness is a good sign the end is near.

entries.name: Ketheric's Shield
entries.description: In the theatre of dreams, Ketheric killed his wife every night. That wasn't how things happened... but always upon waking, he would glare into the dark, long-faced and solemn, and he would think: 'I keep you alive with my memories, beloved. I kill you with what I've become.'

entries.name: Sentinel Shield
entries.description: Clever enchantments dance between the grooves of this shield, which emanates a magic of heightened awareness.

entries.name: Shield +1
entries.description: Though dented in many places, this shield shines like new.

entries.name: Shield of Scorching Reprisal
entries.description: Local rumour claims a devil's tear gives these city militia shields their fire - much to the chagrin of the barracks blacksmith.

entries.name: Shield of Shielding
entries.description: Named in the style of Extremely Unimaginative Jimmy, the geographer and interior decorator who named the 'waterfall' and the 'fireplace'.

entries.name: Studded Shield +1
entries.description: Small pockets of rust are starting to eat away at a few of the studs.

entries.name: Abdel's Trusted Shield
entries.description: Attached to this shield is a faded note. 'G, I've found the best defence against an arrow is to be the one behind the bow - but this shield also does the trick in a pinch. Yours, AA'

entries.name: Shield of Devotion
entries.description: Any tales about the Paladins of Velen are so ancient as to be almost certainly hearsay. Irrefutable, however, is the powerful blessing they left on this ancient shield, which inspires heart-fluttering bravery to this day.

entries.name: Shield of the Undevout
entries.description: Where once this shield would protect the rallying forces of good - now it pushes them back, crushing them against their allies until they pop.

entries.name: Swires' Sledboard
entries.description: A gnomish adventurer once used this to outpace his enemies down a slope.

entries.name: Astarion's Underwear
entries.description: Embroidered into the cloth: 'If you're reading this, you managed to bed or behead me. Either way, you got lucky.'

entries.name: Halsin's Underwear
entries.description: Why does it smell like a herb garden?

entries.name: Jaheira's Underwear
entries.description: Embroidered with little ducks.

entries.name: Karlach's Underwear
entries.description: How do these not burn off?

entries.name: Lae'zel's Underwear
entries.description: Built for function rather than fun.

entries.name: Minthara's Underwear
entries.description: Woven with as much toughened cobweb as cloth.

entries.name: Netherese Briefs
entries.description: Energy crackles around these. Gale wouldn't... Surely he didn't enchant his...

entries.name: Periwinkle Undergarments
entries.description: This charming piece's hue reminds of the flower often sprouting from anonymous graves.

entries.name: Shadowheart's Underwear
entries.description: If pants could brood...

entries.name: Wyll's Underwear
entries.description: Long may these gird the Blade of Frontiers.

entries.name: Artificial Leech
entries.description: Though blood and age have rusted the mechanism, a good twist can still make the blades on this bloodletting device spin.

entries.name: Battle-Worn Blade
entries.description: A fine but well-used sword. It seemed to have once belonged to a holy order, but the indication of rank and patron deity at the hilt have recently been filed down.

entries.name: Battleaxe
entries.description: Tiny scratches mar the metal - a testament of someone sharpening this axe over and over.

entries.name: Bonesaw
entries.description: The saw's teeth are blunt and rusted, it's beautiful metalwork barely visible beneath a layer of black, coagulated blood.

entries.name: BOOOAL's Arms
entries.description: The cut-off pincer of some Underdark crustacean seems to magically adhere to a bone shaft, creating a make-shift javelin.

entries.name: Broken Pike
entries.description: The pike's tip is battered and bent, fit for neither soldier nor scoundrel.

entries.name: Cemetery-Blue Torch
entries.description: A deep oily smell wafts from this crude tree branch.

entries.name: Cleaver
entries.description: Stained with blood and gore, the handle has almost rusted through.

entries.name: Club
entries.description: A long, deep crack runs through the side of the wood, filled with crusted blood.

entries.name: Crude Mace
entries.description: Rotten rags and mud are the only things keeping this mace together.

entries.name: Cultist Brand
entries.description: Wrought from a single piece of twisted iron. Bits of charred flesh cling to the strange symbol shaped at the end.

entries.name: Drunk-Purple Torch
entries.description: A deep oily smell wafts from this crude tree branch.

entries.name: False Spear of the Night
entries.description: While the handle is well made, the metal point is pitted with rust, and brittle as frozen underwear in the hands of a stone giant.

entries.name: Flail of Myrkul
entries.description: A browning piece of brain sticks stubbornly to one of the spikes.

entries.name: Flame Blade (weapon)
entries.description: An ethereal scimitar made of living fire.

entries.name: Githyanki Longsword
entries.description: Every tip and edge on this elaborate sword is sharpened to a deadly perfection.

entries.name: Githyanki Shortsword
entries.description: Despite its engravings, this lightweight sword is perfectly balanced - a flawless killing implement.

entries.name: Glaive
entries.description: Simple but sharp. The shaft of this glaive is worn smooth with use.

entries.name: Goblin Scimitar
entries.description: A cruel and crude blade forged en masse by goblin hordes.

entries.name: Greataxe
entries.description: The rectangular engravings on this axe's wooden handle have been nearly scratched away by armoured hands.

entries.name: Greatsword
entries.description: This sword's guard, held haphazardly in place by thin rope, wobbles slightly when swung.

entries.name: Greatsword +1 (Common)
entries.description: A rune etched into the base of this expertly-forged sword identifies its dwarven blacksmith.

entries.name: Halberd
entries.description: Part of the spike affixed to the top of this halberd has snapped off, leaving a cruel barb.

entries.name: King's Knife
entries.description: Crudely forged with mismatched components, nearly rusted through, and plenty sharp.

entries.name: Lantern
entries.description: A deep oily smell wafts from this crude tree branch.

entries.name: Mace
entries.description: A simple but effective mace, cast en masse by human blacksmiths.

entries.name: Makeshift Spear
entries.description: Dirt and rust mar the edges of this spear, but it is deadly all the same.

entries.name: Maul
entries.description: Hammers like this are used in many dwarven competitions, testing who can throw them the farthest while enduring the most ale.

entries.name: Needle of the Outlaw Rogue
entries.description: A dagger that thrums with desire - a longing for vengeance.

entries.name: Pactbound Battleaxe
entries.description: A summonable battleaxe granted by a warlock's patron. Its surface crackles with interdimensional energy.

entries.name: Pactbound Glaive
entries.description: A summonable glaive granted by a warlock's patron. Its surface crackles with interdimensional energy.

entries.name: Pactbound Greatsword
entries.description: A summonable greatsword granted by a warlock's patron. Its surface crackles with interdimensional energy.

entries.name: Pactbound Maul
entries.description: A summonable maul granted by a warlock's patron. Its surface crackles with interdimensional energy.

entries.name: Pactbound Rapier
entries.description: A summonable rapier granted by a warlock's patron. Its surface crackles with interdimensional energy.

entries.name: Pactbound Trident
entries.description: A summonable trident granted by a warlock's patron. Its surface crackles with interdimensional energy.

entries.name: Pactbound Warhammer
entries.description: A summonable warhammer granted by a warlock's patron. Its surface crackles with interdimensional energy.

entries.name: Pickaxe
entries.description: A plain tool, covered almost entirely in coppery rust.

entries.name: Pitchfork
entries.description: A farming tool crafted from mismatched branches, held together by fraying twine.

entries.name: Plague-Green Torch
entries.description: A deep oily smell wafts from this crude tree branch.

entries.name: Polished Dagger
entries.description: The dagger's leather grip is stamped with a stag's head - the symbol of the Emerald Enclave.

entries.name: Practice Sword
entries.description: Though carefully coated in a thick layer of varnish, the edges of the wooden sword are already starting to chip away.

entries.name: Ritual Staff
entries.description: Streaks of tendon and sinew cling to the animal skull lashed atop of this wooden staff.

entries.name: Rusted Blade
entries.description: Ages of rust have eaten away at this blood-soaked knife.

entries.name: Rusty Dagger
entries.description: Useful for writing your name in damp slush and not much else.

entries.name: Rusty Glaive
entries.description: Ruined with decay.

entries.name: Rusty Greatsword
entries.description: Large and crusted with rust, and about as useful as a drink of water to a drowning man.

entries.name: Rusty Halberd
entries.description: A dilapidated old shanker of a weapon.

entries.name: Rusty Longsword
entries.description: Mottled with rust, this longsword is a hideous excuse for a blade.

entries.name: Rusty Mace
entries.description: The head of this mace is a scratchboard of peeling orange rust.

entries.name: Rusty Maul
entries.description: Rust has eaten clean-through the heavy head of this maul.

entries.name: Rusty Morningstar
entries.description: The heavy head of this steel star is malefic with rust.

entries.name: Rusty Pike
entries.description: Truly the amount of rust accumulated on this pike is a lesson in how not to keep your weapons.

entries.name: Rusty Scimitar
entries.description: Only an utter gibbon would consider swinging this in combat.

entries.name: Rusty Sickle
entries.description: Not even useful in the herbalist trade.

entries.name: Rusty Spear
entries.description: While the handle is well made, the metal point is pitted with rust, and brittle as frozen underwear in the hands of a stone giant.

entries.name: Rusty Trident
entries.description: Rust pits each of this trident's prongs.

entries.name: Scalpel
entries.description: Scalpel

entries.name: Scimitar (Akabi)
entries.description: This human-made scimitar falls far short of replicating the quality of the drow style it clearly imitates.

entries.name: Shortsword
entries.description: A common and effective sword, carried by adventurers, thieves, and watchmen alike.

entries.name: Syringe
entries.description: The yellowish-green ooze dried to the syringe's long needle gives you the distinct impression that this medical device was never used to heal anyone.

entries.name: Torch
entries.description: A deep oily smell wafts from this crude tree branch.

entries.name: Trepan
entries.description: Though blood and age have rusted the mechanism, a good twist can still make the blades on this bloodletting device spin.

entries.name: Twisting Branch
entries.description: A thick, gnarled branch, grown into a club-like shape.

entries.name: War Pick
entries.description: A pickaxe modified to pierce flesh and armour rather than stone.

entries.name: Whipping Cane
entries.description: A cane designed to inflict a sharp and agonising pain with every blow.

entries.name: Broken Club
entries.description: The tip of this club has snapped off, its wood rotten to the core.

entries.name: Chessa's Practice Sword
entries.description: A wooden sword coated in a thick layer of varnish. Well-loved, its handle is engraved with the name "Chessa".

entries.name: Dad's Axe
entries.description: An old woodcutter's axe, infused with a shadow's bleak curse.

entries.name: Dagger
entries.description: A rogue's favourite toy.

entries.name: Flail
entries.description: The head of this flail is shiny and new, its wooden shaft still coarse and unmarked by blood.

entries.name: Greatclub
entries.description: Traces of dried viscera ring many of the iron spikes embedded in this oak club.

entries.name: Handaxe
entries.description: A straightforward hatchet, dulled slightly from chopping wood - or bones.

entries.name: Harper Blade
entries.description: A common and effective sword, carried by adventurers, thieves, and watchmen alike.

entries.name: Javelin
entries.description: A rusted fishing harpoon, repurposed as a weapon.

entries.name: Kass' Practice Sword
entries.description: A wooden sword coated in a thick layer of varnish. Clumsy and covered in crude painted handprints like blood, the sword is engraved with the name 'Kass'.

entries.name: Light Hammer
entries.description: A blacksmith's pride and joy, repurposed for combat. Its steel head is tarnished from years in the forge.

entries.name: Longsword
entries.description: A common sword, passed between hands both fresh and battle-scarred.

entries.name: Morningstar
entries.description: More of this morningstar's iron spikes are bent than not.

entries.name: Pactbound Flail
entries.description: A summonable flail granted by a warlock's patron. Its surface crackles with interdimensional energy.

entries.name: Pactbound Sickle
entries.description: A summonable sickle granted by a warlock's patron. Its surface crackles with interdimensional energy.

entries.name: Pike
entries.description: This pike's broad steel head has been repeatedly bent and hammered back into its original shape.

entries.name: Poo-Scraper
entries.description: Fecund and revolting, the Abyss is not the worst place this has been.

entries.name: Quarterstaff
entries.description: Someone has carved twenty-seven small lines into the hard wood.

entries.name: Rapier
entries.description: A slender but deadly sword, favoured by Waterdhavian nobility.

entries.name: Rusty Flail
entries.description: A pitiful excuse for a flail, pitted with rust.

entries.name: Rusty Light Hammer
entries.description: Pockmarked in rust like flaking red tears, this light hammer is good as a doorstop, and not much else.

entries.name: Sahuagin Spear
entries.description: Forged by dwarven hands, and prized by all warriors who wish to keep their foe at a distance.

entries.name: Salami
entries.description: A boon to any adventurer - delicious, long-lasting, and hard enough to smack an adversary.

entries.name: Scimitar
entries.description: This human-made scimitar falls far short of replicating the quality of the drow style it clearly imitates.

entries.name: Sickle
entries.description: A farming tool with a wicked edge, spilling blood and grain with equal ease.

entries.name: Sickle (Redcap)
entries.description: A farming tool with a wicked edge, spilling blood and grain with equal ease.

entries.name: Spear
entries.description: An aged spear, its steel head nicked by the blows of a dozen battles.

entries.name: Staff
entries.description: Gnarled, finger-like roots encase the gemstone at the top of this staff.

entries.name: Staff of the Moonmaiden
entries.description: This staff's blue inlays and moon-shaped ornamentation indicate its use among Selûne's clergy.

entries.name: Trident
entries.description: It is said tridents were brought to the surface when Umberlee threw a Triton prince who scorned her onto Faerûn's shores.

entries.name: Warhammer
entries.description: This hammer's noticeable lack of upkeep hardly matters, given its heft.

entries.name: Argument Solver
entries.description: Few things solve a disagreement faster than displaying a greatclub. And this one reeks, too.

entries.name: Artificial Leech (+1)
entries.description: Though blood and age have rusted the mechanism, a good twist can still make the blades on this bloodletting device spin.

entries.name: Assassin's Shortsword
entries.description: Quiet is the air around this sword, and quiet are the steps of the one who wields it.

entries.name: Assassin's Touch
entries.description: This long, slender blade fits perfectly between the ribs of any unsuspecting victim.

entries.name: Battleaxe +1
entries.description: The intricate engravings on this axe's blade and handle make plain the skill of its smith.

entries.name: Bonesaw (+1)
entries.description: The saw's teeth are blunt and rusted, it's beautiful metalwork barely visible beneath a layer of black, coagulated blood.

entries.name: Ceremonial Battleaxe
entries.description: The intricate engravings on this axe's blade and handle make plain the skill of its smith.

entries.name: Ceremonial Longsword
entries.description: A complex filigree wraps around the base of this blade - the runes on the side suggesting it is not merely decorative.

entries.name: Ceremonial Mace
entries.description: The leather handle of this mace smells badly of rotting blood.

entries.name: Ceremonial Warhammer
entries.description: Following tradition, this hammer's faces were forged with grooves that sealed in the blood of its first kill.

entries.name: Club +1
entries.description: A long, deep crack runs through the side of the wood, filled with crusted blood.

entries.name: Club of Hill Giant Strength
entries.description: Though this rotting chair leg doesn't look like much, every splinter vibrates with barely-contained power.

entries.name: Comeback Handaxe
entries.description: This loyal axe always returns to its owner after being thrown. However, it has no eyes and therefore dreadful aim, inevitably returning to its thrower blade-end-first.

entries.name: Corellon's Grace
entries.description: This light, flexible staff is of elven make, marked with mithral sigils that channel magic in the blink of an eye.

entries.name: Dagger +1
entries.description: This dagger's handle is smooth and light, its jagged blade sharpened into a thin, cruel edge.

entries.name: Deep Delver
entries.description: Countless hands have smoothened the haft and sharpened the blade. This is an ancestral weapon - perhaps dating back to the ancient digs that sundered the duergar from their dwarf-kin.

entries.name: Doom Hammer
entries.description: Bringer of that which it is.

entries.name: Dragon's Grasp
entries.description: Somehow, this axe perpetually feels warm to the touch.

entries.name: Everburn Blade
entries.description: Silent flames surge the length of the blade as soon as it clears the scabbard.

entries.name: Exterminator's Axe
entries.description: The intricate engravings on this axe's blade and handle make plain the skill of its smith.

entries.name: Faithbreaker
entries.description: A hand-like brand stamped into the leather handle obscures the notches that would normally signify a hobgoblin's rank.

entries.name: Flail +1
entries.description: A browning piece of brain sticks stubbornly to one of the spikes.

entries.name: Githyanki Greatsword
entries.description: Though heavily decorated and inlaid with rubies, the blade's sharp edge suggests its use isn't merely ornamental.

entries.name: Githyanki Greatsword (Psionic)
entries.description: Though heavily decorated and inlaid with rubies, the blade's sharp edge suggests its use isn't merely ornamental.

entries.name: Githyanki Longsword (+1)
entries.description: Every tip and edge on this elaborate sword is sharpened to a deadly perfection.

entries.name: Githyanki Shortsword (+1)
entries.description: Despite its engravings, this lightweight sword is perfectly balanced - a flawless killing implement.

entries.name: Glaive +1
entries.description: Fashioned by expert elven hands to be both deadly and beautiful.

entries.name: Greataxe +1
entries.description: A small prayer decorates the hilt of this axe. It resonates in your head when you touch it.

entries.name: Greatclub +1
entries.description: Without the wrapped leather grip, the weight of the slab of iron at the end of this greatclub would send it flying with a single swing.

entries.name: Greatsword +1
entries.description: The thick leather straps wrapped around the base of the blade creak under a solid grip.

entries.name: Halberd +1
entries.description: This halberd's spike is black with ash that cannot be washed away.

entries.name: Hamarhraft
entries.description: The Dwarven grammar is garbled, but the weapon's name suggests something about the importance of first impressions.

entries.name: Handaxe +1
entries.description: This axe's hooked blade is crafted to cleave flesh and bone.

entries.name: Hoppy
entries.description: Not the most elegant of weapons, the warpick's cumbersome weight certainly allows it to be deadly in combat, when wielded by a strong arm. Inexplicably, this one has a small rabbit carved into the handle.

entries.name: Hunter's Dagger
entries.description: Prey often thinks it has escaped the worst of the predator's bloodthirst and fury - but there are always further torments to be meted out.

entries.name: Infernal Mace (Uncommon)
entries.description: Precise infernal runes are woven into this weapon's filigree, implying a creator well-versed in hellish arcana.

entries.name: Intransigent Warhammer
entries.description: The elegant design of this hammer belies its brutal, crushing power. This weapon does not give ground.

entries.name: Ironwood Club
entries.description: Fashioned from the hard, unforgiving trunk of an oak, this club still retains the perfume of the forest.

entries.name: Javelin +1
entries.description: The worn leather strap at the end of this javelin loops around the wrist to let it be thrown with devastating force.

entries.name: Katana
entries.description: The hilt of this slender sword is wrapped with soft, black silk - the dark colour hiding any possible stains.

entries.name: Kurwin's Cauteriser
entries.description: Mortician Kurwin was known to use his trusty Cauteriser on all sorts of interesting subjects. At first these were cadavers, then people who wouldn't be missed, and it was only after he targeted a well-liked tavern owner that he was ratted out to the law.

entries.name: Light of Creation
entries.description: Small lodestones have been inserted along the halberd's shaft, a strange blue current running through them.

entries.name: Lightning Jabber
entries.description: A makeshift spear fashioned from a giant crab's claw and the charged imagination of kuo-toa fishfolk.

entries.name: Longsword +1
entries.description: A complex filigree wraps around the base of this blade - the runes on the side suggesting it is not merely decorative.

entries.name: Loviatar's Scourge
entries.description: More club than scourge, this weapon has a serrated edge made for drawing long, shallow cuts.

entries.name: Mace +1
entries.description: The leather handle of this mace smells badly of rotting blood.

entries.name: Magical Pike
entries.description: The base of this polearm's shaft is splintered, likely having borne the weight of a rider plucked from their mount.

entries.name: Maul +1
entries.description: A weapon of dwarven make: elegant, but strong enough to last several human lifetimes.

entries.name: Melf's First Staff
entries.description: In spite of (or perhaps because of) his suspiciously amusing name, the wizard Melf was actually quite a talented spellcaster and innovator in the field of the arcane. He even led an order called the Knights of Luna.

entries.name: Merregon Halberd
entries.description: Sharp teeth grow out of the halberd's dark metal - if it is indeed metal at all.

entries.name: Morningstar +1
entries.description: It's said that one warrior with a morningstar is worth seventeen with a sword - one for each of the weapon's spikes.

entries.name: Murderous Cut
entries.description: Odd to think that dark gods like Bhaal were once mortal. One wonders if they ever thumbed a wagon ride, thought about the weather, or ate flavoured yoghurt.

entries.name: Myrkulite Scourge
entries.description: A browning piece of brain sticks stubbornly to one of the spikes.

entries.name: Nature's Snare
entries.description: Thread-like vines wriggle along this wooden staff.

entries.name: Pike +1
entries.description: The base of this polearm's shaft is splintered, likely having borne the weight of a rider plucked from their mount.

entries.name: Quarterstaff +1
entries.description: A polished wooden staff, embellished with knobs and steel for both function and design.

entries.name: Render of Mind and Body
entries.description: The best offence is a struck cognisance.

entries.name: Returning Pike
entries.description: A 'Crazy Wilbur' is a technique invented by the dwarvish Ticklebeard Clan. It involves getting your larger enemies to swallow your weapon, then calling it back to you - as messily as possible.

entries.name: Ritual Axe
entries.description: Though shiny and recently polished, dried blood still fills the deepest crevices of this axe.

entries.name: Ritual Dagger of Shar
entries.description: The blade is sharp, and the handle firm. Yet death exudes from this dagger as it might from a fresh corpse.

entries.name: Scimitar +1
entries.description: The phases of the moon are carved into the hilt of this scimitar, betraying a druid's careful hand.

entries.name: Shadow Blade (weapon)
entries.description: Umbral claws sweep through the long slender facets of the blade.

entries.name: Shining Staver-of-Skulls
entries.description: Look no further than Scyllua Darkhope - fallen paladin and champion of Bane - to see how the tools of good can be turned to evil purpose.

entries.name: Shortsword +1
entries.description: A standard, lightweight sword, suitable for both thrusting and slashing techniques.

entries.name: Shortsword of First Blood
entries.description: A golden blade, exquisitely made and astonishingly sharp.

entries.name: Spear +1
entries.description: Forged by dwarven hands, and prized by all warriors who wish to keep their foe at a distance.

entries.name: Speedy Reply
entries.description: A heavy haft and wide blade belie the speed of this weapon. It parts the air as swiftly as any duelling sabre.

entries.name: Staff of a Mumbling Wizard
entries.description: Because it was designed by a compulsive mumbler, this staff can't distinguish between its spells, and so can only cast - <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_Fireball">Fireball</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Firebolt">Firebolt</LSTag> at random.

entries.name: Staff of Arcane Blessing
entries.description: Though dust has settled into every nook and cranny of this staff, it still emanates a soothing aura. Its previous owner cast it aside - forgotten because there was nobody to bless.

entries.name: Staff of Crones
entries.description: Live worms wriggle beneath the crumbling surface of this half-rotten staff. Merely touching it fills you with a wave of unbearable nausea and a strange longing, as if it's calling out for its like.

entries.name: Steelforged Sword
entries.description: Though the grip's leather is old and crusty, it shows no signs of wear, and not a single scratch mars the slender blade.

entries.name: Svartlebee's Woundseeker
entries.description: Wielded by Svartlebee The Custodian, so named because he had the following reputation: Have you got someone in your life causing a mess? Send Svartlebee a missive. He shall clean them up, and then clean up the crime scene.

entries.name: Sword of Justice
entries.description: The words 'Deliverance. Justice. Vengeance.' are engraved on the base of this sword. They echo in your mind.

entries.name: Sword of Screams
entries.description: A blade of flawless craft. As it parts the air, you fancy you can hear a faint, whispering shriek...

entries.name: Sylvan Scimitar
entries.description: Everything moves strangely in the Feywild, from rivers to behaviours. It's a mercurial place, where the magical and physical can pass permeably through one another.

entries.name: Syringe (+1)
entries.description: The yellowish-green ooze dried to the syringe's long needle gives you the distinct impression that this medical device was never used to heal anyone.

entries.name: The Skinburster
entries.description: In mellow light, the halberd's curved steel head eerily resembles a grin.

entries.name: The Undead Bane
entries.description: Wielded by the indomitable Ser Lexia. Although her eagerness to destroy evil in all its forms was constant, she often took time to make little gifts for her friends.

entries.name: The Watcher's Guide
entries.description: Time has dampened this spear's sheen, but the centre glows a faint blue. The magic it exudes feels old, terrible... and divine. The spear was given to its previous owner for his unerring loyalty - even after death.

entries.name: Trepan (+1)
entries.description: Though blood and age have rusted the mechanism, a good twist can still make the blades on this bloodletting device spin.

entries.name: Trident +1
entries.description: The brutal design of this weapon's trio of prongs forces pierced flesh apart.

entries.name: Very Heavy Greataxe
entries.description: It's really very heavy.

entries.name: Vision of the Absolute
entries.description: The tip of this spear strikes unerringly towards its target's eyes.

entries.name: War Pick +1
entries.description: When swung, the arc of this weapon perfectly matches the curve of its beak-like pick.

entries.name: Warhammer +1
entries.description: Following tradition, this hammer's faces were forged with grooves that sealed in the blood of its first kill.

entries.name: Witchbreaker
entries.description: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to... well, keep doing whatever she's doing. It's probably malefic, involving toads and... and things.

entries.name: Xyanyde
entries.description: Cast deep in the Underdark by duergar slaves, the head of this mace is engraved with spiderwebs. It is ice-cold to the touch.

entries.name: Adamantine Longsword
entries.description: Though heavy, this longsword swings effortlessly in your hand - ready to take down a hundred enemies.

entries.name: Adamantine Mace
entries.description: A nimble mace, heavy with the promise of broken bones.

entries.name: Adamantine Scimitar
entries.description: Each cut of this blade shines with the wicked glint of adamantine - a promise for a devastating blow.

entries.name: Ambusher
entries.description: This blade is one of a few rare swords wielded by the Eucalyptus League, a group of fabulously wealthy courtesans who owned a great deal of Luskan's bazaars.

entries.name: Bigboy's Chew Toy
entries.description: Often mistaken for a relic of the wizard Bigby's creation, this staff was, ironically, made as a bite stick for Bigby's dog, Bigboy.

entries.name: Blackguard's Sword
entries.description: Formerly wielded by one who forsook all ties of friendship and kindness, this sword is rife with deranged energies. It seems to transmit feelings of contentment when carving through bones.

entries.name: Blade of Oppressed Souls
entries.description: Fragments of dead souls are imprisoned in the steel. Angry, powerful, hopeful, or scared - all of them rose up against their illithid masters, and all of them fell to this blade. Now, they are trapped forever, forced to aid their oppressors.

entries.name: Blooded Greataxe
entries.description: Stained brown and reeking of iron, this greataxe once belonged to a killer so deranged, his name was magically scrubbed from all histories.

entries.name: Breaching Pikestaff
entries.description: Concussive energy thumps like a mighty heartbeat from this pike.

entries.name: Cacophony
entries.description: Carved in circles across the knob of the staff are different words for thunder. Gnomish, Sylvan, Elvish, Celestial, even the Primordial tongue - all of these and more fuse together to form the thunderword.

entries.name: Caitiff Staff
entries.description: The texture of magic granted by a warlock's patron is largely dependent upon the patron themselves - for example, your standard eldritch patron's probably going to work some eyeball-mottled tentacles in there somewhere.

entries.name: Charge-Bound Warhammer
entries.description: Energy crackles in weird and wonderful patterns across your hand as you wield this bound weapon, as if your very veins were marbled like a cloud of blue-white lightning.

entries.name: Clown Hammer
entries.description: This hammer has a colourful history - it doesn't honk when you squeeze it, alas.

entries.name: Cold Snap
entries.description: In the steel, you can see small ice formations like bubbles in a bath, and even hear them pop with crickling crackles of frosted delight.

entries.name: Corpsegrinder
entries.description: Reliable and trustworthy, you could not hope for more respectable company than this maul whilst traversing the forlorn places of the world.

entries.name: Corrosive Flail
entries.description: Acid was long ago abandoned by assassins, who found poison much more reliable in spiking their targets' drinks. The acid kept melting the chalices.

entries.name: Creation's Echo
entries.description: This staff pulses with energy, swiftly attuning itself to the beat of your heart.

entries.name: Cruel Sting
entries.description: The trauma of becoming a drider is quickly set aside with a cold arachnid dispassion. This sword follows that disturbing trend - a replenishing poison gland is built within, deployed only against trapped opponents.

entries.name: Dagger +2
entries.description: A light, slender blade, magically honed to stay razor-sharp.

entries.name: Defender Flail
entries.description: This flail was created to commemorate victory over the devil Belhifet. It has since made its way so far from Easthaven that the locals have long forgotten that chapter of their town's past.

entries.name: Defender Greataxe
entries.description: The power of this axe lies in a fluctuating arcane enchantment that flows between the beard and the edge of the axe, and the wielder themselves.

entries.name: Despair of Athkatla
entries.description: Touching the adornments, it's clear that Lorroakan's short temper has flowed into his staff. It flows into your brain in shades of burgundy and carmine, bright as the storm-lanterns of Lorroakan's homeland.

entries.name: Dolor Amarus
entries.description: Once wielded by a murderer, the weapon's handle retains an eerie, clammy warmth, as if Dolor's pre-slaughter sweat somehow crept into the leather - and lingers there still.

entries.name: Drakethroat Glaive
entries.description: Kereska, the draconic goddess of arcane knowledge, gifted this glaive to a dragonborn when facing off against a group of carbuncular spiders. How their arachnid legs curled and blackened before that night's dark business was done!

entries.name: Dread Iron Dagger
entries.description: A web of veins runs the length of the blade - it has become a slender iron mortuary for all the innocents it has tasted.

entries.name: Duke Ravengard's Longsword
entries.description: Cradling his newborn son awkwardly, the Duke's face pulled into a rictus of misery. His love Francesca smiled at him, briefly, and died. He stared at her until the boy cried, and he told the boy it would be all right, though he himself did not believe it.

entries.name: Flail +2
entries.description: The flail sits heavy in your hand - the weight of steel and magic.

entries.name: Flail of Ages
entries.description: Created by a warmongering rakshasa and kept for a time under the careful watch of an astute noble named Lord de'Arnise, this flail is a tool of absolute destruction, and a versatile one at that.

entries.name: Fleshrender
entries.description: The previous owner was going to call this sword Barney, but he got such a bollocking from his friends that he named it Fleshrender instead, and sulked for a whole tenday afterward.

entries.name: Glaive +2
entries.description: Tiny specks of blood are fused into the blade, as if the glaive is feeding on them.

entries.name: Gleamdance Dagger
entries.description: A pair of pixie wings were used to create this pretty blade - their delicate tracings can be seen all day and night, though they shine brightest by the light of a gibbous moon.

entries.name: Gold Wyrmling Staff
entries.description: The fire engulfing this staff seems to feed off thin air, never once burning the dark wood.

entries.name: Greataxe +2
entries.description: This heavy axe emits a barely audible hum when swung.

entries.name: Hammer of the Just
entries.description: Tyr is often known as the Maimed God - a descriptor he shares with most victims of this heavy warhammer.

entries.name: Harmonic Dueller
entries.description: Unsheathed, the steel of this rapier shivers and thrums mellifluously in response to nearby surfaces - the motion brings to mind an actor struck with pre-show nerves.

entries.name: Harmonium Halberd
entries.description: The platinum inlays of this halberd hum an otherworldly harmony in the key of C, heightening the wielder's vigour but diminishing their mental faculties. The sound it makes is pining, as if far from its rightful home.

entries.name: Harper Sacredstriker
entries.description: This quarterstaff is as solid as the bond between each member of the Harpers - even working in anonymity, they do so with a common and righteous cause.

entries.name: Hellbeard Halberd
entries.description: Salvaged from the beard of a dead infernal leviathan, whose facial hair was formed from the weapons of an army it had once vanquished.

entries.name: Hollow's Staff
entries.description: This staff was wielded by Thibault Hollow, a supremely talented necromancer notable for his overwhelming fear of zombies. Many was the time when his dread lair would echo with a high-pitched shriek when one of them surprised him in a corridor, or when he was taking a bath.

entries.name: Infernal Mace
entries.description: Precise infernal runes are woven into this weapon's filigree, implying a creator well-versed in hellish arcana.

entries.name: Infernal Spear
entries.description: Precise infernal runes are woven into this weapon's filigree, implying a creator well-versed in hellish arcana.

entries.name: Jorgoral's Greatsword
entries.description: Strong castle-forged steel surmounts a grip of sturdy leather - this immense sword is capable of disembowelling giants in a single swipe.

entries.name: Ketheric's Warhammer
entries.description: This hammer's weight is centred on enchanted obsidian at the base of the head. Some nights before bed, Ketheric would sneak a whey-faced glance at the hammer, and think about the stone, and wonder what unknown facet of his heart bore his weight.

entries.name: Larethian's Wrath
entries.description: Deceptively light, the blade rasps through castle-forged plate as easily as Corellon Larethian's own anarchic holy sword through the hearts of evil orcs.

entries.name: Longsword +2
entries.description: This longsword never dulls, although an observer may notice it quietly drinks the blood of slain enemies.

entries.name: Mace +2
entries.description: The shallow etchings along this mace's head seem to change shape, depending on the light.

entries.name: Monster Slayer Glaive
entries.description:
Monster-slaying is a rare calling, not for the faint of heart. It requires temperance, discipline, and usually a very big stick with something pointy at the end.
The best thing about spears is that the ugly parts of combat are happening at the other end.

entries.name: Moonlight Glaive
entries.description: A gift from Dame Aylin and her radiant goddess, this weapon's contours hold a silver-white beauty akin to the nightly lantern that climbs the firmament each evening.

entries.name: Pale Oak
entries.description: Infused with Silvanus' strength, these staves are gifted to Faithwardens who act in defence of nature.

entries.name: Punch-Drunk Bastard
entries.description: You see... *hic* the thing... the really, really important thing *hic*... about this item is *belches copiously*... oh sod it, it's a club. Enjoy.

entries.name: Quarterstaff +2
entries.description: Steel bands wrap around a wooden core, giving this staff extra momentum.

entries.name: Rapier +2
entries.description: The thin edge of this sword seems to blur and become nigh imperceptible with even the slightest movement.

entries.name: Rat Bat
entries.description: A club with nails hammered through it. Classic.

entries.name: Ravengard's Scourger
entries.description: Duke Ravengard's father was the sort of man who works with his hands, and communicates in grunts. In his heart his son vowed to do better. But when Wyll was born, Ravengard felt a strange gravity that drew him away from his son.

entries.name: Salty Scimitar(rrr)
entries.description: Shiver me timbers, this be a devilishly nasty blade.

entries.name: Scimitar +2
entries.description: An arched electric-blue afterimage follows this blade's every move.

entries.name: Shadow Lantern
entries.description: Encased in a cocoon of shadow within the lantern, the mangled pixie lies like some deformed pupa, its mouth slack, and those same shadows crawling over its greying tongue.

entries.name: Shattered Flail
entries.description: A bundle of bones and blood - and a soul-piercing demonic presence - is all that remains of the Flind's flail. It would make a decent mace with a particularly nasty bite.

entries.name: Shortsword +2
entries.description: A common and effective sword, carried by adventurers, thieves, and watchmen alike.

entries.name: Sickle of BOOOAL
entries.description: Infused with the inconceivable might of the formidable BOOOAL!

entries.name: Sorrow
entries.description: For every drop of blood spilled, a piece of the soul perishes - until nothing remains but regret.

entries.name: Soulbreaker Greatsword
entries.description: The sharp metal whispers to you. Pleading. Cursing... Echoes of slain foes.

entries.name: Spear +2
entries.description: Even the ornamentation at the base of this spear's head is honed to a razor edge.

entries.name: Staff of Interruption
entries.description: This staff hums with a disruptive arcane energy that drives nearby spellcasters to distraction.

entries.name: Staff of the Emperor
entries.description:
Ceremorphosis eradicates great swathes of the consciousness that came before... but not everything. Touching the staff, a fragment of the Emperor's memory slithers into your brain - you see sea waves foaming into spume, and feel the explorer's exultant joy.

Then the image is gone, like so much silken night under a cut-shade sun.

entries.name: Sussur Dagger
entries.description: Smoke-like whorls of sussur sap darken the metal of this dagger's blade and silence its victims.

entries.name: Sussur Greatsword
