entries.description: Sussur roots extend from this sword's hilt into the blade itself. It yearns to drink magic, silencing every creature it strikes.

entries.name: Sussur Sickle
entries.description: The sheen of sussur sap forged into this sickle glows blue, silencing every creature it cuts.

entries.name: Sword of Clutching Umbra
entries.description: Fingers of shadow seem to beckon from the dark edge of the blade.

entries.name: Sword of the Emperor
entries.description: There's a graceful swarthiness to this sword. The inscription in the steel reads - 'My eye wanders far from home / To shores of distant Anchorome.'

entries.name: The Baneful
entries.description: The wizard Otiluke wrote about bound weapons and their propensity to coalesce with their wielder as the pair come together. He also wrote about their dangers, which are manifold, and their benefits, which make the danger worth it.

entries.name: The Spellsparkler
entries.description: Yrre the Sparkstruck intended to give the Spellsparkler to Lenore, a cleric of Mystra and old lover. But when the gnome returned to the cleric's tower, they found it empty - inhabited only by dust and abandoned experiments.

entries.name: Thermodynamo Axe
entries.description: Designed by gnomish innovation, this weapon has a dynamic core that swivels and tinkles into life whenever the axe is swung at a foe.

entries.name: Thorn Blade
entries.description: This blade is sharp and slender as a serpent's fang - and just as likely to inflict a hideous sting.

entries.name: Trident +2
entries.description: An elegant, vicious weapon designed to eviscerate flesh and organs.

entries.name: Twist of Fortune
entries.description: They say rich folk are never truly happy: especially true when they're targeted with this morningstar.

entries.name: Unseen Menace
entries.description: Yes, but what exactly is hitting you?

entries.name: Vicious Battleaxe
entries.description: A pulse of magic shoots through your hands whenever you touch this axe.

entries.name: Warhammer +2
entries.description: The segmented design of this gnome-forged hammer borrows elements of dragonborn weaponry.

entries.name: Wavemother's Sickle
entries.description: The curve of this sickle evokes a pitiless crescent moon over turbulent seas.

entries.name: Belm
entries.description: Faded but still legible, the mark of a Kara-Turan forgemaster adorns the pommel of this exquisite sword. Light as a robin's wing, quick as gnomish wit, this weapon has unseamed many foes - and will continue to, in the correct hands.

entries.name: Dwarven Thrower
entries.description: The first Dwarven Thrower was created unintentionally. The moment was transcribed in the annals of dwarfdom thusly: 'Ach, it doesn't work. Another design down the bloody drain. Now to... Does er... Does anyone else hear a sort of humming whistle? Growing louder?'

entries.name: Foebreaker
entries.description: As heavy and opposed to nonsense as the kitchen cook in most stories about some young adventurous girl going to become a knight or a hedge witch or something. You've got to have a big no nonsense cook. It's like rules.

entries.name: Halberd of Vigilance
entries.description: A variant of this halberd's design was thrown out in the early stages of development by its forgemaster. This was because the halberd kept expressing itself. 'ALARM!' it would shriek in peril. 'POTENCY FILLS ME LIKE A SONG OF HOPE!' it roared in triumph.

entries.name: Handmaiden's Mace
entries.description: This mace was designed by Lolth's assassins to fell heretics who dared turn their back on the Spider Queen. However, even the best-laid designs fall to nothingness when brought to bear against Shar's faithful.

entries.name: Hellfire Greataxe
entries.description: Anything hit by this has the life expectancy of a glass hammer.

entries.name: Incandescent Staff
entries.description: Etchings course red-hot through the length of this staff, the script of primordial fire writ in flame.

entries.name: Infernal Rapier
entries.description: Imagine the soul as a blade. A good one, carefully looked after. A bad one suited for rusting in the rain. Flame-chewed and narrow, this blade is Wyll's soul summarised in steel.

entries.name: Justiciar's Scimitar
entries.description: This light, curved blade is as unusual and unforgiving as the darkness it strikes from.

entries.name: Knife of the Undermountain King
entries.description: Snatched from the realm of the mad wizard Halaster Blackcloak, this knife became a prized keepsake of a duergar king.

entries.name: Mourning Frost
entries.description: The air around this staff crackles with a cold, frosty wind - a power that has been divided for too long, and is waiting to be released.

entries.name: Pelorsun Blade
entries.description: After the blade had sliced Kas the Bloody-Handed's throat, it was chosen by Pelor, God of the sun, to do righteous work against the undead.

entries.name: Rhapsody
entries.description: Cazador's love of poetry arose after he read one on the naked stomach of a dead child in his homeland. The child was hung from the lowest branch of a tree. Cazador read the poem, and looked at the child, and he knew that here was the artform for him.

entries.name: Sethan
entries.description: When this axe careens through the air toward an unfortunate head - the whistle of its spiritual counterpart is never far behind.

entries.name: Staff of Cherished Necromancy
entries.description: Unlike their father, Thibault, Cherish Hollow was not afraid of zombies. Cherish was afraid of sharks, liquorice, wallpaper, Netherese artefacts, hats (large), the outdoors, the indoors, hats (small), and milk pails. Zombies were a bloody picnic.

entries.name: Staff of Spellpower
entries.description: A near-perfect relic that is only blemished by the collected palm-sweat of various archmagi from across the Realms.

entries.name: Staff of the Ram
entries.description:
Fashioned by some unknown archmage - no identifying insignia is forthcoming.

The staff thrums with a slow, ferocious pulse that draws its concussive power from the spiral-horned creatures that gave the weapon its name.

entries.name: Stillmaker
entries.description: The dagger's twisting blade is designed to nick the flesh as many times as possible, allowing its paralytic poison to flow effortlessly into any unfortunate target.

entries.name: Sword of Chaos
entries.description: The sword of Sarevok, brother of Gorion's Ward and child of the evil god Bhaal. Though much of its power died with him, the sword is still formidable, and glows with a malevolent light.

entries.name: Sword of Life Stealing
entries.description: Folded into the steel of this menacing weapon is an alloy of enchanted metal. It waits like a leech in thick swamp water, awaiting a victim to taste, awaiting a chance to restore your heartiness and inflict suffering on your foes.

entries.name: The Dancing Breeze
entries.description: Tiny specks of blood are fused into the blade, as if the glaive is feeding on them.

entries.name: The Sacred Star
entries.description: The power of this item lies in belief, though not in any god. This item believes that it's very good at hitting things, so it is. Belief is quite powerful when it comes to violence.

entries.name: Trident of the Waves
entries.description: Umberlee, the goddess of the sea, is deeply capricious, intelligent, and not nearly as wet around the edges as her domain might suggest. She often demands sacrificial tribute from sailors, such as their ships, their cargo, and, while she's at it, them.

entries.name: Voss' Silver Sword
entries.description: Heavy and grouted in the gore of countless centuries, this prototype for the contemporary githyanki silver sword was wielded during their rebellion against the mind flayers who enslaved them.

entries.name: Woe
entries.description: The gentle tap-tap-tap of a staff on stone sparked terror for all in Cazador's palace. It signalled an approaching storm, and all they could do was shrink into the background and pray its wrath would not fall on them.

entries.name: Balduran's Giantslayer
entries.description: Wielded by Balduran, the founder of Baldur's Gate and friend to his guardian dragon, a great glittering wyrm called Ansur. Fellowship can be undone, though, as easily as you or I might unlace the strings of our shoes, and it was in a time of skullduggery and hardship that Balduran killed Ansur, carrying out the deed with this sword.

entries.name: Bloodthirst
entries.description: The Lord of Murder wasn't always a lord. He was once just a petty killer. When Bhaal first drew blood in a Baldurian back-alley, it dropped to the ground and lingered. When he ascended, this dried blood-drop grew, warped - and became sharp.

entries.name: Crimson Mischief
entries.description: When she was a girl, she toyed with nastiness and sadism. Children often grow out of this; they get hobbies. For Orin, that taste for cruelty fermented, and in a way she did find hobbies. Ones that screamed.

entries.name: Devotee's Mace
entries.description: This weapon is favoured by celestial devas, the vanguards of the divine ranks of paradise.

entries.name: Duellist's Prerogative
entries.description: A blade gifted to Lora by her own mother, Lenore the Fleet. When challenged to duels, Lenore's opponents assumed she had received this nickname from some naval exploit. They found out how wrong they were when her blade blurred faster than the eye could follow.

entries.name: Nyrulna
entries.description: The forgemaster Lirrico designed this weapon for the champion of the wind goddess Akadi. A key component in the forging was his home city's wind, and for a year after the weapon was made, no wind blew there at all.

entries.name: Selûne's Spear of Night
entries.description: 'One of the goddess Selûne's titles, Moonmaiden, has often been debated among the ecclesiastical. Common symbology certainly rejects the assumption of virginity. More to the point, 'maiden' itself carries some dusty connotations. How about Lunar Lady? Keeps the alliteration, too.' - Margaery Henderplum

entries.name: Shar's Spear of Evening
entries.description: When visiting mortals in dreams, Shar's hair would curl and twist about her head like strands of inky midnight. If it tickled her nose, the goddess was careful not to show it.

entries.name: Silver Sword of the Astral Plane
entries.description: The fervour with which the githyanki express devotion to their queen is admirable to some, disquieting to others. When confronted with the fallibility of the divine (since no one is wholly perfect), who knows what reaction such folk might evince.
entries.wikiTitle: Silver Sword of the Astral Plane

entries.name: Moonlantern
entries.description: Each framed facet of the lantern glass is pierced by lances and long tendrils of eerily beautiful moonlight.

entries.name: Orphic Hammer
entries.description: Every contract a devil makes has some form of insurance - this one is cast in infernal iron and was forged in deep, ruinous hellfire.

entries.name: Torch of Revocation
entries.description: This staple of any worthwhile exorcist burns with a pale flame that destroys the anchors of troublesome ghosts in need of banishment.

entries.name: Allandra's Whelm
entries.description: When Allandra was a girl, she saw a hot spall of matter fire through the sky. She wished upon this falling star, but instead of getting an answer from the sky, she got one from the sea in the voice of Umberlee, goddess of the endless fathom.

entries.name: Arduous Flame Blade
entries.description: The extent of cultural idolatry amongst members of the Flaming Fist is anyone's guess, but fascination with fire is plain and unambiguously obsessive.

entries.name: Azer Warhammer
entries.description: Flecks of volcanic glass gleam darkly from the head of this warhammer - obsidian eyes regarding the world with the narrow, spite-inflamed convictions of its azer wielder.

entries.name: Blood-Bound Blade
entries.description: This weapon was wielded by the lionlike eldritch knight Cypress of the Starfeller clan, who took on challenges of the heart and mind with palpable brilliance, and fought with a skill and heated intensity that was almost solar.

entries.name: Chaos Flail
entries.description: The weapon of a flind, imbued with the power of the demon lord Yeenoghu. Some say the flail itself is the catalyst for transforming gnolls into vicious flinds.

entries.name: Combination Axe
entries.description: The intricate engravings on this axe's blade and handle make plain the skill of its smith.

entries.name: Dagger of Shar
entries.description: This dagger's handle is smooth and light, its jagged blade sharpened into a thin, cruel edge.

entries.name: Darkblade
entries.description: Despite its engravings, this lightweight sword is perfectly balanced - a flawless killing implement.

entries.name: Deva Mace
entries.description: The golden slopes of the celestial heavens are filled with angels. Theistic scholars don't know what they do, but whatever it is, they do it holy.

entries.name: Djinni Scimitar
entries.description: Contrary to popular belief, your standard djinni doesn't grant wishes, unless that wish is to have your nose lopped off.

entries.name: Doom Axe
entries.description: Bringer of that which it is.

entries.name: Enforcer Club
entries.description: Sometimes the blunt application of fear (and, admittedly, some swinging elbows) is the difference between continued chaos and the re-establishment of order.

entries.name: Executioner Sword
entries.description: Once there was a man who dreamed of unlocking every bit of his potential. It upset him when he couldn't; after all who can? When his daughter was born, she taught him about real dreams. She taught him with her eyes.

entries.name: Flail of Dread Skulls
entries.description: Target must succeed a Wisdom <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag>. On failure, they are struck by Yeenoghu's curse. Depending on a dice roll, they will receive one of the following: Madness, 2d6 Psychic damage, or become Paralysed.

entries.name: Githyanki Longsword (Psionic)
entries.description: Every tip and edge on this elaborate sword is sharpened to a deadly perfection.

entries.name: Gnarled Tree Branch
entries.description: A heavy branch ripped from the trunk of an oak tree.

entries.name: Greatclub (Minotaur)
entries.description: Heavy, spiked branches bound together with rope and sinew. It's hard to imagine a cruder weapon, but it is effective.

entries.name: Greatclub +2
entries.description: A blue glow radiates through the brass spirals at the end of this heavy club.

entries.name: Heavy Spiked Club
entries.description: Rusted iron spikes and mismatched stones are haphazardly lashed to the end of this thick oak branch.

entries.name: Infernal Longsword
entries.description: Precise infernal runes are woven into this weapon's filigree, implying a creator well-versed in hellish arcana.

entries.name: Infernal Warhammer
entries.description: Precise infernal runes are woven into this weapon's filigree, implying a creator well-versed in hellish arcana.

entries.name: Mind Sundering Dagger
entries.description: Light as thoughts themselves, this dagger is in the habit of rending them, causing significant pain, and occasional death.

entries.name: Moonblade
entries.description: This sacred elven blade once belonged to Ketheric Thorm. Selûne's blessing shines silver along its cutting edge.

entries.name: Netherstone-Pommelled Bloodthirst
entries.description: The Lord of Murder wasn't always a lord. He was once just a petty killer. When Bhaal first drew blood in a Baldurian back-alley, it dropped to the ground and lingered. When he ascended, this dried blood-drop grew, warped - and became sharp.

entries.name: Planeslayer Flail
entries.description: Passed from hand to hand by those who hunt creatures from beyond the Material Plane, this flail has two words scrawled on it: 'No Trespassing.'

entries.name: Promise
entries.description: A leafy pattern is carved into the dagger's blade. It glows faintly in the dark.

entries.name: Rebound Battleaxe
entries.description: This axe is so loyal, it will sometimes return to wielders it favours.

entries.name: Render of Scrumptious Flesh
entries.description: It might be your imagination, but when blood runs over the blade, you could swear you hear... slurping.

entries.name: Rod of Resurrection
entries.description: The piece of electrum embedded at the top of this staff is filed to a point so it can 'pierce the Weave itself' - symbolically, at least.

entries.name: Rusty Battleaxe
entries.description: A rust-pitted axe, malodorous in its degradation.

entries.name: Rusty Greataxe
entries.description: The beard of this axe is ginger with rust, and therefore soulless.

entries.name: Rusty Rapier
entries.description: So brittle, you could flick it in half.

entries.name: Rusty War Pick
entries.description: Swinging this war pick might actually result in the rust-eaten head simply falling off.

entries.name: Rusty Warhammer
entries.description: Snared and flaking with awful rust.

entries.name: Sanguine Blade
entries.description: Blood enthrals and holds great dominion over people. Its wine-dark stain anoints even the pacifist in such troubled times as these.

entries.name: Scythe of Myrkul
entries.description: Simple but sharp. The shaft of this glaive is worn smooth with use.

entries.name: Shadow Battleaxe
entries.description: Oliver would watch his father split logs with this, enjoying the thwacking sound. Sometimes, in that part of dusk when the light gets thin, he was drawn to his father's shadow, and would feel a stir of inexplicable dread.

entries.name: Shar's Sting
entries.description: The blade is sharp, and the handle firm. Yet death exudes from this dagger as it might from a fresh corpse.

entries.name: Shortsword (Yurgir)
entries.description: This dagger's handle is smooth and light, its jagged blade sharpened into a thin, cruel edge.

entries.name: Spiderstep Staff
entries.description: Slightly sticky to the touch, this staff has excellent grip.

entries.name: Staff of Accretion
entries.description: Simmering in the heartwood of this staff, you sense a latent power pulsating - it seems the thing is impatient to build up and dispense its fierce energy.

entries.name: Steadfast Maul
entries.description: Steadfast Edwina of Icewind Dale wielded this maul for many years before pursuing her desired career of fiction writing. She wrote crime novels set in Waterdeep for thirty years, and died largely unrecognised. But happy.

entries.name: The Impaler
entries.description: This impaling pole of enchanted steel was commissioned as part of a set by Strahd von Zarovich, who presented the weapons to his honour guard one cold morning.

entries.name: Tough Sunrises
entries.description: Sent by Lathander, the god of creativity and sunrises. Unfortunately, it was not received by the cleric who needed it at that crucial moment, but by a baffled librarian in Daggerford, who used it as a door stopper.

entries.name: Twisted Oak Crook
entries.description: A staff engraved with a leafy motif, maples and oakleaf winding through a forest going through every stage of life, spring to bare-branched winter.

entries.name: Vampiric Dagger
entries.description: This dagger's handle is smooth and light, its jagged blade sharpened into a thin, cruel edge.

entries.name: Verminsign
entries.description: Where most people see a bundle of interesting diseases in the common rat, members of the Zhentarim syndicate see a potential colleague.

entries.name: Vicious Shortsword
entries.description: Despite its engravings, this lightweight sword is perfectly balanced - a flawless killing implement.

entries.name: Goblin Bow
entries.description: Fashioned together from a rough-cut branch and stinking sinew.

entries.name: Rusty Heavy Crossbow
entries.description: Try firing a bolt from this rust-encrusted stock, see if you keep all your fingers.

entries.name: Rusty Light Crossbow
entries.description: The stock of this crossbow is devoured by decay.

entries.name: Hand Crossbow
entries.description: The spring locks back with the tiniest, most satisfying click.

entries.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries.description: A standard-issue crossbow, used by many guardsmen.

entries.name: Longbow
entries.description: During the Crown Wars, the demand for longbows was such that adult yew trees were almost driven to extinction.

entries.name: Sahuagin Longbow
entries.description: Carved enchantments span the length of this supple bow.

entries.name: Shortbow
entries.description: This small, agile bow bears a beautiful elven string, easy to draw but tough as steel.

entries.name: Bow of Awareness
entries.description: This halfling bow requires a full draw for smaller folk, but serves as a quick off-hand for those of greater height.

entries.name: Crossbow of Arcane Force
entries.description: The soft hum of power emanates from the alien metal.

entries.name: Firestoker
entries.description: Though the crossbow's bolts look burning hot, they are pleasantly warm to the touch.

entries.name: Gandrel's Aspiration
entries.description: When Gandrel was seven, he was frightened badly by a vampire spawn during a public burning. Seized by the flames, the creature didn't shrivel up. It swelled and burst like a squeezed leech. Brains splattered the boy's shoes, grey-pink and pulpy. He would never forget it.

entries.name: Githyanki Crossbow
entries.description: This heavy crossbow is fashioned from a curious, tensile metal that doesn't seem to be native to Faerûn.

entries.name: Hand Crossbow +1
entries.description: A subtle magic runs through both strings of this crossbow, keeping the bows even once the lock is released.

entries.name: Heavy Crossbow +1
entries.description: Despite the heaviness of this crossbow, the latch pulls back with an effortless ease.

entries.name: Hellrider Longbow
entries.description: This longbow was forged from the remnants of Stanislav the Silver's shield, found near the wreckage of Castle Ravenloft some years ago.

entries.name: Hunting Shortbow
entries.description: Supple and strong, this shortbow has been imbued with a ranger's solemn magic - running your fingers along the smooth ash, you can feel that solemnity like a ghost in the shaped wood.

entries.name: Light Crossbow +1
entries.description: Though this crossbow's stock is hollowed out, its heavy trigger mechanism keeps it well-balanced.

entries.name: Longbow +1
entries.description: Carved enchantments span the length of this supple bow.

entries.name: Sharran Crossbow
entries.description: A sleek, well-made crossbow that is plain but for the symbol of Shar on the handle.

entries.name: Shortbow +1
entries.description: This halfling bow requires a full draw for smaller folk, but serves as a quick off-hand for those of greater height.

entries.name: Spellthief
entries.description: A shiver of magic flows from this bow into your hand - like a promise.

entries.name: Bow of the Banshee
entries.description: The impression of an elven face screams silently from the finely curved bow - the image becomes even more disturbing when the bowstring snaps forward on release, emitting a blood-curdling wail.

entries.name: Darkfire Shortbow
entries.description: This length of yew was polished in a lacquer made from the mingled, cooled, and refined breath of a gold and silver dragon.

entries.name: Giantbreaker
entries.description: Legends say the Giantbreaker earned its name when an elven ranger singlehandedly defeated a score of hill giants. While the ranger's name is long forgotten, Giantbreaker's lives on.

entries.name: Hand Crossbow +2
entries.description: Though the crossbow is small and light, a heavy power runs through its bowstring.

entries.name: Harold
entries.description: Named after Harold Butterbisk, who owned the Butterbisk Inn in Waterdeep before it was renamed by new owners. The stock of the crossbow reads: Quaffing is a shootable offence.

entries.name: Least Expected
entries.description:
One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. It was to the tremendous surprise of all that Ludmilla, the quiet, the weepy, the daughter most under her mother's thumb, took up this bow and fired.

The arrow flashed, and while Duerra and her blinded court wailed impotently, the children escaped into an uncertain, yet sweetly free, future.

entries.name: Longbow +2
entries.description: A soothing hum drifts through your head whenever you draw this bow.

entries.name: Ne'er Misser
entries.description: On the stock, the crafter of this crossbow etched in tiny print: 'Ifn yer gonna miss, why dontchyae stop being a wally, and hit instead!'

entries.name: The Joltshooter
entries.description: Sleek and lightweight, it is said that the Joltshooter was Yrre the Sparkstruck's favourite weapon. They were indifferent towards bows, but the spikes jutting out of it?

entries.name: The Long Arm of the Gur
entries.wikiTitle: The Long Arm of the Gur

entries.name: Titanstring Bow
entries.description: The commonly held belief that archers are rangey, thin-wristed people is completely false. It takes years of training to pull a bowstring all the way back to your cheekbone, and wrists like iron.

entries.name: Vicious Shortbow
entries.description: Pliable yew and a hearty bowstring ensure this shortbow fires straight and true.

entries.name: Blightbringer
entries.description: Conducting a series of increasingly sick rituals - involving the ashes of a gnome and silkworms fed fat on the corpse of a dwarven cleric - the goblin shaman Kirruk Redrats created this deadly bow.

entries.name: Fabricated Arbalest
entries.description: A perfect system must be ruled by a keen eye - and any error foolish enough to rear its head afore the eye must be quickly, precisely, and totally eliminated. This crossbow can help with that.

entries.name: Hellfire Engine Crossbow
entries.description: 'Trundling, mashing, mincing, crushing, grinding, blasting, biting! Hear their peeling thunder, their roaring flames, their clicking, whirring, metallic melody, and know that the hellfire engines of Avernus are on the move!' - Edict in Elturel

entries.name: Hellfire Hand Crossbow
entries.description: Rigged to draw on the skin-peeling hellfire of Avernus by a resourceful devil, this crossbow's size is no indication of its deadly potential.

entries.name: The Dead Shot
entries.description: When the archer Frederik Durlusk died, his only request was to be buried with his favourite bow. This is that bow.

entries.name: Gontr Mael
entries.description: Gontr Mael blasted from the corpse of the Steel Watcher Titan: a bow formed from the boiling slag and weird whispering gyros inherent to the mechanical giant. It must have acted as the Titan's abdomen, exchanging muscle for immaculate steel.

entries.name: Dart
entries.description: A well-used dart, its stained feathers slightly bent.

entries.name: Dart +1
entries.description: A dart made of lightweight wood, its feathers carefully cut at a sharp angle.

entries.name: Dart +2
entries.description: Pegasus feathers lend this dart remarkable speed, as well as a pleasant jasmine fragrance.

entries.name: Hand Crossbow (Yurgir)
entries.description: The spring locks back with the tiniest, most satisfying click.

entries.name: Light Crossbow of Speed
entries.description: Bolts slot into this crossbow with wonderful ease, as if eager to nestle against the stock, soon to fly.

entries.name: Magical Hand Crossbow
entries.description: The string of this crossbow, secured tightly against the stock, came from the lyre of a powerful bard who gave up his days as a magical minstrel for a more ascetic life.

entries.name: Makeshift Bow
entries.description: Though nothing more than a flexible twig and a string, this makeshift bow will do in a pinch.

entries.name: Rusty Hand Crossbow
entries.description: This adroit little crossbow is undone with rust.

entries.name: Sling
entries.description: Big, neat stitches line the supple leather pouch of this sling

entries.name: Arrow of Aberration Slaying
entries.description: Forged from a meteor's alien metals, this arrow resonates with an unsettling hum.

entries.name: Arrow of Acid
entries.description: Corrodes and disfigures whatever it touches.

entries.name: Arrow of Arcane Interference
entries.description: To disrupt the Weave is to draw Mystra's wrath - if her casters can catch you.

entries.name: Arrow of Beast Slaying
entries.description: This roughly-hewn arrow was likely crafted in the field, fletcher's tools lit by a campfire's glow.

entries.name: Arrow of Celestial Slaying
entries.description: Infernal inscriptions twist around the shaft, burned black into the wood.

entries.name: Arrow of Construct Slaying
entries.description: Only a few fragile threads hold an artificial life together. Sever them with this.

entries.name: Arrow of Darkness
entries.description: Black as the Styx, beautiful as a starless night.

entries.name: Arrow of Dragon Slaying
entries.description: It's said the inventor of these arrows was assassinated by a shadow dragon, who wished their secret for itself.

entries.name: Arrow of Elemental Slaying
entries.description: Placing a finger upon the flat of its arrowhead causes a different sensation every time - heat, cold, a jolt of electricity...

entries.name: Arrow of Fey Slaying
entries.description: Fire this and a Formorian laughs.

entries.name: Arrow of Fiend Slaying
entries.description: Swift and true as a solar's shining blade.

entries.name: Arrow of Fire
entries.description: Though it doesn't radiate any heat, this arrow's point will singe any flesh it touches.

entries.name: Arrow of Giant Slaying
entries.description: Small weights in the fletching keep this arrow well-balanced despite the heft of its iron arrowhead.

entries.name: Arrow of Humanoid Slaying
entries.description: Its twisting arrowhead shreds targets from within.

entries.name: Arrow of Ice
entries.description: Vapour curls off the point of the arrowhead like breath on a winter day.

entries.name: Arrow of Ilmater
entries.description: Named by a cleric of Loviatar for her own amusement.

entries.name: Arrow of Lightning
entries.description: Thread-like bolts of electricity arc across the arrowhead the moment this arrow is nocked.

entries.name: Arrow of Many Targets
entries.description: This arrow is far more flexible than most - it can bend nearly in half without snapping.

entries.name: Arrow of Monstrosity Slaying
entries.description: Its barbed arrowhead is as wicked in appearance as the abominations it was crafted to kill.

entries.name: Arrow of Ooze Slaying
entries.description: The blunted edge of its arrowhead is dipped in corrosive oils.

entries.name: Arrow of Piercing
entries.description: Particularly handy when you're outnumbered, with your back against a wall.

entries.name: Arrow of Plant Slaying
entries.description: Thin veins of rot snake across this arrow's wooden shaft.

entries.name: Arrow of Roaring Thunder
entries.description: When nocked, this arrow vibrates and emits a faint but distinctive crackle.

entries.name: Arrow of Salving
entries.description: The fizzling, soothing balm that coats this arrow is recommended by a majority of sages to treat minor ailments.

entries.name: Arrow of Transposition
entries.description: Some archers claim that these arrows switch places with one another when placed in the same quiver.

entries.name: Arrow of Undead Slaying
entries.description: This arrow is carved from green wood, still sticky to the touch.

entries.name: Barbed Arrow
entries.description: The top of this arrow is wickedly sharp and designed to lodge in the flesh.

entries.name: Smokepowder Arrow
entries.description: This arrow is ripe with the metallic stench of smokepowder - eager to ignite.

entries.name: Amnian Dessert Wine
entries.description: Favoured by denizens of the southern merchant state, this sweet red is often shared to celebrate deals done - and wash away any lingering bitterness from the haggling.

entries.name: Arabellan Dry
entries.description: Someone identifying themselves as Captain Trombone has scratched a drawing on the bottle's bottom. The drawing shows a sad pig eating a bacon sandwich, and bears the words, 'Rise up!'

entries.name: Arkhen's Hoard
entries.description: Expect strong jammy notes and the faintest hint of tobacco from this middling Sembian blend.

entries.name: Ashaba Dusk
entries.description: A bit flat, yet charmingly plucky, this Sembian red just might surprise you.

entries.name: Baalor Ale
entries.description: Hellishly strong, even sipping a little froth of this ale is enough to make a gelatinous cube disgorge whatever it has jellified, cry a bit, and go home to its wife hoping she'll forgive it.

entries.name: Baldur's Grape
entries.description: Worthy of a Grand Duke, this Baldurian red is velvety and powerful with a delightfully tart finish.

entries.name: Barrel-Aged Callidyrran
entries.description: Firm, oaky, and spicy, as is to be expected from its respected elven vintner.

entries.name: Blackstaff
entries.description: Big, bright, and unbalanced, this red is Waterdeep in a bottle.

entries.name: Blingdenstone Blush
entries.description: A fruity wine with hints of currant and cherry, made with surface-picked grapes and barrel-aged in the dark tunnels of the Wormwrithings.

entries.name: Brass City Scrangle
entries.description: Scrangle from a standard watering hole is pretty intense stuff - the way they brew it in the elemental Plane of Fire (with genie-tail smoke and extra lime juice) is a biohazard.

entries.name: Carafe of Wine
entries.description: Northerners cherish this mulled wine for its spice and warmth, not to mention its strength.

entries.name: Chultan Fireswill
entries.description: Judging by its fiery aroma, this heavily-spiced spirit packs a powerful punch.

entries.name: Common Table-Wine
entries.description: Quenching thirst across wide Faerûn, this common wine is served in ceramic jars that make a most pleasing sound when uncorked. The emptier the vessel, the better.

entries.name: Eigersstor Noblerot
entries.description: Close your eyes and you can almost taste Neverwinter - earthy, chewy, ever-so-slightly green.

entries.name: Esmeltar Red
entries.description: Inheriting the worst qualities of its Amnian varietals, this blend is resoundingly hollow.

entries.name: Farsea Marshwine
entries.description: Bitter and sopping-wet, this Cormyrian red tastes as if it's been thrown overboard.

entries.name: Frostkiss Ale
entries.description: An ale aged over years, said to be as cold and sour as the goddess it's named after.

entries.name: Gulthmeran Reserve
entries.description: Best left to truly discerning palettes, this wine may be too austere for its own good.

entries.name: Highsun Liqueur
entries.description: Brewed from herbs gathered at the summer solstice, this druidic concoction is said to cleanse the spirit of last season's ills. It's also excellent for digestion.

entries.name: Ithbank
entries.description: Its Tethyrian vintner layers elegant and expressive flavour like a bard's melody.

entries.name: Lovely Malty Beer
entries.description: A malty aroma wafts from this hay-coloured brew.

entries.name: Mermaid Whiskey
entries.description: Its Tethyrian vintner layers elegant and expressive flavour like a bard's melody.

entries.name: Monastery Firewine
entries.description: Really gives the monks something to pray about, the morning after.

entries.name: Moonshae Zinfandel 1461
entries.description: Headstrong on first taste, this underwhelming blend limps by the final sip.

entries.name: Moonshae Zinfandel 1462
entries.description: Inheriting the worst qualities of its Amnian varietals, this blend is resoundingly hollow.

entries.name: Moonshae Zinfandel 1463
entries.description: Headstrong on first taste, this underwhelming blend limps by the final sip.

entries.name: Moonshae Zinfandel 1464
entries.description: This Calishite red hits the tongue like a wild bull - big, meaty, and loud.

entries.name: Moonshae Zinfandel 1465
entries.description: This Calishite red hits the tongue like a wild bull - big, meaty, and loud.

entries.name: Moonshae Zinfandel 1466
entries.description: Inheriting the worst qualities of its Amnian varietals, this blend is resoundingly hollow.

entries.name: Moonshae Zinfandel 1467
entries.description: This Calishite red hits the tongue like a wild bull - big, meaty, and loud.

entries.name: Moonshae Zinfandel 1475
entries.description: Inheriting the worst qualities of its Amnian varietals, this blend is resoundingly hollow.

entries.name: Mug of Beer
entries.description: A malty aroma wafts from this hay-coloured brew.

entries.name: Pitcher of Beer
entries.description: This pitcher of bitter ale is filled to the brim. Plenty to share - or not.

entries.name: Plum Fizz
entries.description: Headstrong on first taste, this underwhelming blend limps by the final sip.

entries.name: Portal Sherry
entries.description: Wide gateways ring the bottle's circumference. It is said with every bottle consumed, the drinker awakes in a new and exciting location.

entries.name: Purple Dragon Blush
entries.description: Crisp, refined, and complex, this is an exemplary Cormyrian vintage.

entries.name: Rolling Deck Rum
entries.description: A sticky-sweet blend said to fortify the stomachs of sailors. Or ensure they're already empty by the time the rough seas hit.

entries.name: Rosymorn Firewine
entries.description: The colour of this wine is inviting, but don't be fooled - it's harsh on the nose and flabby on the palate.

entries.name: Stagswift Tonic
entries.description: Brewed in high Lathenderite monasteries, Stagswift has ensured many a monk was awake to greet the dawn. Typically from the night before.

entries.name: Suzailian Sweet
entries.description: Rough scales rings the bottle's perimeter - a product of Suzail's lively trade in dragon-themed wares.

entries.name: Syl-Pashan Sup
entries.description: This Calishite red hits the tongue like a wild bull - big, meaty, and loud.

entries.name: Tyche Pink
entries.description: A fragrant blend of red and white wines. Sodden nobles will deign to drink it only as a matter of last resort.

entries.name: Whalebone Spiced
entries.description: Waterdhavian sailors covet voyages to the western isles, as their ships return ballasted by crates of this amber spirit.

entries.name: Wine
entries.description: This Luskan blend is at war with itself - sharp, heavy, and shockingly dirty.

entries.name: Bagel
entries.description: A chewy roll from the communities of the Greenfields, frequently served with sesame or poppy seeds sprinkled on top.

entries.name: Baguette
entries.description: A long and hearty loaf, good for sopping up soup or sour cream.

entries.name: Baldurian Mash
entries.description: A piping hot plate of vegetables and roasted potatoes, topped off with tomatoes, spring onions, and a perfectly fried egg.

entries.name: Baldurian Seafood Stew
entries.description: A signature dish of the bustling harbour city, this stew is fragrant with garlic, fried tomato paste, and the day's catch. Best enjoyed with a hunk of crusty bread lashed with butter.

entries.name: Banana
entries.description: Bruised and slightly mushy.

entries.name: Beregost Blue Wedge
entries.description: Although this tangy cheese is produced only in Beregost, the many trade caravans passing through the town distribute it all over the Sword Coast.

entries.name: Beregost Blue Wheel
entries.description: The monks of Candlekeep covet wheels of this tangy cheese from nearby Beregost almost as much as they covet knowledge.

entries.name: Berry Tart
entries.description: A thick, sugary jam fills every nook and cranny between this tart's buttery crust and fresh berry topping.

entries.name: Bex's Handmade Cookies
entries.description: Bex's Cookies

entries.name: Biscuit
entries.description: Its crunchy exterior hides a soft centre and an abundance of sweetened raisins.

entries.name: Black Pudding Platter
entries.description: An assortment of grilled, fried, baked, and boiled blood sausages, complete with a savoury dip.

entries.name: Bloodless Pig Meat
entries.description: A few coarse hairs still stick out of the skin on the knee.

entries.name: Bluecap
entries.description: While bland and tasteless, bluecap spores are your best bet at finding something edible in the Underdark.

entries.name: Bluejay corpse
entries.description: This bluejay is certainly less snarky in a pulped form.

entries.name: Blushcap Mushroom
entries.description: Red and white mushrooms appear in many children's rhymes throughout Faerûn.

entries.name: Boiled Beholder Eyestalks
entries.description: Even in death, the beholder's eyes regard you with a mix of hauteur and suspicion.

entries.name: Boiled Potato
entries.description: A soft, hot potato filled with garlicky butter and herbs.

entries.name: Bunch of Horseradish
entries.description: Some folk believe horseradish cures toothaches, but be warned - it is more likely to just make your eyes water.

entries.name: Butter Bun
entries.description: Baked up a dozen at a time in warm ovens throughout the heartlands.

entries.name: Cabbage
entries.description: Vibrantly green and seasoned with a good amount of dirt.

entries.name: Carnival Squash
entries.description: Though this squash can be cooked into a rich meal, it's striped pattern makes it a popular autumn decoration.

entries.name: Carrot
entries.description: The undervalued stalwart of stews and salads.

entries.name: Charming Little Egg
entries.description: Round and speckled, there's something appreciably cheerful about an egg. Even the word itself, 'egg.' How frolicsome.

entries.name: Chelo Khoresh
entries.description: A feast dish, stewed from the moment dawn breaks until night swallows the sun. Favoured among Calimshite sultans - and their would-be poisoners.

entries.name: Chicken Egg
entries.description: Fried, boiled, poached: everyone has a favoured method of cooking an egg. The chicken rarely has any say in the matter.

entries.name: Chopped-Up Pig
entries.description: A trail of slimy blood slowly drips from the carcass.

entries.name: Cinnamon Roll
entries.description: Dusted with cinnamon and doused in vanilla icing, this treat's aroma is almost as delicious as its taste.

entries.name: Coffee
entries.description: Dark as tar, this coffee was brewed in the Amnian style - strong, bitter, and with a hint of spice.

entries.name: Cormyrian Seafood Soup
entries.description: A spicy tomato base filled with clams, mussels, and shrimp, sprinkled with spring onions and a dash of lemon juice.

entries.name: Courgette
entries.description: Especially delicious when slowly baked over a fire and spiced with Amnan herbs.

entries.name: Dried Beef Sausage
entries.description: Just a little chewy.

entries.name: Dried Pork Sausage
entries.description: Infused with copious amounts of garlic and cooked in mulled wine.

entries.name: Dried Rope Sausage
entries.description: Infused with copious amounts of garlic and cooked in mulled wine.

entries.name: Dried Sausage Links
entries.description: Infused with copious amounts of garlic and cooked in mulled wine.

entries.name: Durinbold Cheese Wedge
entries.description: Doused in honey and wrapped in chestnut leaves, this creamy sheep milk cheese is known for its distinct nutty taste.

entries.name: Everything Soup
entries.description: Also called 'Welcome Soup', this broth is named for the halfling tradition of frantically raiding the pantry or garden upon the unexpected arrival of a guest.

entries.name: Fire-Spiced Chicken Sausages
entries.description: While fire spices are popular amongst tieflings, most other races will need a sizeable chunk of bread or can of milk to douse the heat these sausages produce.

entries.name: Fish
entries.description: A thin, slimy layer has formed over its moist scales.

entries.name: Fish Fillet
entries.description: Delicious baked, steamed, or raw.

entries.name: Fish Head
entries.description: Commonly used in stocks or grilled for the succulent bits of the cheeks, throat, and eyes.

entries.name: Fragrant Fungus Stew
entries.description: A popular duergar dish. And why not? Its ingredients are common, and its flavour as bright as the glowcaps that comprise it.

entries.name: Fried Rat Skewer
entries.description: Fried until crisp and covered with a mixture of garlic, lime and peppers.

entries.name: Frites
entries.description: These thick-cut chips fried in beef tallow evoke memories of leisurely promenades along partially frozen rivers.

entries.name: Fruit Porridge
entries.description: This chunky porridge tastes overwhelmingly of bananas.

entries.name: Garlic
entries.description: Beneath this bulb's pungent aroma hides a subtle sweetness and an unrivalled depth of flavour.

entries.name: Glowcap Mushroom
entries.description: The glowcap is an Underdark traveller's boon, both lighting the way and dazzling the tongue.

entries.name: Goodberry (item)
entries.description: Plump and juicy, this berry exudes a soothing, sweet smell.

entries.name: Green Grapes
entries.description: Grapes for the table - not for wine - plucked from vines unknown.

entries.name: Grilled Cormorant
entries.description: A caramelised, fatty honey glaze drips from the webbed feet.

entries.name: Grilled Miniature Giant Space Hamster
entries.description: No matter how small, rare, or cute a critter, it will still fill your stomach.

entries.name: Grilled Pork Belly
entries.description: Succulent and layered with crispy fat.

entries.name: Grilled Pork Leg
entries.description: Traditionally roasted over the fires in Mithral Hall, grilled and spiced pork legs are especially popular among dwarven adventurers.

entries.name: Grilled Rothé Ribs
entries.description: Doused with honey and herbs, these ribs are a popular fare during Midsummer festivities.

entries.name: Grilled Steak
entries.description: Crisp but juicy, and sprinkled with just the right amount of salt and spices to bring about the beef's natural flavour.

entries.name: Gruel
entries.description: This watery sludge slowly drips off your spoon.

entries.name: Haggis
entries.description: An ancient dish, as old as the halfling race. Traditionally served with 'neeps' and 'tatties'.

entries.name: Half-Eaten Apple
entries.description: Though quite a bit of flesh remains on this apple, it is steadily turning a murky brown.

entries.name: Head of Lettuce
entries.description: This humble head is well past its prime. Its outer leaves are slimy and soft, and a thin brown liquid leaks from the stem.

entries.name: Headless Fish
entries.description: Tiny fish bones stick out from the cut tail.

entries.name: Hearty Dinner
entries.description: A traditional meal: potato, vegetables, and two different meats.

entries.name: Heavy Supply Pack
entries.description: A sturdy bag filled to the brim with bread, vegetables, meats, and anything you need for a good night's sleep.

entries.name: Honey Comb
entries.description: Comb of sweet honey.

entries.name: Honeyed Ham
entries.description: Traditionally served as the first dish at every halfling holiday feast, this large ham is brushed with honey, brown sugar, and pineapple glaze.

entries.name: Horseradish
entries.description: A touch of horseradish adds a nice, spicy zing to any recipe.

entries.name: Kiwi
entries.description: From Snowdown's north coast: an uncommonly furry fruit of uncommonly exquisite taste.

entries.name: Leg of Mutton
entries.description: Delicious when stewed, smoked, or roasted with onions, rosemary and thyme.

entries.name: Lemon
entries.description: Yellow as the summer sun; fresh as Neverwinter air; and sour as a high elf's scowl.

entries.name: Mashed Potatoes
entries.description: Creamy and smooth, with a note of black pepper and nutmeg.

entries.name: Milk
entries.description: Thin and weak, this milk smells - and tastes - of a barn.

entries.name: Mixed Coffee
entries.description: The harsh but invigorating coffee in this drink is tempered by a soothing milk tea - best supped in grand plazas of music and blue-pink light.

entries.name: Moulded Cheese Wedge
entries.description: Dark green spots run through this light cheese. It is unclear if the mould is malicious, or an intentional characteristic of this variety.

entries.name: Murky Stew
entries.description: Cooked over a campfire for hours, the ingredients of this sodden dish have lost all resemblance to any foods you know.

entries.name: Mushroom Soup
entries.description: A thick, rich soup to warm both your hands and stomach.

entries.name: Neogi Claws
entries.description: A delicacy among the gith residing on the Astral Plane, neogi claws are roasted on hot coals and seasoned with whatever spices the latest raid brought in.

entries.name: Neogi Rolls
entries.description: Though food isn't a necessity on the Astral Plane, many gith enjoy neogi meat both for its taste and out of spite for the creatures.

entries.name: Neverwinter Stew
entries.description: This stew gets its rich flavour from a combination of human, elven and dwarven beers.

entries.name: Okta's Alternative Meal
entries.description: Chunks of fat and leathery meat float in a watery soup.

entries.name: Onion
entries.description: Classic. Pungent. Versatile. A dietary staple across Faerûn, eaten in stews, salads - or even raw.

entries.name: Onion Soup
entries.description: A watery soup of onions and herbs, topped with a slice of stale bread.

entries.name: Orange
entries.description: A colourful citrus favourite grown in the south of the Sword Coast.

entries.name: Owlbear Egg
entries.description: Owlbear hatchlings are tiny and adorable for the first few tendays of their life. Then they eat you out of house and home. Then they simply eat you.

entries.name: Pale Mint
entries.description: From the scorched sands of the Calim desert rises this rare, culinary jewel. Once dried and crushed, its lemony sweetness graces only the rarest gourmet dishes.

entries.name: Pear
entries.description: Properly ripened, the sugary pear has few culinary rivals. Unripe, it contains all the appeal of a rothé's unwashed hide.

entries.name: Pig's Head
entries.description: The longer you stare at it, the longer it stares back.

entries.name: Pizza
entries.description: Sprinkled with sausage and no fewer than three different cheeses.

entries.name: Pork Loin
entries.description: Traditionally roasted in the heartlands with apple and cider gravy.

entries.name: Pork Shoulder
entries.description: Especially delicious when doused with wine and slowly braised over a fire, Cormyrian style.

entries.name: Potato
entries.description: A knobbly, dependable staple of every household across Faerûn, poor and wealthy alike.

entries.name: Potato Porridge
entries.description: The only limit to a potato recipe is the cook's imagination.

entries.name: Potato Scone Platter
entries.description: These fried potato scones produce a soft but satisfying crunch when bitten.

entries.name: Potato Wedges
entries.description: Fried, not baked, if the faint aroma of pork fat is any indication.

entries.name: Poutine
entries.description: Fries, cheese, and gravy. A perfectly balanced meal.

entries.name: Puff Pastry Braid
entries.description: A substantial raisin-packed pastry, braided in a style popularised by the halfling chef of the Elfsong Tavern in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Pumpkin
entries.description: Though this pumpkin weighs only a fraction of those offered to Chauntea at Highharvestide, it still constitutes a healthy meal for two.

entries.name: Pumpkin Soup
entries.description: Creamy and smooth, this soup tastes like a winter evening spent by a warm hearth.

entries.name: Purple Grapes
entries.description: Grapes for the table - not for wine - plucked from vines unknown.

entries.name: Raspberry
entries.description: Full ripe berries that taste tart, and burst at the slightest bite, and stain your fingers.

entries.name: Raw Steak
entries.description: A thick cut of tender meat, ringed with a layer of fat.

entries.name: Red Apple
entries.description: A delight from the orchards of Cormyr: crisp, juicy, and ever-so-slightly tart.

entries.name: Red Pepper
entries.description: Known regionally as a 'chime pepper' or 'whip pepper', this mild vegetable can be dried and crushed to make a flavourful seasoning that forms the basis of many central Faerûnian stews.

entries.name: Roast Beef Joint
entries.description: A joint of succulent beef, slowly roasted in mustard and gravy, and garnished with carrots and peas.

entries.name: Roast Pork
entries.description: So succulent it peels off the bone with only the slightest touch.

entries.name: Roast Turkey
entries.description: Doused with red wine and garnished with oranges and grapes, this roast turkey has a sophisticated but sweet taste.

entries.name: Roughly-Cut Ham
entries.description: A few coarse hairs still stick out of the skin on the knee.

entries.name: Salmon Pie
entries.description: The fluffy crust emits a cloud of delectable-smelling steam when broken open.

entries.name: Seafood Bouillabaisse
entries.description: A visit to any of the Sword Coast's major ports isn't complete until you've tasted this popular stew of haddock, cod, clams and mussels, sprinkled with a pinch of fennel.

entries.name: Sourdough Bread
entries.description: A firm, flaky crust is the hallmark of a sourdough loaf. Concocted in the Pirate Isles, it has recently become popular on the mainland.

entries.name: Spicy Pork Sausage
entries.description: Hard, fatty, and filled with the tangiest spices found in the port of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Spicy Sausage Links
entries.description: Hard, fatty, and filled with the tangiest spices found in the port of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Spicy Shrimp Soup
entries.description: Many a tavern in Baldur's Gate has its own version of this soup - to be eaten at your own risk.

entries.name: Spilled Mashed Potatoes
entries.description: Bits of grass and dirt adorn this pitiful scoop of mashed potatoes.

entries.name: Split Pea Soup
entries.description: A chunky soup made of mashed peas and smoked ham, sprinkled with just a tad too much pepper.

entries.name: Spoiled Treacle Tart
entries.description: So sweet you can barely taste the mould.

entries.name: Stale Bread
entries.description: Slightly leathery and starting to dry out, but better than an empty stomach.

entries.name: Stout Stew
entries.description: Food should not fit so snugly or so warmly in the gut - it's like a brothy hug!

entries.name: Succulent Pear
entries.description: Impossibly plump, this scrumptious pear looks hale and hearty.

entries.name: Sun-Dappled Paella
entries.description: The smell of the sea wafts gently from this warming, delicately spiced dish.

entries.name: Sunflower Seed Bun
entries.description: Never absent from a strongheart halfling's pantry, these little buns are ideal with a chunk of cheese or a bit of sausage.

entries.name: Sunmelon
entries.description: Sunmelon vines sprawl across gardens from the Chionthar to the Delimbiyr. The fruit is served fresh, pickled, or jellied.

entries.name: Sunmelon Half
entries.description: Sunmelon vines sprawl across gardens from the Chionthar to the Delimbiyr. The fruit is served fresh, pickled, or jellied.

entries.name: Sunmelon Piece
entries.description: Sunmelon vines sprawl across gardens from the Chionthar to the Delimbiyr. The fruit is served fresh, pickled, or jellied.

entries.name: Supply Pack
entries.description: A collection of cured meats, dried fruits, kindling, and anything else necessary to survive life on the road. Everything, down to the flint, smells distinctly of smoked ham.

entries.name: Suspicious Meat
entries.description: It would be best to believe that this is just a very tall, very skinny pig.

entries.name: Sweet Potato
entries.description: Roasted, steamed, candied, or fried - there are as many recipes for this versatile root as there are cultures in Faerûn.

entries.name: Tea
entries.description: The Turmishan herbs in this honey-coloured tea leave a light warmth on the tongue.

entries.name: Tomato
entries.description: This red fruit's bright flavour and plump texture make it popular for a variety of recipes, cooked or raw.

entries.name: Treacle Tart
entries.description: Sugary sweet breadcrumbs stick to whatever it touches.

entries.name: Turnip
entries.description: Easy to grow in the humid Sword Coast and even easier to carry around, turnips end up in many an adventurer's stew.

entries.name: Vegetable Broth
entries.description: A rich mix of vegetables, simmered for hours and topped with a piece of juicy tofu.

entries.name: Vegetable Soup
entries.description: A rich mix of vegetables, simmered for hours and topped with a piece of juicy tofu.

entries.name: Walnut
entries.description: The cautionary tale of Dennon Nosmile warns every eager young halfling on the Sword Coast against cracking walnut shells with their teeth.

entries.name: Waterdhavian Cheese Wedge
entries.description: Popular among travellers for its robust and sharp flavour, to say nothing of its peculiarly long shelf life.

entries.name: Waterdhavian Cheese Wheel
entries.description: Popular among travellers for its robust and sharp flavour, to say nothing of its peculiarly long shelf life.

entries.name: White Bread
entries.description: Crusty on the outside and soft on the inside, this bread fills your mouth with a rich, slightly sweet taste.

entries.name: White Mushroom
entries.description: Delicious when sautéed with a bit of garlic, cooked into a cream, or grilled with a slice of veal.

entries.name: Whole Chicken
entries.description: The plucked neck hangs floppily to one side, its dead eyes ever-so-slightly open.

entries.name: Arsonist's Oil
entries.description: 'It was then that Swires tossed the oil. It splattered the cambion, and all at once its skin of brilliant carmine dulled to dark, a red like cheap wine, and the fiend vented this sound of anguish I almost pitied, for its very affinity for fire was now undone.'

entries.name: Basic Poison
entries.description: Even when closed, a choking acrid smell emanates from this bottle.

entries.name: Crawler Mucus
entries.description: The base for this sticky membranous poison was scraped from the carapace of a carrion crawler.

entries.name: Diluted Oil of Sharpness
entries.description: The flecks of shimmering crystal suspended within this murky oil make it hum with arcane potential.

entries.name: Drow Poison
entries.description: Many drow cultivate poisons with religious fervour. After all, Lolth, their dread arachnid Goddess, is pleased by only the deadliest of concoctions.

entries.name: Karabasan's Poison
entries.description: The base for this sticky membranous poison was scraped from the carapace of a carrion crawler.

entries.name: Malice
entries.description: This vial contains a fine powder that resembles smoke when shaken - or tossed into an enemy's eyes.

entries.name: Oil of Accuracy
entries.description: This slick oil helps your weapon slip through the tiniest of cracks in an enemy's defences.

entries.name: Oil of Bane
entries.description: The cloying scent of this oil makes one feel foolish, ill-prepared, not quite worthy.

entries.name: Oil of Combustion
entries.description: 'Look, it's perfectly simple. You just coat the person in the oil, like so. Then you strike a match, like s- oh bugger.' - Bufort Iggles, The Unfortunate

entries.name: Oil of Diminution
entries.description: Gazing through the glass bottle, everything seems shrunken and contracted - almost gaunt.

entries.name: Oil of Sharpness
entries.description: Tiny silver shards give this clear, gelatinous substance an uneven sparkle.

entries.name: Purple Worm Toxin
entries.description: If the poison is potent enough, even the smallest pinprick can fugue the brain and turn the capillaries to shrivelled tubes.

entries.name: Serpent Fang Toxin
entries.description: From political assassinations to marital dysfunction, poison's got you covered.

entries.name: Simple Toxin
entries.description: The emerald hue of this toxin is vivid and baleful as a sunrise over a swamp.

entries.name: Thisobald's Brewed-Up Bellyglummer
entries.description: A truly despicable poison devised from an agglutination of corpse roses by the experimental mind of Thisobald Thorm.

entries.name: Wizardsbane Oil
entries.description: Symbols for the eight schools of magic fluctuate in this oil - one by one appearing and dissolving in the oil, as if devoured.

entries.name: Wyvern Toxin
entries.description: Shifting mercurially within its vial, the toxin holds a promise of swift and delectable death.

entries.name: Baby Blue and Gold Dye
entries.description: This gold evokes the piercings of the Adjudicators, dragonborn soldiers of Djerad Thymar.

entries.name: Black and Azure Dye
entries.description: The scales of a lightning-breathing dragon are this blue.

entries.name: Black and Furnace Red Dye
entries.description: Mixed from enchanted furnace coals from the forge of some legendary smith.

entries.name: Black and Jade Green Dye
entries.description: A dye so rich it evokes liquid jade held up to the sun.

entries.name: Black and Summer Green Dye
entries.description: This dye smells vaguely of mint and lime.

entries.name: Bloody Plum Dye
entries.description: The ingredients for this dye are impressively rare - tears from an empyrean, conveyed to this plane from Mount Celestia.

entries.name: Blue Dye
entries.description: This strong blue and yellow combination brings to mind a gala event in winter, with yellow dresses twirling and laughter on the air.

entries.name: Boreal Blue Dye
entries.description: During the goddess Auril's curse upon Icewind Dale, she shed enchanted snow upon the land - this dye is made from a fistful of those flakes.

entries.name: Brown Alabaster Dye
entries.description: Pillars of this colour can be found in the palaces of Chult's nobility.

entries.name: Cobalt Dye
entries.description: The very heavens at dusk, alight with stars and deepening through blues, could not be so vivid as this dye!

entries.name: Custard and Pink Rose Dye
entries.description: Figaro of Baldur's Gate invented this dye one day - he did not sleep for a fortnight, so anxious was he to get the pigment right.

entries.name: Dark Amethyst Dye
entries.description: The colour of an immeasurably expensive claret.

entries.name: Deep Lilac Dye
entries.description: Ironically made of magnolias and concentrated ethanol.

entries.name: Drake General Dye
entries.description: A dye created by Imperial Dyemaster Sigurd and his apprentice, Aurora, for those who wish to stride valiantly into a world rife with adventure.

entries.name: Dye Remover
entries.description: Using a universal solvent and a secret recipe coined by a hedge witch long ago, this dye remover just wipes those pesky colours right out.

entries.name: Faewild Green and Dun Dye
entries.description: Halfling foresters use this dye in their ghillie suits for camouflage.

entries.name: Gorgeous Maroon Dye
entries.description: In the Sea Ward in Waterdeep, Lady Cassalanter caused quite the stir at one of her famous parties while wearing this shade of dye in her dress.

entries.name: Green Dye
entries.description: A humble dye made from tree sap.

entries.name: Harlequin Black and White Dye
entries.description: The white of the moon, the black of courtly mischief.

entries.name: Indigo Dye
entries.description: A splash of this colour immediately communicates nobility.

entries.name: Jet and Pink Rose Dye
entries.description: These hues give the appearance of one of Luskan's dignitaries.

entries.name: Lime, Lemon, and Lichen Dye
entries.description: Despite the name, this dye's colour comes from pixie wings fluttering over old chicken coops - the eggs come out funky.

entries.name: Lush Burgundy
entries.description: The wealthiest courtiers, merchant princesses, and mesmerising princes wear this colour.

entries.name: Mellow Fruit Dye
entries.description: You'll look like you belong in a tree - not hanging like an extremely dead person, but rather dangling in a most enchanting fashion.

entries.name: Muddy Red Dye
entries.description: This is absolutely just mud and blood. Right?

entries.name: Ocean Dye
entries.description: Simple and charming as a trip to the seaside.

entries.name: Orange Dye
entries.description: Segments of tangerine and tiger eye.

entries.name: Pale Green Dye
entries.description: A simple dye made from crushed pellet-shaped insects.

entries.name: Pale Orange Dye
entries.description: Certainly very orange. Pumpkins live in envy of this dye.

entries.name: Pale Pink Dye
entries.description: Ah, the hue of heroes.

entries.name: Peach and Apricot Dye
entries.description: The most fruitful fashionistas of Toril use this dye.

entries.name: Pink and Leaf Green Dye
entries.description: Colours used by gnomish alderfolk to mark intelligence and guile.

entries.name: Purple Dye
entries.description: Shavings of a coatl's wing dissolved in natural acids.

entries.name: Red Dye
entries.description: One of the primary colours, and one you've seen a lot of, given your career choice.

entries.name: Sage Green Dye
entries.description: Green as good-smelling herbs in a cookpot.

entries.name: Sea Green Dye
entries.description: Cunning merrow preserve coral for a hundred years in a kind of aquatic stasis; when the coral emerges, it forms this dye.

entries.name: Sinful Red on Bone White
entries.description: Decorating your armour with this will make you look like a moon weeping bitter tears of blood.

entries.name: Swamp Green Dye
entries.description: This dye will make your clothes look like noxious, stagnant swampwater, and honestly that's so in right now.

entries.name: White and Scarlet Dye
entries.description: A very agreeable dye that evokes pale snow and fresh bloodshed.

entries.name: Yellow Dye
entries.description: This dye will make even iron shine like the sun.

entries.name: Elixir of Acid Resistance
entries.description: Despite its reputation as a chalky and unappetising brew, a pleasing effervescence makes this potion easy to drink.

entries.name: Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
entries.description: A small bottle, filled to the brim with arcane energy.

entries.name: Elixir of Barkskin
entries.description: Before your eyes, the elixir firms into a tough, striated twig, then it liquefies once more.

entries.name: Elixir of Battlemage's Power
entries.description: Derived from the eye of a mage-hunting Nothic, this elixir waxes from within with a piercing light.

entries.name: Elixir of Bloodlust
entries.description: Those willing to immerse themselves in savagery often reap a blood-red reward.

entries.name: Elixir of Cloud Giant Strength
entries.description: Angling this solution just so refracts the colours of sunrise within.

entries.name: Elixir of Cold Resistance
entries.description: This bottle feels warm, as if it's been sitting by a hearth.

entries.name: Elixir of Darkvision
entries.description: Enfolded in darkness, monsters and tucked-away treasures hide, glimpsed only by the naturally gifted, and, of course, whosoever imbibes this brackish elixir.

entries.name: Elixir of Dragonborn Prowess: Acid
entries.description: One of Blood Vendor Araj Obladra's elixirs, distilled from a specific sanguine quality, and with properties aligned to an equally specific race.

entries.name: Elixir of Dragonborn Prowess: Fire
entries.description: One of Blood Vendor Araj Obladra's elixirs, distilled from a specific sanguine quality, and with properties aligned to an equally specific race.

entries.name: Elixir of Dragonborn Prowess: Frost
entries.description: One of Blood Vendor Araj Obladra's elixirs, distilled from a specific sanguine quality, and with properties aligned to an equally specific race.

entries.name: Elixir of Dragonborn Prowess: Lightning
entries.description: One of Blood Vendor Araj Obladra's elixirs, distilled from a specific sanguine quality, and with properties aligned to an equally specific race.

entries.name: Elixir of Dragonborn Prowess: Poison
entries.description: One of Blood Vendor Araj Obladra's elixirs, distilled from a specific sanguine quality, and with properties aligned to an equally specific race.

entries.name: Elixir of Dwarven Resilience
entries.description: One of Blood Vendor Araj Obladra's elixirs, distilled from a specific sanguine quality, and with properties aligned to an equally specific race.

entries.name: Elixir of Elven Elegance
entries.description: One of Blood Vendor Araj Obladra's elixirs, distilled from a specific sanguine quality, and with properties aligned to an equally specific race.

entries.name: Elixir of Fire Resistance
entries.description: Pleasantly cool to the touch. A layer of frost coats the inside of the bottle.

entries.name: Elixir of Force Resistance
entries.description: The surface of this concoction remains remarkably still, no matter how much the bottle is agitated.

entries.name: Elixir of Githyanki Providence
entries.description: One of Blood Vendor Araj Obladra's elixirs, distilled from a specific sanguine quality, and with properties aligned to an equally specific race.

entries.name: Elixir of Gnomish Ingenuity
entries.description: One of Blood Vendor Araj Obladra's elixirs, distilled from a specific sanguine quality, and with properties aligned to an equally specific race.

entries.name: Elixir of Guileful Movement
entries.description: Though textured like half-frozen honey, this liquid flows as effortlessly as mercury.

entries.name: Elixir of Half-Elven Healing
entries.description: One of Blood Vendor Araj Obladra's elixirs, distilled from a specific sanguine quality, and with properties aligned to an equally specific race.

entries.name: Elixir of Half-Orcish Fury
entries.description: One of Blood Vendor Araj Obladra's elixirs, distilled from a specific sanguine quality, and with properties aligned to an equally specific race.

entries.name: Elixir of Halfling Luck
entries.description: One of Blood Vendor Araj Obladra's elixirs, distilled from a specific sanguine quality, and with properties aligned to an equally specific race.

entries.name: Elixir of Heroism
entries.description: Flasks filled with this potion are often passed around by soldiers at first light on the dawn of battle.

entries.name: Elixir of Hill Giant Strength
entries.description: A sliver of a hill giant's fingernail is suspended in this potion, and the foul stench renders it unpleasant to swallow.

entries.name: Elixir of Human Versatility
entries.description: One of Blood Vendor Araj Obladra's elixirs, distilled from a specific sanguine quality, and with properties aligned to an equally specific race.

entries.name: Elixir of Lightning Resistance
entries.description: This potion causes a tingling sensation in the extremities when consumed.

entries.name: Elixir of Necrotic Resistance
entries.description: Smells of fresh herbs and berries. Some say flowers placed within will bloom indefinitely.

entries.name: Elixir of Peerless Focus
entries.description: A spellcaster who cannot maintain their spells is about as useful as a chocolate kettle.

entries.name: Elixir of Poison Resistance
entries.description: Popular among politicians and adventurers alike.

entries.name: Elixir of Psychic Resistance
entries.description: This potion, reminiscent of whiskey in taste but not effect, is known to cause temporary ringing in the ears.

entries.name: Elixir of Radiant Resistance
entries.description: There's a hint of brimstone to this bubbling brew.

entries.name: Elixir of See Invisibility
entries.description: Beneath its vial of glass the liquid floods with colour, goes translucent, and becomes colourful once more - a pretty fluctuation.

entries.name: Elixir of the Colossus
entries.description: Instantly upon inhaling this elixir, your abdomen seems to swell, and the muscles in your back feel like sheets of hammer-beaten steel.

entries.name: Elixir of Thunder Resistance
entries.description: Despite its reputation as a chalky and unappetising brew, a pleasing effervescence makes this potion easy to drink.

entries.name: Elixir of Tiefling Vice
entries.description: One of Blood Vendor Araj Obladra's elixirs, distilled from a specific sanguine quality, and with properties aligned to an equally specific race.

entries.name: Elixir of Universal Resistance
entries.description: Thick as molten iron with a taste to match. Coats you from your throat to your fingertips.

entries.name: Elixir of Viciousness
entries.description: The syrupy liquid languidly swirling inside this bottle somehow reminds you of a predator lying in wait.

entries.name: Elixir of Vigilance
entries.description: An acrid, coppery aroma wafts from this liquid, clearing the senses and honing awareness.

entries.name: Greater Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
entries.description: From hedge wizards to high priests, these elixirs are coveted by spellcasters of any ilk.

entries.name: Superior Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
entries.description: Even through the thick glass, the arcane energy contained within this bottle makes your fingers tingle.

entries.name: Supreme Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
entries.description: It is said that the glimmer in this elixir is the reflection of light on the Weave itself.

entries.name: Tadpole Elixir
entries.description: Stimulates the pineal gland in the brain, unlocking malevolent power.

entries.name: Acid Vial
entries.description: The liquid bubbles slightly as it dissolves any impurities on the inner glass.

entries.name: Alchemist's Fire
entries.description: Shapes swirl and glow behind the glass, liquid embers folding into and around each other.

entries.name: Brilliant Retort
entries.description: All the bang and the boom of the original, but with an extra surprise.

entries.name: Caustic Bulb
entries.description: Soft to the touch and covered with a thin layer of colourless slime.

entries.name: Concussion Grenade
entries.description: Deals Fire and Thunder damage to nearby objects and knocks them back.

entries.name: Flammable Slime Bomb
entries.description: A soft ball of orange slime. It burns uncomfortably hot in your hand.

entries.name: Flashblinder
entries.description: Gyroscopic whispers emanate from the device - gnomish machinery speaks with a metal tongue.

entries.name: Fungal Bamboozler
entries.description: Inhaling the wrong spores can dissolve even the sharpest intellect into fizzing confusion.

entries.name: Grease Bottle
entries.description: The pale sludge within this bottle doesn't pour easily, oozing out in fatty clumps instead.

entries.name: Haste Spore Flask
entries.description: Thousands of white spores buzz against the glass, impatient to be released.

entries.name: Haste Spore Grenade
entries.description: An alchemical concoction practically buzzing with potential energy.

entries.name: Hearthlight Bomb
entries.description: Now and again, a small ball of light flickers in the dark liquid, like the reflection of some alien yet sweet star on the darkest ocean.

entries.name: Holy Water
entries.description: A splash of the sacred for those in need.

entries.name: Iron Flask
entries.description: A flask that can hold friends and foes. Likely to make the former the latter.

entries.name: Jug of Water
entries.description: Slightly cloudy, but safe to drink.

entries.name: Karabasan's Gift
entries.description: A strong paralytic poison.

entries.name: Merregon Potion
entries.description: A potion brewed by the merregons to charm a displacer beast. This batch seems weaker and might only addle the mind.

entries.name: Noxious Spore Grenade
entries.description: A rank, roiling stench emanates from this alchemical concoction.

entries.name: Oil Flask
entries.description: This bottle was filled haphazardly - the outside is sticky with dried oil.

entries.name: Orthon Explosive
entries.description: Deals Fire and Thunder damage to nearby objects and knocks them back.

entries.name: Phase Optimizer
entries.description: Grant nearby Steel Watchers an additional <LSTag Tooltip="Action">action</LSTag> with roiling arcana.

entries.name: Poisonous Slime Bomb
entries.description: A soft ball of green slime. Thick drops slide down your fingers, stinging your skin.

entries.name: Reflectoguard
entries.description: Gortash's reflectoguard applies a condition that reflects all incoming projectiles back at their source.

entries.name: Sanguine Explosive
entries.description: Create a surface of blood.

entries.name: Scrap and Shrapnel Grenade
entries.description: A makeshift grenade that unleashes a storm of scrap metal upon detonation.

entries.name: Smokepowder Bomb
entries.description: This explosive gnomish invention is packed tight with smokepowder.

entries.name: Spiked Bulb
entries.description: A sticky, sap-like substance trickles down the spikes of this bulb.

entries.name: Squidjins
entries.description: Powders mixed with Baffled Squid ink create a mesmerising burst of colour.

entries.name: Surprise-Based Teddy Bear
entries.description: This teddy bear toy is stuffed with explosives. Still adorable.

entries.name: Void Bulb
entries.description: The numerous suction cups on this ball expand and constrict rhythmically, as if breathing - they latch on to anything they can get hold of.

entries.name: Volo's Jar of Moustache Wax
entries.description: The pale sludge within this bottle doesn't pour easily, oozing out in fatty clumps instead.

entries.name: Web Grenade
entries.description: This tangle of webs pulses with expectant magic, eager to unfurl at a moment's notice.

entries.name: Wogglims
entries.description: One of Oddfire's better inventions, this firework bursts with a gorgeous crackle.

entries.name: A Mother's Loathing
entries.description: A hint of blood lingers around the stopper. It's enough to make your mouth water.

entries.name: Antidote
entries.description: This concoction appears rather chewable, thick as it is with herbs and roots.

entries.name: Basilisk Oil
entries.description: Extracted from a basilisk's gullet, this thick, grey oil swirls slowly in its container.

entries.name: Boon of the Hag
entries.description: A hint of blood lingers around the stopper. It's enough to make your mouth water.

entries.name: Bottled Breath
entries.description: The howl of wind can be heard within this lightly vibrating bottle.

entries.name: Broken Promises
entries.description: A parasite swims in the bottom of this bottle, fat with strength.

entries.name: Butterflies in the Stomach
entries.description: A traditional brew of ergot and nutmeg, meant to recapture the fluttering thrill of first love.

entries.name: Cup of Water
entries.description: Because one can't live on ale alone.

entries.name: Duergar Antidote
entries.description: Concocted of rare ingredients that hasten the drinker's demise unless mixed correctly.

entries.name: Elixir of Health
entries.description: An effective cure-all for physical ailments.

entries.name: Eternal Carafe of Wine (Or Sometimes Acid)
entries.description: Each morning, this carafe refills with wine. Sometimes, however, instead of wine, it refills with indigestible acid.
entries.wikiTitle: Eternal Carafe of Wine (Or Sometimes Acid)

entries.name: Faltering Will
entries.description: A sweet, intoxicating aroma hangs around this bottle. It reminds you of home.

entries.name: Heart of Stone
entries.description: Fragments of malachite swirl at the bottom of this potion, coalescing and separating rhythmically.

entries.name: Insanity's Kiss
entries.description: Something thrashes in this heavy gourd, consumed by rage.
