entries.name: Lost Time
entries.description: Its seal is dry and cracked with age, yet the clear potion within bears no signs of spoilage.

entries.name: Lover's Avarice
entries.description: A rotten pungency undercuts this potion's otherwise pleasant aroma of roses and honey.

entries.name: Missing Pets
entries.description: Thousands of little legs skitter inside this bottle, seeking an escape.

entries.name: Mysterious Elixir
entries.description: The anonymous liquid in this draft is not viscous but moves with an unusual lethargy when tilted.

entries.name: Oil of Slipperiness
entries.description: This sticky black unguent is thick and heavy in the container, but flows quickly when poured.

entries.name: Potion of Angelic Reprieve
entries.description: The motion of the shimmering liquid going back and forth in its vial is somnambulant - you know drinking it will bring the comfort of a warm, enveloping blanket.

entries.name: Potion of Angelic Slumber
entries.description: One of the few ways for elves to experience sleep. Other methods include taking narcotics and being hit very hard with a chair.

entries.name: Potion of Animal Speaking
entries.description: A heady aroma of hay, musk, and manure greets your nose upon opening the bottle.

entries.name: Potion of Everlasting Vigour
entries.description: A reward received from biting Araj Oblodra. Vampirism has sometimes been called The Dark Gift, or the Dark Kiss, perhaps as an allusion to their forbidden relationship to sunshine. It does provide gifts in abundance; such is the case with this potion.

entries.name: Potion of Feather Fall
entries.description: Tossing this vial from hand to hand, it seems to glide, suspended in motion, before coming to rest gently in your palm.

entries.name: Potion of Flying
entries.description: This potion is so light, you feel that if you tossed it high, it might float like a lilypad on the pond of the air.

entries.name: Potion of Gaseous Form
entries.description: Consuming this potion feels more like swallowing vapour than liquid.

entries.name: Potion of Glorious Vaulting
entries.description: Lupperdiddle Swires, Gnomish Adventurer, could reportedly jump twenty feet in the air. He was about the size of a bantam hen.

entries.name: Potion of Greater Healing
entries.description: A draught for curing moderate injuries.

entries.name: Potion of Healing
entries.description: A draught for curing minor cuts and bruises.

entries.name: Potion of Invisibility
entries.description: You'd think this bottle was empty but for the sound of sloshing liquid from within.

entries.name: Potion of Mind Reading
entries.description: Fragments of memory and perception smatter this liquid - a crude constellation of thought.

entries.name: Potion of Sleep
entries.description: Hypnotic patterns swirl within this hazy potion.

entries.name: Potion of Speed
entries.description: This solution ripples and splashes of its own accord, almost like it's trying to escape the bottle.

entries.name: Potion of Superior Healing
entries.description: A draught for curing serious injuries.

entries.name: Potion of Supreme Healing
entries.description: A draught for healing life-threatening injuries.

entries.name: Potion of Vitality
entries.description: A coveted restorative for the adventurer on their last legs.

entries.name: Remedial Potion
entries.description: A coveted restorative for the adventurer on their last legs.

entries.name: Wilted Dreams
entries.description: Smells like a sleep potion turned sour.

entries.name: Scroll of Conjure Elemental
entries.description: Bend the barrier between the Planes until they disgorge an elemental ally to follow and fight for you.

entries.name: Scroll of Conjure Minor Elemental
entries.description: Conjure a minor elemental to fight alongside you.

entries.name: Scroll of Protection from Evil and Good
entries.wikiTitle: Scroll of Protection from Evil and Good

entries.name: Scroll of Summon Quasit
entries.description: Inky notes slash across the margin of this particular scroll, the angle of the handwriting suggesting urgency. Perhaps warning.

entries.name: Scroll of True Resurrection
entries.description: Resurrect a companion. They return to life with all of their <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">hit points</LSTag>.

entries.name: Signed Trade Visa
entries.description: A visa promising safe passage to Baldur's Gate, stamped with the letters 'GT'.

entries.name: A Breakthrough at Last
entries.description: This book is redolent with the enticing smell of paper and ink.

entries.name: A Brush with Evil: On Hags
entries.description: Part of a series examining some of Faerûn's more infamous creatures, this exploration on hags remains one of Soot's most popular works.
entries.wikiTitle: A Brush with Evil: On Hags

entries.name: A Hunter's Guide to Hags
entries.description: A beautiful manuscript made from expensive, high-quality parchment.

entries.description: A collection of children's rhymes about the gods Amaunator, Asmodeus, and Auril.

As in geometrics, the triangular shape proves more stable than any linear or other structure, and the wearer of this crown feels - exquisite and tenebrous - the will to dominate flowing through them.

entries.description: Despite fitting easily in your hand, this rough stone has a good weight to it.

entries.name: Icy Crystal
entries.description: This crystal is freezing to the touch, no matter how long you hold it. Shallow grooves run along the bottom, as if it used to be attached to something.

entries.name: Icy Helve
entries.description: The ice-cold handle of what must once have been a staff. A single screw sticks out from the top.

entries.name: Icy Metal
entries.description: Specks of frost cover the hole in the bottom of this chunky piece of iron, where it was clearly screwed onto something.

entries.name: Idol of Selûne
entries.description: A statue of Selûne, Our Lady of Silver, the Moonmaiden, gazing quietly at the world.

entries.name: Idol of Shar
entries.description: Carved from black marble, this effigy is as terrible and perfect as the Lady of Loss herself.

entries.name: Idol of Silvanus
entries.description: A wooden statue of Silvanus, the Oak Father, god of nature and its impartial fairness. Those near the idol seem to better understand the natural world.

entries.name: Infernal Alloy
entries.description: The ridges in this metal glow faintly, drawing your gaze. The longer you watch its hellish pulsations, the harder it is to remember who and where you are.

entries.name: Infernal Iron
entries.description: This dented piece of black metal has a red shine to it, no matter the lighting. Faint screams echo through your mind whenever you touch it.

entries.name: Infernal Metal
entries.description: Something about this scrap of metal calls out to you, as though it yearns to pierce your mind, your body - perhaps your soul.

entries.name: Mithral Ore
entries.description: Rough, unprocessed and raw - this mithral ore is ready to be fed into the forge.

entries.name: Mother Dearest
entries.description: They really are still close...

entries.name: Music Box
entries.description: Spinning the handle turns a mechanism within this contraption, plinking out a simple tune.

entries.name: Shaft of a Broken Spear
entries.description: The remainder of a spear shaft, snapped cleanly in the middle.

entries.name: Shovel (item)

entries.description: A humanoid brain - alive and in perfect condition - suspended in cerebrospinal fluid.

entries.name: Sponge

entries.name: Soap Bar

entries.name: Sponge Tray

entries.description: With the forest's illusion dispelled, this apple's lethal nature has become readily apparent.

entries.name: Rotten Banana
entries.description: Little is left of this banana but patches of brown skin and mush.

entries.name: Rotten Beregost Blue Wedge
entries.description: Though Beregost cheese is known for its tangy taste and veins of mould, this particular piece might have fermented for a little too long.

entries.name: Rotten Beregost Blue Wheel
entries.description: Usually known for its peculiar tangy smell, this cheese wheel gives off a distinctively sour smell.

entries.name: Rotten Carrot
entries.description: A bendy carrot, suffused with light and dark splotches.

entries.name: Rotten Chicken Eggs
entries.description: The choking stench of sulphur wafts from these slimy green eggs.

entries.name: Rotten Durinbold Cheese Wedge
entries.description: Dozens of minuscule worms cover the surface of this cheese wedge

entries.name: Rotten Fish
entries.description: A layer of putrid slime covers this fish's scales.

entries.name: Rotten Lemon
entries.description: This shrivelled lemon is covered almost entirely in white and green mould.

entries.name: Rotten Mushroom
entries.description: Slimy and mouldy, this mushroom smells strongly of rotting leaves.

entries.name: Rotten Tomato
entries.description: A putrid slime drips from this mouldy tomato.

entries.name: Rotten Waterdhavian Cheese Wedge
entries.description: Hard as a rock, green, and smelly, this cheese is more hazard than food.

entries.name: Rotten Waterdhavian Cheese Wheel
entries.description: This once-delicious chunk of cheese now smells of sorrow and regrets.

entries.name: Suspicious Poison
entries.description: Don't be fooled - this 'potion' will leave you worse for wear.

entries.name: Wine Goblet
entries.description: This dwarven-crafted goblet may be empty of wine, but it's full of promise.

entries.name: Akabi's Old Lamp
entries.description: This lamp is empty, yet emanates the distinct smell of old socks.

entries.name: Aloe Oil
entries.description: Made from the succulent flowering plant, this oil is about as useful on your journey as a false nose to a clown protest group.

entries.name: Anomalous Coral
entries.description: This bone-like contraption is slightly moist.

entries.name: Ball
entries.description: The exterior of this toy ball is rough with tooth marks.

entries.name: Ballista Arrow
entries.description: The product of a fletcher's fine work, meant to be fired from a bow.

entries.name: Barbed Device
entries.description: The surface of this contraption has the consistency of dried phlegm.

entries.name: Barber Shears
entries.description: Its blades have been worn dull from years of use.

entries.name: Bear Claw
entries.description: Tough as steel, this bear claw is still deadly.

entries.name: Bed Linen
entries.description: Though rough and threadbare, these linens were folded with care.

entries.name: Bedroll
entries.description: The thick fur lining of this traveller's bedding is lightly stained with dirt.

entries.name: Bellows
entries.description: Despite the splintered wood and cracked bag, these bellows still emit a considerable wheeze of air.

entries.name: Blacksmith's Tongs
entries.description: Numerous dips into fire and oil have given the tips of these tongs a coppery sheen.

entries.name: Blood-Filled Bowl
entries.description: Someone has used this bowl to store a disembowelled frog, bathing in its own blood and intestines.

entries.name: Bone
entries.description: This bone - part of a leg, or perhaps an arm - is clean of blood and sinew.

entries.name: Bottle
entries.description: A mysterious liquid has dried to the bottom of this bottle.

entries.name: Bottled Blooms
entries.description: Encased safely in glass, these beautiful petals continue to blossom.

entries.name: Bottled Eye
entries.description: An eye floats in the oily liquid, moving only when jostled.

entries.name: Bottled Solvent
entries.description: A foul-smelling, oily liquid that shimmers in the light.

entries.name: Bottled Tentacles
entries.description: A long jar, packed full of severed tentacles. It's unclear if they're from a sea creature or something more sinister.

entries.name: Bowl
entries.description: A modest wooden bowl.

entries.name: Brain
entries.description: This sticky, greying mass exudes a slightly sweet, putrid odour.

entries.name: Broken Cane
entries.description: This splintering cane has struck enough victims to have cracked from overuse.

entries.name: Bronze Keg
entries.description: Unidentifiable bits of food are dried into the spigot affixed to this large pot.

entries.name: Broom
entries.description: This broom's stiff bristles are frayed from use.

entries.name: Bucket
entries.description: A red liquid coats the bottom of this bucket. It smells of rust.

entries.name: Bucket of Water
entries.description: Filled with murky water.

entries.name: Canteen
entries.description: A portable container favoured by travellers and adventurers. Great for water, better for spirits.

entries.name: Charcoal
entries.description: A necessary staple for any component pouch.

entries.name: Clamshell
entries.description: A quick shake sends this mollusc's imperfect pearl rattling around within its hinged shell.

entries.name: Conch Shell
entries.description: Despite its stony feel, this hollow shell is quite fragile.

entries.name: Cooking Pot
entries.description: A pot large enough to serve a dozen or more.

entries.name: Copper Brazier
entries.description: A hefty copper brazier, decorated with filigreed flowers and cording.

entries.name: Copper Coin Pile
entries.description: This pile of copper coins smells faintly blood-like.

entries.name: Copper Plate
entries.description: A simple but luxurious plate, made of hammered copper.

entries.name: Crystal Ball
entries.description: Dim light haunts the inside of this heavy crystal ball, as though something inside waits to be called upon.

entries.name: Cup
entries.description: An unassuming cup, slightly chipped and scuffed.

entries.name: Cutting Board
entries.description: This thick slab of wood is criss-crossed with countless knife marks.

entries.name: Daggerroot Bundle
entries.description: Known as 'the executioner's garnish', this herb flourishes in blood-fed soil and has flavoured countless final meals.

entries.name: Definitely a Broom of Flying
entries.description: This magical broom bestows the power of flight to winged beings. Warning: chickens not included.

entries.name: Doo
entries.description: A new stuffed friend for Karlach, loved beyond repair.

entries.name: Drinking Horn
entries.description: This hollowed-out rothé horn reeks of stale beer.

entries.name: Earthen Bottle
entries.description: A dirty brown bottle, seemingly made out of clay and clumps of hair.

entries.name: Empty Brain Jar
entries.description: The limp body of a parasite is just visible in the container's murky depths.

entries.name: Empty Potion Bottle
entries.description: An alchemist's bottle of modest size.

entries.name: Empty Potion of Sleep
entries.description: This potion of sleep is empty.

entries.name: Ettvard Needle's Silver Presentation Inkwell
entries.description: This container of crystal and polished brass is filled near to the brim with coal-black ink.

entries.name: Fishing Rod
entries.description: Rusted and slick with grime. The lure may be more valuable than the rod itself.

entries.name: Fish Skeleton
entries.description: These bones have been picked clean of every scrap of flesh.

entries.name: Fork (item)
entries.description: The tines of this fork have clearly been bent and reshaped into place many times.

entries.name: Ghastly Bottle
entries.description: Ghastly Bottle

entries.name: Gilded Mortar and Pestle
entries.description: Gilded tools are no luxury for any serious alchemist. While wood is hard to clean, metal often binds to its contents, sometimes with disastrous consequences. A thin layer of gold solves both these problems.

entries.name: Glass Chalice
entries.description: A smooth chalice fabricated by gnome artisans.

entries.name: Glass Cup
entries.description: Gnomes are known to melt and reshape their glass shards, resulting in this cup's distinct green tint.

entries.name: Goblet
entries.description: Artlessly made from cheap materials, this goblet has likely held more grog than expensive wines.

entries.name: Goblet With Dead Tadpoles
entries.description: This alloyed goblet is embossed with writhing tadpoles.

entries.name: Fuzzy
entries.description: This bear - oft-torn and repaired - seems one good squeeze away from crumbling into mouldered stuffing and threadbare patchwork.

entries.name: Halsin's Pipe
entries.description: A wooden pipe, worn smooth with age and use. It still smells faintly of some exotic tobacco.

entries.name: Hammer
entries.description: The varnish of this hammer's handle has been worn dull by callused hands.

entries.name: Hollow Shell
entries.description: The inside of this shell is smooth and hard, like coloured glass.

entries.name: Horn Shell
entries.description: This shell's geometric whorls come to a deceptively sharp point.

entries.name: Hourglass
entries.description: Sand steadily slips down the glass tube, each grain marking the passage of time as if it were nothing.

entries.name: Incense Bowl
entries.description: A heat-fast ceramic bowl. Smudges of ash still linger within.

entries.name: Ink Pot
entries.description: Often used and refilled - the sides are a mess of inky stains.

entries.name: Ink Pot and Quill
entries.description: The quill is frayed and the ink is runny. Not of high quality.

entries.name: Intestines
entries.description: Maggots and flies cover the opened legs, crawling over and under each other in search for a place to feed.

entries.name: Iridescent Shell
entries.description: Though mounted on a pair of sturdy, rough feet, this iridescent shell seems to change shape depending on the light.

entries.name: Iron Bowl
entries.description: A layer of rust fills this bowl's delicate filigree.

entries.name: Iron Pan
entries.description: A thousand cookfires have left this pan heavily scorched.

entries.name: Kanon's Handkerchief
entries.description: Its owner frequently insisted he didn't need this hand-cut linen square, but his sister kept it to hand in case his allergies kicked up.

entries.name: Knife
entries.description: The flat of this knife is shiny enough to use as a mirror.

entries.name: Ladle
entries.description: A metal ladle, deep enough to fill a bowl with a single scoop.

entries.name: Large Bottle
entries.description: A thick glass bottle commonly used in breweries.

entries.name: Lid
entries.description: This lid's rim is coated with a film of dried milk.

entries.name: Lukasz
entries.description: This bear - oft-torn and repaired - seems one good squeeze away from crumbling into mouldered stuffing and threadbare patchwork.

entries.name: Makeshift Ladle
entries.description: The eyes of this hollowed-out dwarven skull have been filled with clay, but rivulets of some liquid or another have seeped through the cracks, staining the jaw like tears.

entries.name: Mamzell Amira's Gilded Hand Mirror
entries.description: This handheld mirror has seen better days.

entries.name: Metal Fork
entries.description: This two-tined fork is begging to be plunged into a slab of meat.

entries.name: Milk Can
entries.description: Smells a bit sour.

entries.name: Mirror (Clutter)
entries.description: This handheld mirror has seen better days.

entries.name: Moon Brooch
entries.description: This brooch of sculpted gold bears the sigil of Selûne - the waxing moon.

entries.name: Mug
entries.description: Worn smooth by warmed hands.

entries.name: Needle
entries.description: Rust and dirt coat this fine-tipped needle.

entries.name: Oil Lamp
entries.description: The sides of this brass lamp are shinier than the rest, as if they've been repeatedly rubbed.

entries.name: Pan
entries.description: A fine implement, well-scoured and polished.

entries.name: Pile of Stained Towels
entries.description: This heavy linen fabric is soaked in blood.

entries.name: Potion Bottle
entries.description: An empty bottle fashioned from leather, clay, and hair.

entries.name: Quill
entries.description: A long, sharpened feather plucked from the wing of a goose.

entries.name: Rags
entries.description: These rags carry a faint greyish odour that all old clothes seem to carry with them - a whiff like the dust off moth wings.

entries.name: Ribcage (Clutter)
entries.description: Though separated from the hips and skull, this ribcage is still in pristine condition.

entries.name: Rothé Femur
entries.description: Tiny hairline fractures spread across this giant bone.

entries.name: Rope
entries.description: A length of strong, hand-braided rope.

entries.name: Rotting Basket
entries.description: Rugged, moist, and split in places, this basket seems about ready to fall apart.

entries.name: Round Flask
entries.description: A thick glass bottle, meticulously shaped to resist fire and distribute heat evenly.

entries.name: Scale
entries.description: Likely to be seen balancing coin in a market stall or flour in a baker's kitchen.

entries.name: Serving Spoon
entries.description: Brings to mind savoury stews and buttered vegetables.

entries.name: Severed Arm
entries.description: Heavy and slick with sweat and blood, this arm has a tendency to slip out of your hands.

entries.name: Severed Eye
entries.description: Tiny veins and ruptured muscle still cling to the back of this eye.

entries.name: Severed Foot
entries.description: This foot has been roughly chopped off at the ankle.

entries.name: Severed Hand
entries.description: The few remaining fingers on this hand have grown pallid, cold, and stiff.

entries.name: Severed Head
entries.description: The severed head of a young woman. The jaw is ripped off, locking her face in an eternal, bloody scream.

entries.name: Severed Leg
entries.description: Deep, purple bruises bloom on the putrid flesh wherever you touch this leg.

entries.name: Severed Legs
entries.description: Deep, purple bruises bloom on the putrid flesh wherever you touch the leg.

entries.name: Severed Pelvis
entries.description: Maggots and flies cover the opened legs, crawling over and under each other in search for a place to feed.

entries.name: Severed Torso
entries.description: A large maggot crawls out of a hole in the bloated abdomen.

entries.name: Shears
entries.description: Its blades have been worn dull from years of use.

entries.name: Shovel's Friend-Finder
entries.description: Just because it is pitted with rust doesn't mean it isn't ideal for digging up new friends.

entries.name: Skull
entries.description: The top of this skull is cracked with a lattice of shallow fractures.

entries.name: Skull (No Jaw)
entries.description: Missing its bottom jaw. And its body.

entries.name: Small Shovel
entries.description: Easy to transport - or hide.

entries.name: Sodalite Shell
entries.description: The blue streaks lining this shell secrete a sweet-smelling slime.

entries.name: Spatula
entries.description: Numerous burns hint that this spatula's previous owner was a careless cook.

entries.name: Spoon
entries.description: A heavy spoon inlaid with gold accents.

entries.name: Stained Towel
entries.description: This heavy linen fabric is soaked in blood.

entries.name: Stained Towels Pile
entries.description: This heavy linen fabric is soaked in blood.

entries.name: Starfish
entries.description: Striking in colour and shape, this five-pointed creature is commonly found clinging to waterside rocks.

entries.name: Stuffed Bear
entries.description: A knitted toy bear stuffed with soft fur.

entries.name: Stuffed Bear (Faded)
entries.description: This bear - oft-torn and repaired - seems one good squeeze away from crumbling into mouldered stuffing and threadbare patchwork.

entries.name: Stuffed Owlbear Toy
entries.description: Though threadbare and slightly dirty, this stuffed toy is soft and comforting, like a warm hug.

entries.name: Tin Plate
entries.description: This plate was hammered thin enough to bend with bare hands.

entries.name: Toad Teapot
entries.description: Incredibly lifelike, down to the last wart.

entries.name: Tongs
entries.description: These tongs are fire-scorched and pitted with rust.

entries.name: Towel
entries.description: This heavy linen fabric is unadorned, but pleasantly soft to the touch.

entries.name: Toy Block
entries.description: Letters and shapes are carved into the painted sides of this wooden block.

entries.name: Unfinished Stuffed Bear
entries.description: A knitted toy bear stuffed with soft fur. It has a dimple chin and is stitched with the name Godwillington.

entries.name: Unfinished Toy
entries.description: This teddy bear toy has been decapitated. Inside some mechanical parts are visible. How joyous.

entries.name: Valeria's Snuff
entries.description: This glass phial has been scrubbed clean of its former contents.

entries.name: Valeria's Spare Pipe
entries.description: Tusk-chewed and bent slightly to sit neatly under a trunk, this pipe has seen a great deal of the city's craven underbelly.

entries.name: Valeria's Trunk Balm
entries.description: A mysterious liquid has dried to the bottom of this bottle.

entries.name: Vase (Clutter)
entries.description: While plain, this vase has a glazed finish, giving it a luxurious sheen.

entries.name: Vial of Blood
entries.description: Blackened drops of blood have coagulated on the outside of the bottle and stained its stopper.

entries.name: Wooden Bowl
entries.description: Lumps of a sticky black substance line the inside of this plain bowl.

entries.name: Wooden Spoon
entries.description: Flecks of dried porridge are embedded within the grains of wood.

entries.name: Worg Dung
entries.description: A wet, dark heap of dung with the sharp stench of rotting meat. Still slightly warm.

entries.name: Whittled Duck
entries.description: A duck whittled out of wood. It smells of the deep forest.

entries.name: Withered Blue Petal
entries.description: An exotic gossamer petal, faded and blue. It smells faintly of honey.

entries.name: Withered Sussur Petal
entries.description: A gossamer petal, all that remains of a sussur bloom when drained of its energy or exposed to surface air.

entries.name: Gold
entries.description: You can find a dozen different currencies in Faerûn, but everyone accepts gold.

entries.name: Bronze Ingot
entries.description: A small but heavy bar of untempered bronze, manufactured at the High House of Gond.

entries.name: Gold Ingot
entries.description: A small but heavy bar of untempered gold, manufactured at the High House of Gond.

entries.name: Mithral Ingot
entries.description: A small but heavy bar of exquisite mithral, manufactured at the High House of Gond.

entries.name: Silver Ingot
entries.description: A small but heavy bar of untempered silver, manufactured at the High House of Gond.

entries.name: Agate
entries.description: A fine stone for carving, often found at the base of volcanoes.

entries.name: Amethyst
entries.description: Brilliant, purple, and rumoured to drive away oni.

entries.name: Black Diamond
entries.description: Dark as Shar's cruel embrace.

entries.name: Bloodstone
entries.description: Anyone can squeeze blood from a stone if the edges are sharp enough.

entries.name: Diamond
entries.description: Sparkles brighter than Selûne's Tears in the night sky.

entries.name: Emerald
entries.description: It's said when Shar walks upon the earth, she leaves a path of onyx behind her.

entries.name: Infernal Diamond
entries.description: Supplies power to the House of Hope.

entries.name: Jacinth
entries.description: Sunlight dances off this pale golden gem, as if it were alive.

entries.name: Jade
entries.description: A precious mineral from the Sea of Fallen Stars, cherished by sovereigns and stonecarvers alike.

entries.name: Keepsake Gem
entries.description: A small gemstone, dulled by decades of handling by nervous fingers. A small rune has been scrupulously carved into its tip.

entries.name: Malachite
entries.description: Parents slip these stones under their children's pillows to ward off nightmares.

entries.name: Onyx
entries.description: It's said when Shar walks upon the earth, she leaves a path of onyx behind her.

entries.name: Pearl
entries.description: Perfectly round and ever-so-slightly pink.

entries.name: Peridot
entries.description: Green as poison, but no more dangerous than a pebble.

entries.name: Purple Fluorite Shard
entries.description: A common Underdark crystal, fluorite seems to form anywhere where light is scarce, though only bigger stones are suitable for mining.

entries.name: Ruby
entries.description: A deep burgundy colour, this stone seems to trap all light.

entries.name: Sapphire
entries.description: It is said kissing a sapphire will help you keep any secret - no matter how grave the sin.

entries.name: Archibald Ravenshade
entries.description: A master of sonnets and plays about ambition, supernatural tensions with the natural world, avarice, love, and moving bushes.

entries.name: Aspen Lamentation
entries.description: Half-submerged in the earth and swallowed in moss, an effigy basks strangely sad in the gorgeous golden aspens, yellow with autumn and sunshine.

entries.name: Blank Canvas
entries.description: A plain cotton cloth, full of possibilities.

entries.name: Beach at Dusk
entries.description: Sunset touches the bluffs, the beach, and the pink-blue waves lapping at the shore.

entries.name: Butterfly on Skull
entries.description: Difficult to imagine how the artist got the bloody butterfly to stay there for so long...

entries.name: Cabin in Motion
entries.description: The 'in motion' here is curious. What does the artist mean by that? What could be in motion here, in such a still scene?

entries.name: Clerebold Rillyn
entries.description: Staring superciliously, this young child is clad in the finest plate, sheets of steel slotted together expertly.

entries.name: Condemnation
entries.description: Harrowing and beautiful and terrible. What does it condemn, though?

entries.name: Elegant Blush-Filled Portrait
entries.description: Swan-necked and very lovely withal, this particular blushing maiden is keenly embarrassed - perhaps she didn't much care to be depicted in paint.

entries.name: Elven Eminence
entries.description: The artist has exaggerated the points of the ears, which seem to cut the canvas dark like pale knives. The garb and crossed hands of this eminent man are beautiful, poised, and utterly indicative of means.

entries.name: Envoys at Table
entries.description: Contemporary, fresh, and very valuable, this piece is believed by savants on the art scene to be something special, perhaps a masterpiece that will marshal in a new genre-based movement.

entries.name: Ernest Tillerturn
entries.description: Even with the addition of her lute, the C chord strumming out sensuously from the canvas to the ear, this young woman still looks immensely, disconsolately bored.

entries.name: Fake Portrait of a Noble Before His Death
entries.description: A counterfeit piece of art.
entries.wikiTitle: Fake Portrait of a Noble Before His Death

entries.name: Full Body Depiction of a Tiefling
entries.description: Here a tiefling noble is shown at rest, knuckles pressed to red-fleshed cheek like a roosting robin whose fiery breast has burned to encompass the bird.
entries.wikiTitle: Full Body Depiction of a Tiefling

entries.name: Gilbert Irlentree
entries.description: Darkly garbed and ruffed, this noble arches his brows at the onlooker, as if expecting you to do something interesting.

entries.name: Grand Infernal Painting
entries.description: Rendered with sumptuous skill, great gouting bleed seeming to squirt and dribble and spill like wine from drunk lips, the violence impeccable, the tangled quality sublime.

entries.name: Grass House
entries.description: Rich blankets of grass waft up the slopes, shivering softly.

entries.name: Graveyard Coiler
entries.description: A serpent slithers through the eye socket of a rotting skull, its green slimy skin leaving a trail on the nearby bones.

entries.name: Harrowing Painting
entries.description: Harrowing and beautiful and terrible. What does it condemn, though?

entries.name: Landscape
entries.description: In this scene a brook flows over stones into a large river cutting like a misty serpent through a series of sloping valleys.

entries.name: Maid with Duster
entries.description: Here a woman holds her duster with both hands, as if marketing it, not for consumption or purchase, but for appreciation of its fluffy purposeful shape so adroit at wiping away uncleanliness (a useful juxtaposition for the cleanliness of the image).

entries.name: Nobleman Regards Us
entries.description: Darkly garbed and ruffed, this noble arches his brows at the onlooker, as if expecting you to do something interesting.

entries.name: Oval Framed Elven Eminence
entries.description: The artist has exaggerated the points of the ears, which seem to cut the canvas dark like pale knives. The garb and crossed hands of this eminent man are beautiful, poised, and utterly indicative of means.

entries.name: Painting of Gortash
entries.description: Displaced and waterfalling from bright and evocative pigments to diffuse greys and whites, this rendition of Enver Gortash shows a boyish, mischievous face wreathed in sunshine and the finest raiment.

entries.name: Painting of a Noble Before His Death
entries.description: The portrait done after his death involved no imperious glares, and much more rigor mortis.
entries.wikiTitle: Painting of a Noble Before His Death

entries.name: Painting of a Smiling Maiden
entries.description: Though her dress denotes humble origins, this young woman's gaze is steady and unabashed. Even unfinished, the portrait speaks of awe and affection in every brushstroke.

entries.name: Painting of an Elegant Noble
entries.description: A beautiful middle-aged woman, her attire indicating some considerable status. Though incomplete, the detail suggests this work may be a work of genuine admiration rather than a simple commission.

entries.name: Painting of Lady Jannath
entries.description: A beautiful middle-aged woman, her attire indicating some considerable status. Though incomplete, the detail suggests this work may be a work of genuine admiration rather than a simple commission.

entries.name: Personal Portrait
entries.description: Oh, and how fetching a face! Flawed, flawless. Elegant, hideous. Pained, pleasurable. It seems to fit all such descriptors, and many more besides.

entries.name: Poet Unveils Review
entries.description: Here the famous elven poet unveils the first review for his theatrical production 'Porklet', about a vacillating man who can't bloody make up his bloody mind to just bloody kill his evil uncle (or so spake the review).

entries.name: Portrait of a Bored Girl
entries.description: Her face disinterested, the girl looks askance rather than at her depictor. Her feather juts from a great cap, and a mane of russet-orange hair.

entries.name: Portrait of a Bored Girl (Playing Music)
entries.description: Even with the addition of her lute, the C chord strumming out sensuously from the canvas to the ear, this young woman still looks immensely, disconsolately bored.
entries.wikiTitle: Portrait of a Bored Girl (Playing Music)

entries.name: Portrait of a Noble Before His Death
entries.description: The portrait done after his death involved no imperious glares, and much more rigor mortis.
entries.wikiTitle: Portrait of a Noble Before His Death

entries.name: Portrait of a Fur-Shouldered Noble
entries.description: The cant of the hat is avuncular, but the expression of the wearer is cold, detached.

entries.name: Portrait of a Snowy-Brownbeard
entries.description: Bundled in his heavy satins and frumpy hat, this noble fixes the observer with anxious eyes over a moustache-beard combination of auburn whitening to snow.

entries.name: Portrait of a Tiefling
entries.description: Detailed with a ruff and plush chair, this tiefling noble has been given a stoic air here.

entries.name: Portrait of a Trademaster
entries.description: Darkly garbed and ruffed, this noble arches his brows at the onlooker, as if expecting you to do something interesting.

entries.name: Portrait of a Woman
entries.description: Her cheeks are filled with a blush that seems altogether unrealistic until you meet someone who is, in fact, permanently embarrassed.

entries.name: Portrait of an Elven Poet
entries.description: A master of sonnets and plays about ambition, supernatural tensions with the natural world, avarice, love, and moving bushes.

entries.name: Portrait of Fane
entries.description: Excruciatingly precise lines bring this portrait's undead subject to life. Despite his empty eye sockets, you could almost swear his gaze follows you - judgementally.

entries.name: Portrait of Ifan ben-Mezd
entries.description: A glowering mercenary occupies this portrait - the artist has rendered his pained yet compassionate gaze in devastating detail.

entries.name: Portrait of Lohse
entries.description: A gracefully rendered bard dances within this portrait's frame. The artist has captured something unique in her eyes - almost as if more than one soul sits behind them.

entries.name: Portrait of Marcus Miles
entries.description: A brusque-looking dwarf is picked out in broad, evocative brushstrokes. His magnificent hat is bettered only by his beard.

entries.name: Portrait of Sebille Kaleran
entries.description: A shrewd, wily elf is perched in the foreground of this painting, ready to sink her carefully illustrated blades into an unsuspecting target.

entries.name: Portrait of the Red Prince
entries.description: This painting is awash with bold scarlet hues depicting a noble lizard. His snout is raised in a snooty, imperious glare.

entries.name: River Goes
entries.description: Rippling with current and the plashing of silver fish just under the surface, the river flows somnolently onward.

entries.name: Ruffled Noblewoman
entries.description: Her throat sheathed in a truly gargantuan ruffle, this noblewoman regards the onlooker with lips slightly parted, as if attentive or ready to voice some secret.

entries.name: Sinister Painting
entries.description: Here Corellon is not shown as a beautiful golden haired elven God, but as a dark haired elven Goddess, the body mirrored and contorted with a delicious grace and embedded upon maroon muslin.

entries.name: Sororal Dance
entries.description: Two sisters, one alive and a ballerina, the other killed in her crib, dance together framed in malefic smoky reds and oranges.

entries.name: Staunch Tiefling Before Work
entries.description: Here an aristocrat poses before heading out to a day of political discourse and chasing laws.

entries.name: Stelmane's Portrait
entries.description: Her cheeks are filled with a blush that seems altogether unrealistic until you meet someone who is, in fact, permanently embarrassed.

entries.name: Struck Match
entries.description: The match glow illuminates two conspirators in a plan to shake up their noble bloodline.

entries.name: Stump under Autumn Tree
entries.description: A river meanders on a grey afternoon under the watchful gaze of a lone stump, which sits beside a tree with pencil-shaving leaves.

entries.name: Tableau of Ibex and Rose
entries.description: Just the most prettily glowing flower and... animal... skull, look yes it's a bit macabre and gross but it's also pretty, okay?

entries.name: The Vammas Elder Sisters
entries.description: The match glow illuminates two conspirators in a plan to shake up their noble bloodline.

entries.name: Tigermist
entries.description: Huge improbable peaks elude the prowling of this mist, known as tigermist in Faerûnian folklore for its strange padding quality.

entries.name: The Lay of Larethian
entries.description: Here Corellon is not shown as a beautiful golden haired elven God, but as a dark haired elven Goddess, the body mirrored and contorted with a delicious grace and embedded upon maroon muslin.

entries.name: Valley with Brook
entries.description: In this scene a brook flows over stones into a large river cutting like a misty serpent through a series of sloping valleys.

entries.name: Young Boy In Plate Armour
entries.description: Staring superciliously, this young child is clad in the finest plate, sheets of steel slotted together expertly.

entries.name: Arrow of Sparrow Slaying
entries.description: Magic weapon meant to slay a particular kind of creature, sparrows in this case. The arrow will grievously wound sparrows it hits, the poor wee winged fellows.

entries.name: Baldur's Gate Stone
entries.description: It's really, really an actual stone from Baldur's Gate. Truly, a unique historical artefact. One of a kind.

entries.name: Bone (Uncommon)
entries.description: This bone - part of a leg, or perhaps an arm - is clean of blood and sinew.

entries.name: Broken Lute
entries.description: The body of this lute is splintered and its strings snapped.

entries.name: Broken Parasite Jar
entries.description: Caught on the cracked rim of the broken jar, the tadpole's lifeless tapered body has been robbed of any danger or use it might have posed.

entries.name: Bronze Chalice
entries.description: Though made from precious metals, small veins of rust are starting to corrode the base of this chalice.

entries.name: Bronze Goblet
entries.description: A sturdy bronze goblet, polished to the point it reflects both its contents and the drinker's features.

entries.name: Bundle of Incense
entries.description: Even unlit, these sticks emit a sweet sandalwood smell.

entries.name: Conical Flask
entries.description: The measurement lines carved into the side of this bottle are filled with a sticky substance.

entries.name: Crescent Moon Earring
entries.description: A single bronze earring shaped into the Selûnite symbol of a crescent moon.

entries.name: Fishing Rod of Alertness
entries.description: The wielder of this rod cannot be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SURPRISED">Surprised</LSTag>, unless something unexpected happens.

entries.name: Forgery Kit
entries.description: A selection of seals, wax, parchments, and inks, purchased in back alleys or swiped from officials' desks.

entries.name: Glass Goblet
entries.description: Made of glass, sapphires, and finely crafted gold, this goblet is as delicate as it is precious.

entries.name: Glass Retort
entries.description: This delicate instrument is a common sight in any alchemical shop, but the finest come from Berdusk, carefully packed in straw and sheep's wool and hand-delivered.

entries.name: Gold Chalice
entries.description: An ornamental chalice, decorated with four precious stones.

entries.name: Holy Hand Soap
entries.description: The slogan "Holy Hand Soap - for washing yer hands of dirt, muck, 'n even blasphemy!" adorns this rudimentary bottle.

entries.name: Horn
entries.description: Blowing this horn produces a reverberating, threatening wail.

entries.name: Incense
entries.description: Even unlit, these sticks emit a sweet sandalwood smell.

entries.name: Incense Stick
entries.description: The sweet fragrance of woody smoke still clings to these burnt-out sticks.

entries.name: Plate
entries.description: A simple earthen plate, sparsely decorated with a few strokes of gold paint.

entries.name: Poisoner's Kit
entries.description: This leather pouch is filled with toxic flowers, powders, and extracts, as well as spoons for measuring correct dosages.

entries.name: Sekolah Goblet
entries.description: A hefty silver goblet, large enough to contain several bottles of the most expensive wines.

entries.name: Sending Shell
entries.description: Faint whispers creep from this Sending Shell when you hold it close, yet the method of sending messages from it is unclear.

entries.name: Separatory Funnel
entries.description: This alchemical tool has seen years of use, its metal frame well-rusted and its glass stained a dozen shades of sapphire.

entries.name: Silver Cake Stand
entries.description: The fine engravings on this sumptuous cake stand are barely visible, unless it catches the light just so.

entries.name: Silver Chalice
entries.description: Though made from precious metals, small veins of rust are starting to corrode the base of this chalice.

entries.name: Silver Fork
entries.description: A heavy two-pronged fork made from tempered silver.

entries.name: Silver Glass
entries.description: Silver cups are the favoured vessel when making offers of milk to Selûne - some folk even believing the metal to be the Moonmaiden's hardened tears.

entries.name: Silver Goblet
entries.description: A hefty silver goblet, large enough to contain several bottles of the most expensive wines.

entries.name: Silver Knife
entries.description: Though quite pretty, this knife is dull from many years of use.

entries.name: Silver Plate
entries.description: A richly-made silver plate coloured somewhat by tarnish.

entries.name: Silver Spoon
entries.description: This elongated spoon is slightly too small and too long to ladle up soup with anything but the utmost care.

entries.name: Silver Tray
entries.description: An antique serving tray, polished so it reflects the light from every angle.

entries.name: Spoon of Saltiness
entries.description: When salting food, the bearer of this shadow-cursed utensil will always add too little or too much, but never the right amount. Truly the deviousness is top tier.
